articleTitle: Development of Rotating Pendulum stabilization algorithm and research of system properties with the controller
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the possibility of stabilization problem decision of Rotating Pendulum electromechanical system is discussed. The schematic representation of observable system is pictured and the nonlinear differential equations which describe this system behavior are presented. The transition to reductive model is realized and the research of its main qualitative properties is executed. Modeling the closed-loop system by a controller in Matlab Simulink program environment is spent.

articleTitle: PWM methods evolution
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the experience of the first descriptions of the methods of pulse width modulation in the power electronics from the start of its use to the present day. Development of PWM in the 20th century made mainly from publications of the USSR period and the development of multi-level PWM inverters made available by the publications of foreign authors. The analysis allowed at this process to identify four time stages each of which has its own characteristics.

articleTitle: Remarks on coupled tanks apparatus as a control teaching tool
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Dynamic properties of a coupled tanks apparatus are analyzed in the context of control teaching. The main issue detected is that although it is a second order system, its dynamics are very similar to that of a first order one. The paper highlights the problems which should be discussed when the coupled tanks experiment is used for control teaching.

articleTitle: Modeling of bio-inspired algorithms AntHocNet and BeeAdHoc for Flying Ad Hoc Networks (FANETS)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to versatility, flexibility and fairly small operating costs, the use of small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) groups provides new opportunities for civil application. FANET (Flying Ad Hoc Network), similar to mobile peer-to-peer networks MANET and vehicular peer-to-peer networks VANET represents a special type of peer-to-peer ad hoc network based on UAVs. FANETs are characterized by high nodes mobility, dynamically-changing topology and movement in 3D-space. To organize multi-UAV network one needs to use special routing algorithms developed due to their specific features. The article gives a short overview of the existing FANET algorithms, as well as of the algorithms based on the swarm intelligence (of the ant and bee colonies). The experimental analysis was conducted, that proved the possibility of efficient application of bio-inspired algorithms. The analysis was performed on protocols AntHocNet and BeeAdHoc, simulating the behavior of bees and ants in wildlife, to solve the routing problems in FANETs.

articleTitle: Calculation of power losses in the transformer substation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article the analysis of power losses in electric networks, which are one of the most important indicators of economic efficiency of their work is given. As the automated measurement tools allowing to supervise current loads of electricity networks elements, are installed in a limited number in power systems, then the calculation of the electricity loss for a period of time based on the calculation of losses for a limited period of time is updated. The article presents the evaluation of the practical formulas effectiveness for determining the number of the greatest losses hours in the calculation of losses on real transformer substation load graphics with a nominal capacity of 1000 KVA transformer, received in the energy audit for a day.

articleTitle: Models and algorithms for Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows and other conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article authors consider mathematical modeling of vehicle routing problems. The authors presented the mathematical model of the classic vehicle routing problem and vehicle routing problem with time windows, classification of vehicle routing problems, taking into account different aspects of the transport route. The mathematical model and method of solution for Multi Depot Heterogeneous Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows and safety precautions of transportation of petrochemical products have proposed.

Author Keywords: vehicle routing problem with time window

articleTitle: Joint examinations of optical pulse reflectometers of various kinds for early diagnostics and detection of “problem” sections in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental examinations of optical fibers sections which were exposed to longitudinal stretching loadings or changes of temperature, by means of usual (OTDR - optical time-domain reflectometer) and Brillouin optical pulse reflectometers (BOTDR - Brillouin optical time-domain reflectometer) are presented in this work. OTDR-graphs of “problem” sections of optical fibers and BOTDR-graphs (3D-reflectogrammas and optical fiber strain dependence) for heated and for cooled sections of optical fibers are shown. Results of tests confirmed advantage of the Brillouin reflectometry method for early diagnostics and detection of “problem” sections of fiber-optical communication lines.

articleTitle: Mathematical models of the system of measurement and analysis of temperature parameters of radio electronic modules
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Increasing density of arrangement of radio-electronic equipment of different purpose, especially on-board equipment, limits significantly the possibility of heat removal by means of ventilation and convection in multi-level radio-electronic modules. At the same time, conductive method of heat removal, that suggests the use of heat mode support systems, special heat-exchange materials for sealing elements of radioelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Empowering the formation of wireless sensor network based on nRF24
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The use of wireless sensor networks to monitoring the state of different large objects such as warehouses, manufacturing facilities, etc. is increasing. The most effective solution is the use of radio modules nRF24 in virtue of their low cost, low power consumption, addressing the problem of miniaturization of devices and data transmission capabilities at high speed. Enhanced Shock Burst technology is provided for addressing of the devices during the formation of wireless network. However, it allows to connect on the same frequency only a small number of devices, which complicates the creation of a large-scale multi-user network. In this regard, an algorithm that allows to enlarge capabilities of these transceivers and, consequently, capabilities of wireless sensor network was developed. This algorithm uses a special commands embedded in data packets of measurement information, and it allows to increase the network opportunities at the software level. Thus the algorithm does not exclude checking the integrity of packages on the physical level.

articleTitle: Geographically weighted regression: Fitting to spatial location
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A popular tool for identifying the relationships on spatial data is geographically weighted regression (GWR). GWR estimation quality strongly depends on the choice of the smoothing parameter. Typically for estimation purposes a range of the local area, or a number of nearest neighbors are fixed. However in practice objects can form clusters of different size and composition. For adaptive bandwidth selection a new algorithm for determining a set of nearest neighbors on the basis of analytical method ABC-analysis is proposed. The algorithm efficiency was tested in computing experiments and practical application in the estimation of residential real estate.

articleTitle: Emotion classification on image using Hidden Markov Models
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The area of information technology related to the recognition of emotions in images of people being actively developed. Emotion recognition by Hidden Markov Models using the image of a human face is presented in this paper. As the sequence of observing states the distance used between the parts of the face (the distance between the corners of the lips and eye line, between the corners of the eyebrows and eyes etc.), and the size of the face (width of mouth etc.). We consider two different approaches to the classification of the image of emotions using Hidden Markov Models. The first method is based on determination of the maximum of the likelihood function. The second approach is based on multi-level Hidden Markov Model. Also results which have been calculated for the couple different emotions are presented at the end of the article.

articleTitle: Research of the satellite transponder beams interference impact
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article investigated the effect of the directivity pattern side-lobe level of digital concentric circular antenna array on frequency planning mobile satellite systems using the geostationary satellite transponder. The implementation of the optimal frequency-spatial planning carried out based on the method of coordination rings allows for electromagnetic compatibility by taking into account the multiplicity of interference from the side-lobe antenna multipath rays.

articleTitle: Bridge circuit with two extended properties
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper substantiates an electrical circuit with separate balancing and two extended properties: extended functional capabilities and balancing all definable parameters by means of varistors only. The authors describe the way to make such bridging. Initial bridge circuit has been selected and the method to change its loop containing balancing elements has been defined, with such method comprising the substitution of the single resistor by a multielement port that is equivalent to the port of the controlled, diagnosed, measured or investigated object. It is proved that such loop in the bridge circuit can provide for the bridge circuit extended functional capability even if it is balanced by varistors only. The paper contains examples of equilibrium conditions in the obtained bridge circuit for two variants of controlled objects that are reverse two-terminal networks. The proposed bridge circuit, like the initial one, belongs to quasibalanced bridges, because voltage spikes, that occur at the onset of the output pulse and at its termination and contain sum-totals of exponential summands fading to the zero within the transient time period, are not reduced to zero.

articleTitle: The method for calculating magnetic field induced by current coils
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the simulation of electromagnetic fields in particle accelerators, it is often required to calculate the field from the coils with the current. For this one can use the Biot-Savart law. The paper presents a method for calculating the field from coils with the current, in the case where the coils can be represented in the form of a body formed by extrusion of a constant section along a smooth curve. The formulas that allow transforming the integral over the body of the current coil to the integral along the extrusion curve are presented. The analysis of the effectiveness of the proposed approach is given.

articleTitle: The control unit of the recording equipment and transmitters for paintings of skin glow the acupuncture areas and compliance points
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper recording apparatus control unit for paintings skin glow in the fields of acupuncture and correspondence points is described. The installation consists of the primary and secondary units. The main unit is designed to find the optimal mode optical effects in the preparation of the paintings glow points akupunktu-ry. An additional unit is designed to study the possibility of transmission of optical energy between the ski is biological active points (meridians).

articleTitle: System of monitoring and remote control of temperature conditions, climate and heat consumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the idea on developing of automated system for monitoring and management of climate and space heating. The developed system is implemented on the most modern components used to create devices with Ethernet - interface; it is versatile, easy to rebuild for specific applications and optimal in terms of its implementation costs.

articleTitle: Modern spectrometer equipment in educational laboratory of department of physics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The review of the spectrometer researches conducted in Scientifical educational center of photonics, tool informational and analytical technologies (SEC PIAT) at department of physics of MGUPS (MIIT) is given. Application possibilities of the modern spectrometer equipment in educational process and familiarizing practice students, graduated students and teachers with the hi-tech equipment are discussed.

articleTitle: Modular training complexes for technical disciplines
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Presented modular training systems for technical subjects on the courses “Physics”, “Physical fundamentals of electronics”, “Fundamentals of electronics and circuit design”, “Electrical Engineering”, “Electric machines and the basis of electron-troprivoda”, “Elektroradiomaterialy”, “Radio-technical systems.” The characteristics of the complexes, their composition and features of the application.

articleTitle: Training hidden Markov models on incomplete sequences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with the algorithms of training hidden Markov models on sequences with missing observations. The method of imputation using Viterbi algorithm and the method of marginalization of missing observations are studied. These two methods are compared to the standard methods of dealing with missing data: imputation of gaps using the mode (the most frequent value) of nearest observations and gluing of observable parts of the sequence. The studied methods appeared to be more effective than the standard ones. Although the marginalization method proved to be a bit more effective than the method of imputation using Viterbi algorithm.

articleTitle: Experience in the application of modular teaching complexes in working with deaf students
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Reviewed experience with the application of modular teaching complexes while working with deaf Technical University students. It is shown that their use contributes to mainstreaming vocational and personal development of students.

articleTitle: Study of the effectiveness of curved finite elements on the example of solving a magnetostatic problem
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work studies the effectiveness of using curved finite elements in finite element modeling. The study was made on the example of solving a magnetostatic problem by means of a finite element method stated using two scalar potentials. As a rule, in applied problems researchers have to work on a computational domain with curved boundary. If finite elements with only rectilinear boundaries are used, the order of solution approximation with increase in the order of basis functions will be limited by the approximation order of the curved boundary. The work offers a short review of the object do-main: description of a mathematical model of a magnetostatic problem stated using two scalar potentials; covers a problem of calculation evaluation of a potential break; examines approaches to in-creasing the order of finite elements. The work solves a problem of finite element modeling using basis functions of various orders on rectilinear and curved finite elements and shows how an increase of the order of finite elements affects the accuracy of the obtained solution and the convergence order of the method.

articleTitle: Polarization holographic gratings in liquid crystal composites doped nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of additives nanoparticles carbon nanofibers, SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, ZnO, Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> on the properties of liquid crystal composites formed by polarization holography was investigated. The effect of additives nanoparticles on the phase transition temperature, controlling the electric field and the diffraction efficiency of polarization holographic gratings was shown.

articleTitle: Coupled vector FEM and scalar BEM formulation for eddy current problems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A problem of electromagnetic field modeling with consideration of eddy currents is addressed. A formulation for calculating eddy currents with coupled total vector magnetic potential and reduced scalar magnetic potential is presented. The finite element method (FEM) is used to approximate the total vector magnetic potential and the boundary element method (BEM) is used to approximate reduced scalar magnetic potential. The efficiency of the proposed method is investigated and compared to the pure FEM formulation. The results are obtained by solving the problem of calculating the effect of eddy currents on a magnet activation.

articleTitle: The analysis of distribute inter-cell interference control efficiency algorithms of in LTE
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article covers some key approaches to solve the problem of reducing inter-cell interference in wireless networks, such as LTE, caused by lack of frequency reuse principle. On the basis of the author's simulation model it was done a comparative analysis of the existing solution in terms of achievable throughput and the probability of blocking the traffic channel PUSCH and PDSCH. The simulation results demonstrate the inefficient usage of time domain resources at the cell edges between subscribers served by different stations, as part of any inter-cell interference coordination procedures.

articleTitle: Research of electromagnetic forces electromagnetic actuator at fluctuations of anchor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: By results of analytical and experimental researches of electromagnetic forces in oscillatory process of movement of anchor of electromagnetic actuator are submitted the proofs of basic divergence of settlement and experimental sizes of electromagnetic forces.

articleTitle: The numerical criterion of the compementary pair of bipolar transistors
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this work, we introduced a new numeric, multi-parameter criterion of the complementary pair of bipolar transistors. Graphical form of the criterion is simple and clear. This criterion applies to all modern structures vertical bipolar transistors: classical planar-epitaxial, self - alignment with polysilicon layers, heterojunction bipolar transistors with Si-Ge epitaxial base.

articleTitle: Single-fiber optical transmission system with DWDM channels. Effect OA four-wave mixing products
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Single-fiber optical transmission system (SFOTS) is offered, where the duplex is organized using dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM). The process of generating four-wave mixing products (FWM) occurring in optical fiber is modeled. The distribution of FWM products for the optical spectrum is investigated, as well as the number of products falling within the channel bandwidth.

articleTitle: Application method of barrier functions in the problem of estimating the probability density of the parameterized approximations
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The methods of obtaining a parameterized density function with a limited number of data. The solution of this problem by minimizing the functional. In the method of the barrier function minimization problem with inequality constraints reduced to solving a sequence of unconstrained minimization problems. The advantage of this approach lies in the number of restrictions is independent of the order of the polynomial. Practical implementation of the minimization of the above causes functional choice of basis functions and the required order of polynomials approximating the probability density function.

articleTitle: The design of shunts in light triggered power thyristor with integrated protection function from the effect of dV/dt
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article examines the influence of the topology of the light triggered thyristor with a shorted main cathode and amplifying gate on the dV/dt effect. Derived the analytical condition for the topology, the implementation of which allows to realize integrated the function of protecting from the effect of dV/dt.

articleTitle: On finding zero dynamics for descriptor systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A brief overview of the latest results for the problems of quality control theory for the ordinary linear systems as well as the new problems for the above. A link has been noted between the problems in modal control by output feedback and the zero dynamics problem. Descriptor systems reduced to the canonical form and the related problems of zero dynamics were considered.

articleTitle: The scientific development of brazing technology electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the approximation of absence of heat exchange with air soldering rod and wire of constant cross-sectional area of the obtained analytical dependences, allowing to determine the temperature of the soldering depending on the thermophysical and geometrical parameters of the soldering tool and solder joints. The theoretical values within the error of the experiment coincide with the experimental data. The research results are introduced in serial production of electronic devices for military, space and medical purposes. The research results are tested in mass production of products for various purposes. High quality brazed joints performed according to the recommendations of the conducted studies confirmed the complex test automation units in terms of resistance to the effects of mechanical stress, the test devices for military, space and medical appointments experienced by storage and reliability, verification of mechanical strength of several hundred soldered joints, visual inspection of several tens of thousands of brazed joints, examination of thin sections of solder joints, forms solder joints, the study of gap boundaries of the brazed joints.

articleTitle: Oscillistor RF-converter resistance to frequency
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The characteristics of silicon oscillistor sensors with frequency output and oscillistor resistance-tofrequency converter (RF-converter) are discussed. The prospects oscillistor RF-converter for producing on its basis the various sensors with frequency output when the sensing element is a photo-, magnetic-, tenso-, thermo-, or variable resistor (linear and angular motion sensor), and converter resistance-to-frequency will be oscillistor.

articleTitle: The simulation of evolution of crystal particle in vortex chamber
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The vortex chamber is proposed to produce silicon and other crystal particles, as well as to intensify heat and mass transfer processes and chemical reactions. Results of the numerical computations of the evolution of ice crystal moving in vortex reactor are presented.

articleTitle: The design and study of the system of computer network traffic using the secure virtual communication channel technology
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper addresses one of the possible approaches to computer network traffic control based on encapsulated secure virtual communication channels. The design and study of the commercial VPN service with an open source code is considered in the paper. The results of the experiments aimed to identify the intercepted traffic types and to decode it are presented. This work resulted in developing an open-source VPN service based on the proposed algorithm and promoting secure communication channel technologies.

articleTitle: PWM controller design for DC motor drive via time-scale separation technique
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of a DC motor speed control is discussed. DC motor is equipped with autonomous voltage inverter and pulse-width modulator. Proportional-integral (PI) controller is designed for motor speed control based on singular perturbation technique such that multi-time-scale motions are artificially induced in the closed-loop system. Multi-time-scale motions analysis allows getting analytical expressions for selection of controller parameters. Robustness of the closed-loop system properties is maintained. Simulation results are presented as well.

articleTitle: The simulation system and research of functions of random variables
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The questions of research of the distribution laws of one-dimensional functions of a set of independent random variables are considered. The subsystem that allow for implementing the imitation modeling of different functions of a set of independent random variables and investigating these distribution laws is implemented. System capabilities illustrated the efficiency of this method is demonstrated in set of examples.

articleTitle: Risk monitoring of the activity in the verification laboratory
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article reviews issues of the event probability including monitoring of the laboratory activity against accreditation criteria of national system of accreditation for resolving problem of laboratory condition including requirements for assurance of measurements' uniformity.

articleTitle: Development optical module for system of laser centration of pumpings aggregates
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New method of laser power radiation increasing in-process on a takers-off during the leadthrough of centering works on pumpings aggregates is presented. An optical chart and construction of device are presented.

articleTitle: Process variation estimation for passive ladder circuit by means of interval analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article a new technique of process variation estimation in electrical circuit is presented. Technique is based on interval analysis application for a ladder circuit. Using this particular class of electrical circuit high speed of calculation could be achieved which is important in optimization and automated synthesis. In the article general ability of the technique application for a resistor circuit (with real impedance) is shown. Also ways of the technique extension for general circuit (with complex impedance) is discussed. Now the technique application is limited to passive network. The numerical experiments showed an agreement obtained results with statistical modeling with Monte Carlo Method. Further development of the technique is the extension to microwave circuit.

articleTitle: Simulation of power semiconductor converters for electromagnetic actuators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The simulation results of research power pulse converters usable as power supplies for electromagnetic actuators are presented.

articleTitle: Methods for improving parameters of power consumption and received data reliability in wireless mobile ecg monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To reduce the volume of transmitted data, we propose to use the characteristics of cycle codes at the protocol of data transmission with the help of asynchronous transceiver that lets refuse the start marker and the counter giving the length of the transmitted package We considered the peculiarities the adaptive forming of training set for the revealing distorted of areas in electrocardiogram with help of support vector machine.

Author Keywords: mobile monitoring of cardio-vascular system of man

articleTitle: An investigation of statistical properties of parameter estimates of distributions on interval data
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper discusses the issues of estimation of distribution parameters on interval data. It has to deal with interval data samples in situations when the exact value of the observation is unknown, only to the range to which the value belongs is known. In general, these intervals are different for each case and may intersect. The maximum likelihood method can be used for estimating the distribution parameters. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the statistical properties of maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) on interval data. The research was conducted in comparison with the estimates of the distribution parameters on point samples of observation interval midpoints.

articleTitle: Methods of expanding the bandwidth of multicascade microwave attenuators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents methods of increasing the bandwidth. The attenuator is designed as a matched structures based on the planar film resistors. Achieved a significant expansion of bandwidth at a specified input microwave power due to selecting of each stage of transmission factors, providing the same amount of power dissipation.

articleTitle: COMPLEX “BioMon” for the medical mobile biomonitoring development
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: “BioMon” diagnostic system for monitoring human's body functional parameters: blood oxygenation (SpO2), electrocardiography (ECG), heart rate (HR), respiratory rate (BH), body temperature (Tm) and physical activity (PA) was developed. The software has diagnostic algorithms for diagnosis of sleep and the threat of life of the user. The central monitoring station and samples of patient's module (MP BioMon) were made. Patient's module is a set of wearable sensors. Information from the sensors is transmitted by radio to the base station. The tests showed that the complex is able to provide the monitoring and analysis of up to 16 patients at a time.

articleTitle: Synthesis of servosystems using method linear-quadratic optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The methodology of application of linear-quadratic optimization for problems of sequential regulation, where it is necessary to watch the dynamic processes in the environment is developed in the paper. The generalized scheme of control system combining the principles of the construction of classical single-loop regulation systems and stabilization systems with feedback condition is in its base. The proposed solutions represent the idea of conversion of stabilization problems for tracking problems in connection with class of systems with zero steady-state tracking error.

Author Keywords: conversion of stabilization problems for tracking problems

articleTitle: A vortex algorithm for induction motor drives
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The tracking problem for induction motor drives is considered in the paper. The main attention is devoted to the problem of unknown external disturbance compensation. The proposed control algorithm is based on static feedback, which is chosen in such a way to compensate unknown disturbances automatically. Also the robustness of proposed algorithm is illustrated.

articleTitle: Modeling of achievement of the reference situation in the conditions of uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is concerned the approach modeling a possibility of global purpose (a reference situation) achievement in the conditions of uncertainty for some organizational system is offered. The system is described by situational model. The problem is formulated on the basis of synthesis of concepts of the control theory and decision-making, the theory of fuzzy sets and the fuzzy logic, the theory of hierarchical multilevel systems and utility theory. The given concept expands possibilities of the account uncertainty the various nature. Two ways of the description of signs in reference situations by fuzzy numbers and fuzzy intervals are presented in the article. Application of the second way by means of which two typical tasks are solved is proved. The offered approach allows to consider interaction of subsystems at the different levels of hierarchy and considers dynamics of changes of force of influence and background of process.

articleTitle: Definition of MIMO technology noise immunity by correlated channels
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the method of determining receiving noise immunity for MIMO and MISO technologies. The method is based on the use of matrix eigenvalues of multiple correlation in the case of propagating a multi-path signal.

articleTitle: Methods for digitizing weak signals much less the LSB level
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In contemporary software definer radiodevices (SDR), processing of signals is carried out in a digital kind, since entrance cascades of a high-frequency path. The contradiction between very small (by level) analog signals and large value of the least significant bit (LSB) is removed by addition of the vobulation noise. The size and a kind of distribution of this noise essentially influence quality of reception in the whole. In the article, means of the MATLAB system are used to, research of opportunities of numbering of signals, which level much is less than the minimal category of quantization. The empirical expressions for calculation of potential characteristics of transformation of weak signals in ADC are received. It is shown that at the offered numbering there are no combinational handicapes. Results of experimental confirmation of adequacy for models of digital reception of weak signals are obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation of printed dipole match realized on a zinc tungstate
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper gives an overview of P2M protocol - a solution for distribution of massive data sets across multiple destinations in IP network. Paper describes main challenges in designing of high-speed data transport solutions and provides solutions for some of them. P2M was tested in a network of Future Internet Lab Anhalt in order to identify maximal practical limit of data rate per receiver. Tests results are presented in this paper. Research basis for this paper was conducted earlier.

articleTitle: Recursive method of extracting the harmonic signal from a mixture with strong noise: Limitations and the non-uniqueness
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of harmonic signal allocation from a mixture with strong noise is considered. A recursive method for computing correlation functions is analyzed. Theoretical background the efficiency of the method is given. Assumptions about the method constraints and the uniqueness of results are expressed. They verified with the help of specially developed methods and computer simulation.

articleTitle: The radiation resistance design of symmetric coplanar line exciting magnetostatic surface waves
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An excitation of magnetostatic surface waves (MSSW) by symmetric coplanar transmission line was considered for the case, when symmetric coplanar line is placed at some distance from the ferrite film surface. The dependence of coplanar line impedance on the spacing between the line and ferrite film has been studied for the case of magnetostatic surface waves. It has been found that smaller values of this spacing cause increase the frequency range of effective MSSW excitation.

articleTitle: Cyclotron resonance in high magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Formula for calculation of holes transfer frequency in a semiconductor thin film with cubic structure under a strong uniform magnetic field is derived using perturbation theory approach. The transfer takes place between the Landau levels with numbers n=0 and n=1.

articleTitle: System identification with a minmax entropy-based criterion
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A minmax problem statement of a problem of the parameter identification of the input/output mapping of systems is considered, based on the entropy (in the Shannon sense) of the identification error. An interconnection of the minmax criterion proposed and a criterion of the maximum of the mutual information (the Kullback-Leibler divergence) of the system output and model output is shown. Using the entropy based approach, a Gauss closeness measure is proposed, that simultaneously may serve as a simple test for the normality for any continuous distribution, suitable for applications within depended observations.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the measuring circuit regulator automatic compensator for the measurement of thermal electromotive force
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the measuring circuit synthesis controller in the control system of automatic compensator for the measurement of thermal electromotive force based on the dynamic accuracy test. Held a discrete approximation of the regulator with the trapezoid rule. Made of synthetic simulation management system is carried out assessment of the accuracy of measurement and oscillatory transients.

articleTitle: Finite element 3D-modeling of magnetotelluric field for a set of harmonics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with three-dimensional modeling of magnetotelluric field using vector finite element method. The comparison of the computational efficiency of different preconditioners is carried out and an approach is proposed to the choice of the initial guess for solving the finite element systems of equations obtained for a set of harmonics over a broad frequency range.

articleTitle: The planar dipole antenna excited by modified microstrip via-hole balance unit
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel variation of the conventional printed dipole antenna in combination with the modified microstrip via-hole balance unit (balun) is proposed. By properly choosing their parameters, it is possible to create the version of the antenna that has suitable range of input voltage standing-wave ratio (VSWR) performance and radiation patterns. Prototype of this antenna has been successfully implemented on a FAF-4 Russian printed-circuit-board substrate. The proposed antenna with the modified via-hole balun, relatively low profile, and high polarization purity is suitable candidate for mobile communication systems with single linear, dual linear or circular polarization.

articleTitle: Test power in two-sample problem testing as the utility function in the theory of decision making under risk and uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we construct types of alternative hypotheses for the test power research. For every type, it was obtained some alternative hypotheses that competing hypotheses are represented by various families of distribution. The test power is simulated for all alternative hypotheses and all two-sample tests using the Monte-Carlo method. Using the Wald test, we conclude what two-sample test is preferable. Such the conclusions can be applied in the practice.

Author Keywords: theory of decision making under risk and uncertainty

articleTitle: Non - linear electrical properties of proton semiconductors and dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: By methods of kinetic theory of dielectric relaxation the mechanism of migratory polarization in compound hydrogen bonded crystals (CHBC) in variable electric field in wide temperature range is investigated. The solution of the linear system of the equations of Fokker - Planck and Poisson for model of the blocking electrodes in the stationary mode in infinite approximation of the theory of indignations is constructed. It is proved that the dipolar moment of dielectric, other than zero, is generated only on odd harmonicas of a variation field that can form a basis for development of the microwave oven - the generators working at the trebled radio frequency range frequencies.

Author Keywords: the infinite approximation of the theory of indignations is constructed

articleTitle: Adaptive fading Kalman filter with applications in identification discrete system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Under consideration are some theoretical and applied aspects of the parametric identification of the multidimensional Gaussian linear discrete systems described by state space models based on adaptive fading Kalman filter. Original results are obtained in the case that the parameters of mathematical models to be estimated appear in various combinations in the state and measurement equations, as well as the covariance matrices of the process noise and measurement errors. The algorithm of calculation of gradient of the identification criterion for ML method is offered. By an example of one model structure, the efficiency and sensibility is shown of applying the identification procedure.

articleTitle: Basic principles of development of the control panel of hump complex simulator
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses the internal and external requirements related to control panel for hump complex simulator and methods for their implementation. The architecture of distributed microprocessor system of the panels control, the algorithms of its functioning and basic specifications are described.

articleTitle: Methods for improving parameters of power consumption and received data reliability in wireless mobile ECG monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To reduce the volume of transmitted data, we propose to use the characteristics of cycle codes at the protocol of data transmission with the help of asynchronous transceiver that lets refuse the start marker and the counter giving the length of the transmitted package We considered the peculiarities the adaptive forming of training set for the revealing distorted of areas in electrocardiogram with help of support vector machine.

Author Keywords: mobile monitoring of cardio-vascular system of man

articleTitle: Specification of spline regression model with variable penalties
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of selection of groups of basic functions in the spline regression model with variable penalties coefficients is considered. A series of numerical experiments compared three different approaches to the definition of groups of basis functions carried out by computer simulation. According to the results of computational experiments are given practical recommendation on the choice of model specification spline regression with variable coefficients of penalty.

articleTitle: Fuzzy model for risk-contributing factors assessment in a software project
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a mathematical model for assessment of criticality and ranking of risk-contributing factors based on fuzzy logic rules. The paper proposes procedures for fuzzy description of factors and their properties, and presents several suggested assessment scales. An example of model application is given for assessment of risk-contributing factors and their impact on the objectives of a software product marketing program.

articleTitle: The theory of invariant communication systems and the prospect of its development
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the concept of invariant and invariant systems of communication, the role of the theory of transformation groups in the development of invariant systems, classification of invariant communication systems from the standpoint of transformation groups theory, problems and prospects of their development.

Author Keywords: the group of transformations of a communication channel

articleTitle: Research of the amplitude-phase conversion impact on the 16-APSK signal noise immunity
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper represents a study of the nonlinear amplitude-phase conversion impact on the M-APSK signal distortion. M-APSK signals are widely used in the satellite communication systems, including broadcasting systems such as DVB-S2. The investigation done in this paper is aimed towards DVB-S2 standardized 16-APSK modulation scheme (4+12 constellation) and focuses on the impact of satellite high power amplifier amplitude-to-phase characteristic nonlinearity on the signal noise immunity. The Saleh model has been used as a nonlinearity model. We considered the possibility of M-APSK signals receiving under different conditions. As a result, we developed a technique of searching for an optimal operating mode of power amplifier in which a fixed error probability value is ensured by the minimum signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: The construction of degradation trend using the “random-effect” models
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we compare different ways to construction of the degradation models with random effects. Such models are based on the degradation index's dependence on time, which is called trend in this work. Using the constructed model, we can predict time of the failure, in other words, non-failure time of the tested items. The two ways are considered: it is a Wiener degradation model with covariates, which includes the normal distribution as a distribution of the increments of the degradation index, and semi-parametric model with random effects. Using the computer simulation methods, we conduct the research on accuracy of the trend construction, which coincides the considering models, regarding true trend function.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of a solid deformation under the action of an external and internal pressure
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Today, the mathematical modeling of the solids deformation is of great interest due to the development of new materials. In this paper we consider the extended finite element method (XFEM) to simulate the elastic deformation of three-dimensional objects with the complex internal structure. We obtained that the XFEM solutions are in the good agreement with the results of the classical finite element method. However, the XFEM allows us to solve interface move problems without any remeshing.

articleTitle: Some directions of development underground information technologies
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The authors have observed some directions of development underground information technologies implemented in Granch Ltd. These directions related to providing safety of operations in mining. The results of experiments have been shown.

articleTitle: About one structure of the autonomous research robot
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the structure and operation algorithms of research robotic complex consisting of the basic mobile platform moving along the surface and a miniature unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). With proper distribution of the base's and UAV's functions it is possible to increase the size of the area surveyed to constructing the route, and, thus, to minimize the probability of inefficient motion planning, to reduce energy consumption and to increase the time of useful functioning.

articleTitle: Determing an effective permeability tensor in anisotropic media
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a modern mathematical method for solving filtration problems in anisotropic media. We present a discrete variational formulation for a Multi-scale Discontinuous Galerkin Method (DG-method) with special stabilizing parameters. DG-method is used for solving the Darcy problem with full permeability tensor of the second rank. Recommendations on selecting computational scheme stabilizing parameters are proposed. A problem of homogenizing the heterogeneous medium with nonperiodic inclusions is considered. An algorithm for solving an inversion data problem using the Fletcher-Reeves gradient method is given. Mathematical modeling results of solving the Darcy problem in the anisotropic heterogeneous and efficient media are given. A comparative analysis of the obtained mathematical modeling results is carried out.

articleTitle: A ring power divider/combiner integrated with circle-shaped ballast resistor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new design of a ring power divider/combiner is presented in this paper. To achieve good isolation between output arms, the proposed power divider/combiner was integrated with a ballast resistor. The novelty of the suggested approach could be seen in the use of the circle-shaped non-uniform section of lossy transmission line as a ballast resistor. The analysis of the ring power divider/combiner was performed and achieved experimental results demonstrated the significantly improved device performance characteristics compared to those of conventional designs. The isolation between output arms and matching at input of the power divider/combiner were increased by no less than 11,6 dB and 42,9% accordingly, which gives presented power divider/combiner configuration certain advantages over basic designs, such as a more reliable overall performance.

articleTitle: Ways to ensure quality of work radiopure-sensors to base stations
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the issue of providing electro-magnetic compatibility of base stations, the main types of spurious emissions of transmitters of base stations and the ways of their elimination. Spurious radiation, arising in the process of formation of oscillation of the carrier frequency. Radiation-radiation due to spurious modulation and noise radiation. Sustainability work radiopure sensors base stations.

articleTitle: Design and study of the system of metadata image control
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper addresses the problem of confidential data leakage when working with illustrations. The design and study of the system of metadata image control at the host and computer network levels are considered. The results of experiments aimed at editing metadata local files and filtering network data flows are presented. The implemented software products developed by the Research Institute of Information and Communication Technologies are distributed under the General Public License (GPL).

articleTitle: Combined control of an asynchronous machine with squirrel - cage rotor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An asynchronous machine with squirrel cage rotor operation under combine control is investigated. articleTitle: Application of dynamic approach to learning process modeling
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article analyzes the approaches to the development of management systems training process. The mathematical modeling of training systems processes in the context of a dynamic approach to the “growth” of knowledge (cognitive growth) is reviewed. The complex of mathematical models is represented. Development of models is reduced to the serial disclosure of uncertainty with the phased removal of simplification and taking into account various factors.

articleTitle: Parameter control of radio-electronic systems based of analysis of information conflict
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article examines the processes in radio-electronic systems consisting of multiple various radio devices that experience intentional and unintentional intentional interference. The research is aimed at finding the optimal plan for the operation of multiple radio-electronic devices so as to increase the efficiency of joint performance by means of readjusting the parameters of radio waves.

articleTitle: Permanent magnet synchronous machine included in integrated starter-generator
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The integrated starter-generator allows to realize the functions of autonomous object engine start cranking (wind plants, aircrafts, vehicles) and electric power generation. The integrated starter-generator is a single power unit and operates in two modes: starter and generator. The integrated starter-generator is located on the shaft between the internal combustion engine and the gearbox at vehicle application. Electric machine is fed by supercapacitor via voltage source inverter and operates as an engine in starter mode. As soon as internal combustion engine starts operating, inverter begins to operate as an active rectifier, and electric machine as a generator. It is necessary to stabilize electric machine generated voltage at the required level at all range of load and shaft speed. The simulation of permanent magnet synchronous machine as the first step towards the analysis of starter-generator is presented in this paper. Simulation of permanent magnet synchronous machine characteristics in starter and generator modesare obtained.

articleTitle: A laboratory complex for the discipline “organization of the systems of satellite broadcasting”
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For research students of different variants of broadcasting networks in the department of radio systems and signal processing SUT established laboratory model created broadcasting network section comprising two main stations, antenna user terminal, and an optical amplifier equipment, connecting cables. The layout allows you to construct network broadcasting in various configurations, from four types of sources. To change the configuration of the network need only rewire the individual elements of the layout.

articleTitle: Improving the efficiency of gas-turbine engine neuro-fuzzy control and diagnostics algorithms using programmable logic chips
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the application of neural and neural-fuzzy algorithms in aviation gas-turbine engines diagnostic systems for engine failures detection and identification. This paper describes the construction of a mathematical model of gas-turbine engine and neuro - fuzzy failure classifier algorithm using Matlab and realization of this algorithms on modern microprocessors and FPGA.

articleTitle: Efficacy comparison of 2-level VSI and 3-level VSI for the renewable energy applications
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, renewable energy is one of the most promising areas of energetics. Power converters for this area are based on the classical types of inverters: 2-level VSI, 3-level VSI, H-bridges. This paper presents efficacy comparison of 2 - level VSI and 3 - level VSI for the same operating conditions and control algorithms. The estimation of output power quality, the comparison of inverter's efficiency, costs of power semiconductor elements and the comparison of output filters are done.

articleTitle: About the formation of lecture demonstrations in physics demo room of Tomsk university
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the reasons affecting the development of the demonstration experiments of physics laboratories of Tomsk State University. We see that the most simple and reliable devices and equipment remained in the demo room, which are time-tested. Usually those apparatus and facilities remained, which are used for the demonstrations of basic fundamental physical experiments. Physics is developing constantly, and teachers must adopt new advances in the practice of teaching. Large collection of a variety of devices makes it possible for the lecturer to choose the suitable demonstrations for own lecture. The article gives examples of devices for rational use of computer technology in the teaching of general physics courses.

articleTitle: Realization of excitation of anoscillating system with a fixed phase difference between the excitation signal and the response signal
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Methods of measuring of main parameters of vibration systems with one degree of freedom by the example of an oscillating viscometric sensor are described in this paper. An approach for excitation of the oscillating system with a fixed value of the phase difference between the excitation signal and the response signal based on frequency tuning of the exciting signal is proposed. This approach allows one to simplify the algorithm and reduce the measurement errors of quality factor and eigenfrequency of the oscillating system by maintaining the phase difference equal to π/2. For realization of the approach, an operation algorithm is proposed. The approach can be used to study the processes in oscillatory system in real time, including oscillatory systems with low q-factor.

articleTitle: Software for multidimensional inversion of magnetotelluric data with recovering conductivity in the cells
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes the method and software which allows user to carry out multidimensional inversion of magnetotelluric sounding data. The computational schemes of direct problems are based on the finite element method (FEM) with the use of meshes with rectangular regular grids using nodal and vector finite elements. Mathematical model of the inverse problem is based on the idea of the Gauss-Newton minimization. In the proposed approach, the derivatives with respect to parameters are calculated analytically. The paper shows the results of numerical experiments of 2D inversion for synthetic models.

articleTitle: Synthesis of broadband balun on the coupled tranmission lines
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of synthesize compact broadband balun on the coupled transmission lines in a given frequency band with optimal characteristics of power conversion ratio had been discussed in this article. This interactive two - step method allows synthesizing the balun on the two and three coupled transmission lines for different load impedance with a phase difference of 180° in the operating frequency band. The presented numerical examples are confirmed the correctness of the proposed mathematical procedure. The method allows a developer to actively intervene in the synthesis process and in real time to find optimal solution.

abstract: This article presents the design results of the precision microcircuit of the instrumentation amplifier (IA) based on the fully differential difference op-amp (FDDA) and the double-channel low pass filter (LPF). articleTitle: Fundamentals of correct calculation of electrooptical polymeric modulators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Various factors influencing operation of the electrooptical (EO) modulator on the basis of polymeric waveguides are considered. It is shown that for correct calculation of characteristics of EO modulators it is necessary to consider dispersion of the radiofrequency (RF) wave, and also influence of heterogeneity of electrooptical polymer poling in electrode structure of the modulator. Numerical calculations of electrooptical Mach-Zehnder modulators which take into account poling conditions, and also a contribution of the microwave dispersion of polymer and the conductivity of electrodes are carried out. It is shown that application of the additional isolating strips (especially from materials with high dielectric constant, for example from MgO) allows considerably (from 50% to 100%) increase in efficiency of electrooptical tuning. Results of work can find application in devices of integrated optics and microwave photonics.

articleTitle: New explanation of boosting efficiency in classification problem
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We study the reasons of high efficiency of methods based on classifiers compositions, such as boosting. It has been shown that one of the main grounds for such efficiency is the usage of the effect of independence of features. To investigate the performance of a method we run it directly on the distributions. We compare approximating capabilities of boosting and splines. Also we show the relation between a complexity and a margin.

articleTitle: Hybrid neurocontroller for nonlinear plant
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper provides a new style of neurocontroller that is based on hybrid artificial neural network. The neural network comprises a layer of parallel radial basic networks with one input and one output, and a linear output layer. The genetic algorithm is used to search parameter of neural network. The performance of the proposed method is compared with the conventional PID methods for a dynamic plant using MATLAB/Simulink software package.

articleTitle: The creation of a digital element base from components of library ABM to study asynchronous circuits
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: During the schematic analysis of asynchronous circuits at the electrical level high-frequence triggers, counters and other elements with the possibility of control their characteristics (as follows, supply voltage) required. This article offers a solution for the task of synthesis of ideal digital components from the library ABM OrCAD 16.6. Due to all digital devices can be developed at a basic gate «NAND», that by developing the gate from blocks of library ABM may be implemented digital elements any complexity. The paper shows the steps in developing digital components on the example of a four-digit asynchronous counter and storage register by the «bottom-up» method. The maximum frequency of developed four-digit asynchronous counter is 10 GHz. All circuits in work, synthesized to supply voltage = 5V. The usability of digital components developed in such way, is the possibility of eligible them needed for research parameters.

articleTitle: Development of experimental stand for testing of experimental samples of wireless network for process automation module
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The experimental stand for research testing the wireless network for process automation (WNPA) module for field studies and confirm the respective characteristics of existing models WNPA modules. The article describes the structure of the stand and the expected specifications.

articleTitle: Off-line temperature unit of parts of the crank mechanism of piston compressors
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The temperature measurement unit of moving parts of the crank mechanism of slow-speed compressors is developed. The unit has two temperature sensors, an accelerometer, a radio transmitter, a microcontroller, a lithium-manganese battery. Unit operation consists in periodic measurement of temperature-controlled parts and sending the data through the transmitting module. The unit is designed for use in the software and hardware complex of non-destructive control of piston machines. The unit is placed in a hermetic package of oil-resistant material making it possible to operate the compressor crankcase. The unit is powered by an off-line supply source for one year. Due to its portability designed unit can be used as a part of non-destructive control both piston compressors and other industrial equipment.

articleTitle: Identification of the powdery materials adsorption and desorption properties by the use of dynamic infrared thermography
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Experimental validation of the FPA-based infrared thermography as applied to identification of the particulate matter adsorptive and desorptive properties are presented. Using the original equipment, test experiments were carried out to detect a hydrophilic and hydrophobic response obtained from pulverulent materials in the course of a filling the reaction chamber with wet or normal atmospheric air and also after pumping the gas away. Quantitative thermal characteristics of transitional processes progressing on the probed samples granulated surface were measured continuously using InAs FPA-based infrared camera with time resolution of 10 ms per frame. The effectiveness and potential of the IRT for granular material surface studies are demonstrated.
