articleTitle: Algorithms of processing of results of experimental researches of cereals biopotentials
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper stressor are discussed the algorithms of processing of results of measurements of biopotentials for various grades of cereals in the conditions of the most typical influence: the increased and lowered temperature, salinization of the soil, influence of herbicides and toxins, existence of sporous diseases of cereals. The purpose of researches is fast determination (on the basis of vector operation) of significant parameters of the measured signals that allows to estimate the resistance of concrete grades of cereals to influence of the listed stressors.

articleTitle: Optimizing the design of LED lamps for the minimum of uneven light distribution in space
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes experiments on the study of light intensity curve (LIC) support structures LED lights with four emitting elements, mounted in a glass bulb incandescent lamps with E27 base. Comparison LIC support structures design, mass-produced and developed in TUSUR decision.

articleTitle: Statistical modeling the probability of some types of automobile-pedestrian accidents
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper simulation models of some common types of traffic accidents are proposed: automobile-pedestrian accident on unregulated crosswalks with one or two lanes. Statistical modeling the probability of these road accidents occurrences was implemented. The dependences of the probability of occurrence automobile-pedestrian accidents on various parameters of road systems were described.

Author Keywords: the parameters of the road system

articleTitle: Development of thermography electronics monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes the main characteristics of thermal radiation, features of choice of thermal imaging cameras, talked about the means of thermal control and the key elements of the method of thermal imaging as a control method for measuring the temperature fields.

articleTitle: Flow sensor error analysis of heat meters after long term operation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This research was focused on heat meters used in urbanized areas in Central Bulgaria. All of them were installed in customer substations and were used for commercial measurement of the thermal energy consumed. During operation, heat meter flow sensors are subjected to the action of various unfavorable factors, and their metrological characteristics change as a result thereof. A special test rig was used for the study of the flow sensor current status. Some of the main statistical characteristics of the errors were determined. After a one way analysis of variance had been performed, the hypothesis that this was mainly due to the mineral deposits on the inner surface of the flow sensor was confirmed.

articleTitle: Raman-Nath scattering by all-optical poling
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of the investigation of the small-angle Raman-Nath scattering in the all-optically induced gratings of susceptibility inside the oxide glass mediums are presented and the theoretical basis of the observed phenomenon is suggested.

articleTitle: A vortex algorithm for induction motor drives
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The tracking problem for induction motor drives is considered in the paper. The main attention is devoted to the problem of unknown external disturbance compensation. The proposed control algorithm is based on static feedback, which is chosen in such a way to compensate unknown disturbances automatically. Also the robustness of proposed algorithm is illustrated.

articleTitle: Measuring converters for cryogenic temperature
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes measuring converters with frequency output signal for cryogenic temperature based on electron-hole plasma absolute helical instability of specimen placed in longitudinal electric and magnetic fields. Sensitivity of strength measuring converters reached 15 kHz/N at temperature 77K. Sensitivity of angular displacement measuring converters reached 50 kHz/deg. The experimental results are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Dynamic model of induction motor in the hyper-complex space
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the stator and rotor voltage differential equations of an induction motor with a squirrel-cage rotor (IM) and electrical torque formula are presented in frame of the quaternion tools. The mathematical representation has been obtained after different coordinates transformations which are invariant with respect to the scalar quantities. The applying of the IM dynamic models based on the hyper-complex space allows the separation of the instantaneous power into real and imaginary components and by this to describe the electromechanical energy conversion in more detail.

articleTitle: Research of influence of effect of forcing of the speech on a range formant
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In article features of an assessment of legibility of the speech when using formant approach are considered, in particular, influence of effect of forcing of the speech on a range a formant is considered. Earlier the assumption that a range the formant at forcing changes also as well as a speech range has been made. As a result of researches influence of effect of forcing on a range a formant has been experimentally revealed. Change of a range a formant at forcing happens differently, than has been assumed earlier. The accounting of the received results will allow to specify results of an assessment of legibility of the speech taking into account effect of forcing.

articleTitle: Dependence of the mistake in noise of coordinates parameters from the error in installation of capacities of signals of radiators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Influence of an error in installation of power of the signal arriving on radiators of nonequidistant three-point model, on the formed parameters of the probability density distribution of coordinate noises of extended radar object has been considered in this work. The results can be used for the synthesis of mathematical models which are used in digital modeling echoes of distributed objects. They can also be used during creation of hardware and software imitation systems of the echo signals providing test of radio engineering devices.

articleTitle: The base tasks in development of medical information system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Considered in this paper issues are related to the development of a variety of topics of medical information systems. This topic is relevant in connection with the continuing need to improve healthcare. In addition, modern world trends in the development of medical information systems add some relevance to this work. The authors propose the concept of developing a medical information system using a portable system of long cardiac monitoring. This is a heart monitor ECG recorder and software for computer processing and visualization. The further development of medical information systems for the functional status analysis of the body involves solving a number of scientific and practical problems. The solution of these problems is described in this paper. Among them there is a problem of the conceptual design of the structure, content and cross-media interactions of the system, the task of processing and analysis of biomedical signals and data to support decision-making tasks. The authors describe a set of issues. The solution of each particular issue involves new publications preparing.

articleTitle: Automated control of fuel burning in multi-port boiler of thermal power station
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Automated burning mode control is of great practical importance for multi-port PWHOF (peak water-heating oil-fired) boilers widely used at the thermal power plants. Due to its design features, the PWHOF boiler greatly complicates implementation of the automated burning mode control system (ABMC-system). Distinctive features are possibility of burning mode control with the number and combinations of simultaneously operated burners and absence of air and gas amount control. Possibilities of automated control of the burning quality have been estimated. The ABMC-system is practically to be constructed according to the process flow diagram with correction due to the oxygen content in exhaust gases. The double-circuit, one-channel ABMC-system developed with due regard to conditions of multi-port boilers is proposed. The paper provides experimental dependencies of gas flow and performance factor of multi-port boiler at the pressure deviation. Gas savings were estimated. We recommend switching from control according to the process flow diagram to automated control with the electric drive of the forced-draught fans.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling exposure of shock on the electronic equipment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of mathematical modeling of exposure of shock research and development of optimized numerical models of spacecraft electronics, which reduce the dimension of the finite element model, while maintaining the reliability of the simulation results. Mathematical modeling of stress-strain state of the construction of autonomous navigation system due to shock impacts, taking into account the actual operating conditions using developed optimized models.

articleTitle: Test power in two-sample problem testing as the utility function in the theory of decision making under risk and uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we construct types of alternative hypotheses for the test power research. For every type, it was obtained some alternative hypotheses that competing hypotheses are represented by various families of distribution. The test power is simulated for all alternative hypotheses and all two-sample tests using the Monte-Carlo method. Using the Wald test, we conclude what two-sample test is preferable. Such the conclusions can be applied in the practice.

Author Keywords: theory of decision making under risk and uncertainty

articleTitle: Correlation methods of estimation parameters acoustic signals and interference in telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The questions of modeling and methods of acoustic signals in telecommunication systems audio exchange in which there may be the presence of a high level of acoustic noise and disturbance. In particular, research regarded correlation methods and long-term delay parameter estimation and compensation algorithms and schemes echo subscriber units and with single-band multi-band signal processing. The algorithms for estimating the echo parameters and adaptive compensation can reduce the number of filter taps and increase the speed of their adjustment, improve the compensation results.

articleTitle: The influence of diffraction divergence and wavefront curvature of the Gaussian beam on the error of meter standard
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Shifts of the interference fringes originating from the passage of Gaussian beam through a Michelson interferometer have been studied, that allowed finding error of the meter standard caused by diffraction divergence and wavefront curvature of the light beam. We were obtained dependence of the error on the crossection of the beam waist and its position in the reference arm of the interferometer.

articleTitle: Development and research of the carrier module and the mezzanine module of angular velocity
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: At present, an urgent task is to develop specialized modules for automation systems built on the basis of controllers series KM-04. They are used for the construction of process to control systems in the oil and gas industry facilities. Specialized modules are used as a part of microprocessor controllers for the collection and processing of information, management of objects in automatic control circuits or as part of a distributed control system at oil and gas facilities, in particular at the PC “Gazprom” facilities. Rotation frequency measuring module is for receiving and high-precision measurement of the frequency of the input signal from the speed sensor and converting it into a digital binary code. The control mezzanine module, with a pulse-width modulation mode is for generating control signals with pulse-width modulation. The mezzanine modules are installed on the carrier module, which is designed for organizing and managing of the mezzanine modules. The objective of this work was to develop a carrier module and the mezzanine module for measuring rotational speed.

articleTitle: Direct boost converter with zero voltage transition and PWM control (ZVT-PWM)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the key calculation equations for zero-voltage transition and PWM control in a direct boost converter, and demonstrates results of a converter simulation.

articleTitle: Improved method of electrochemical impedance parameters estimation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An improved estimation method of electrochemical impedance equivalent circuits' parameters is proposed. The method allows to decrease estimation errors of an electrolyte resistance in up to 6.5 times, a double layer capacitance - up to 5.8 times, and a charge transfer resistance - up to twice. The accuracy of Warburg constant estimation remains unchanged. To obtain electrolyte resistance estimation, an approximation of total electrochemical impedance hodograph in upper frequency range by circle arcs is used. Taubin and modified by us Levenberg-Marquardt algorithms are applied [1]. An accuracy gain for charge transfer resistance estimation is reached due to more accurate estimations of interfering elements (electrolyte resistance and double layer capacitance) and following compensation of their influence.

articleTitle: The recovery of the phase information from the digital holograms with small angles of interference
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of reconstruction of digital holograms with small angles between the interfering wave fields. The proposed approach is based on a combination of methods of digital holography and step-by-step method of phase shifts and allows to obtain not only the amplitude but also the phase information of the measured object.

articleTitle: Substrate thickness impact to branch-line coupler miniaturization for low pass filters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The present paper is devoted to influence research of the substrate material thickness on the miniaturization degree of the microstrip branch-line coupler device. The miniaturization is executed with the replacement of the ordinary microstrip line by its equivalent in the form of lower frequencies. There have been compared the numerical simulation results of the modeling of branch-line coupler structures with 1, 1.5, 2 and 2.5 mm thickness. The received results show the increase of substrate thickness with the decrease of miniaturization degree and the band of working frequencies in comparison with the standard construction.

articleTitle: Analysis of the self-heating effect in the pair of the comlementary vertical bipolar NPN and PNP transistors of the numerical simulation method
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article, we consider the numerical analysis of the influence of the self-heating effect on the parameters of the complementary vertical bipolar transistors fabricated in bipolar technology classic with the p-epitaxy. As a result of investigations, it was determined that for such structures, the effect of self-heating is negligible and therefore it cannot be taken into account when designing an IC with similar components.

articleTitle: THE InAlAs/InGaAs/InP heterostructures for high power microwave photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this work the study of molecular beam epitaxial growth processes of InAlAs/InGaAs heterostructures on the (001)InP substrates for C-band frequency range photodiodes was carried out.

articleTitle: Solving a consistent extension of Least Squares problems by use of Hopfield neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To solve a non-linear identification problem, in the paper within the theory of recurrent neural networks an approach, proposed in the fullness of time in the literature, is used, based on a modification of the Hopfield neural network and belonging a class of methods referred as neurodynamical optimization. The entity of such an approach is search for the equilibrium point of a corresponding neural network, meanwhile the point simultaneously determines the required optimization problem solution. Within the problem statement of the present paper, the term “consistent” with regard to the Least Squares Method is used as availability of non-zero solution of the problem if there exist stochastic dependence between input and output variables (as known, conventional approach does not guarantee the availability of such a solution (corresponding examples are presented)). The presentation is preceded with a deep analysis of some similar approaches known in the literature and concerned with applying consistent, in the A.N. Kolmogorov's sense, measures of dependence of random values, with emphasizing corresponding delusions.

articleTitle: On finding zero dynamics for descriptor systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A brief overview of the latest results for the problems of quality control theory for the ordinary linear systems as well as the new problems for the above. A link has been noted between the problems in modal control by output feedback and the zero dynamics problem. Descriptor systems reduced to the canonical form and the related problems of zero dynamics were considered.

articleTitle: Geographically weighted regression: Fitting to spatial location
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A popular tool for identifying the relationships on spatial data is geographically weighted regression (GWR). GWR estimation quality strongly depends on the choice of the smoothing parameter. Typically for estimation purposes a range of the local area, or a number of nearest neighbors are fixed. However in practice objects can form clusters of different size and composition. For adaptive bandwidth selection a new algorithm for determining a set of nearest neighbors on the basis of analytical method ABC-analysis is proposed. The algorithm efficiency was tested in computing experiments and practical application in the estimation of residential real estate.

articleTitle: Multielement emitters of terahertz radiation based on array of photonic jet
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents a new approach of a THz multielement emitter based on lateral photo-Dember effect, consisting of periodic gold stripes deposited on the semiconductor surface in which periodic illumination is created using an array of mesoscale dielectric particles to form an array of photonic jets radiating the semiconductor surface with the metal mask.

articleTitle: The construction of degradation trend using the “random-effect” models
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we compare different ways to construction of the degradation models with random effects. Such models are based on the degradation index's dependence on time, which is called trend in this work. Using the constructed model, we can predict time of the failure, in other words, non-failure time of the tested items. The two ways are considered: it is a Wiener degradation model with covariates, which includes the normal distribution as a distribution of the increments of the degradation index, and semi-parametric model with random effects. Using the computer simulation methods, we conduct the research on accuracy of the trend construction, which coincides the considering models, regarding true trend function.

articleTitle: A ring power divider/combiner integrated with circle-shaped ballast resistor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new design of a ring power divider/combiner is presented in this paper. To achieve good isolation between output arms, the proposed power divider/combiner was integrated with a ballast resistor. The novelty of the suggested approach could be seen in the use of the circle-shaped non-uniform section of lossy transmission line as a ballast resistor. The analysis of the ring power divider/combiner was performed and achieved experimental results demonstrated the significantly improved device performance characteristics compared to those of conventional designs. The isolation between output arms and matching at input of the power divider/combiner were increased by no less than 11,6 dB and 42,9% accordingly, which gives presented power divider/combiner configuration certain advantages over basic designs, such as a more reliable overall performance.

articleTitle: The method and technical facilities for measurement of airfield friction coefficient and it's correlation with the characteristics of aircraft braking during landing
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the development of the method and means of friction coefficient measurement of runway coatings under extreme weather conditions. The correlation of measurement results with the braking characteristics of the landing aircraft is discussed. The paper also deals with the conceptual model of a towed measuring complex, implementing a new runway friction coefficient measurement technology. Automatic adaptive braking control system is offered to improve the accuracy of reproduction of electromechanical braking measuring wheel device with antilock braking mode. Computer models of friction coefficient measurement processes are built. Depending of friction coefficient measurements results with simulated antilock braking mode is breathy discussed. Design documentation is developed and experimental model of new towing measurement system is made. Experimental model tests on the basis of automated electromechanical test bench with the “treadmill” controlled drum simulator are carried out.

articleTitle: Interrelationship of the structural and nonlinear-optical properties of the carbonate crystals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Structure and the nonlinear optical (NLO) susceptibility are tabulated for 110 noncentresymmetric (NCS) crystals of the simple and binary carbonates, tartrates, formates, oxalates, acetates, and fluoride-carbonates, using in optoelectronics. It is shown that in the plane of the metal-oxide bond lengths these crystals are positioned inside of the vertical, horizontal and slope intersected ellipses of acentricity. The crystals with high NLO susceptibility are found near right border of the slope ellipse, with the moderate one - into the left and central parts of ellipses, and with low susceptibility into the top and bottom of ellipses rosette. The un-monotonous fuzzy dependency of the NLO -susceptibility on the oxide bond length is observed.

articleTitle: The Investigation of the mechanism of hardening and softening of aluminum single crystals with ultrasound loading
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The investigation of structure A999 grade aluminum single crystals is conducted, the mechanism of nucleation of microcracks and the destruction of a single-crystal sample is described, the phenomenological model of description of the ultrasonic fatigue is presented

articleTitle: Applying of Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distributions by the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The question of optimality Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distributions of linear antenna arrays on the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level is considered in this article. It is shown that the beam width is not necessarily uniquely related to the magnitude of the aperture efficiency. This fact is physically justified. It based on the ratio of the coupling aperture efficiency with amplitude directivity pattern. Research of Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distributions on expediency of its applying by the criterion of maximum value of aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level are carried out. Also, distribution data were analyzed by the specified criteria, depending on the length of the antenna array and the level of the side lobes. It is shown that the Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distribution is optimal by the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level only in the range of low side lobes (less than −30 dB) for almost any length of antenna array. For antenna arrays with a high level of side lobes (to − 30 dB), optimal length is substantially limited, and should be considered at the stage of design in the selection of this type of distribution. Characteristics allow to determine the optimal length of antenna array are brought, for a given side lobe level and corresponding to them value of aperture efficiency.

articleTitle: Speedup of three-dimensional finite element geoelectromagnetic fields modelling in time domain
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the finite element modeling of an electromagnetic field induced by an ungrounded circular loop in three-dimensional medium is conducted using the vector basis functions and an implicit scheme in time. An approach to the choice of initial guess in the solver of finite element system of linear algebraic equations is proposed. The computational efficiency of different preconditioners is compared.

articleTitle: The optimization of drilling conditions by using accelerated life model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we have constructed the parametric accelerated failure time model for the reliability of a drilling tool basing on the results of drill reliability experiment. The second-order polynomial model was considered as the covariate function, and the baseline reliability function was taken from the family of Weibull distributions. The goodness-of-fit of the model was tested with the Kolmogorov, Cramer-von Mises-Smirnov and Anderson-Darling type tests by the sample of residuals. Using the constructed model, we have found the optimal cutting conditions (the feed rate and the rotational speed), which minimize the economical costs. Moreover, the failure-free operation times have been calculated for various probabilities under obtained optimal cutting conditions.

articleTitle: Measuring and computing complex for bench test: Development, implementation, measurement assurance
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Measuring and computing complex (MCC) “Luch-M” is used to perform measurements when bench testing of products. The MCC collects multi-channel data, processes them, documents and stores the measured results. “Luch-M” has been developed and implemented at JSC FR&PC “ALTAI”. The most important task of measurement assurance is testing for pattern approval.

articleTitle: Adaptive fading Kalman filter with applications in identification discrete system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Under consideration are some theoretical and applied aspects of the parametric identification of the multidimensional Gaussian linear discrete systems described by state space models based on adaptive fading Kalman filter. Original results are obtained in the case that the parameters of mathematical models to be estimated appear in various combinations in the state and measurement equations, as well as the covariance matrices of the process noise and measurement errors. The algorithm of calculation of gradient of the identification criterion for ML method is offered. By an example of one model structure, the efficiency and sensibility is shown of applying the identification procedure.

articleTitle: Reduction of influence of sensor communication lines in data collection and preprocessing units
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article explains the ways of reduction of error component of sensor communication lines capacity in using a frequency-independent dipole, an inverter, an analogue adder and measuring circuit pulse power.

articleTitle: Research of dependency of aperture efficient of Dolph-Chebyshev linear antenna arrays on side-lobe levels
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Researches of dependency of aperture efficient of Dolph-Chebyshev antenna arrays on different lengths and random side-lobe levels are carried out in this work. Dependency of aperture efficiency on specified side-lobe level and on the length of antenna array is described. Analysis of the value of aperture efficiency for given side-lobe levels and the length of antenna array is done. Conclusions and recommendations for use of Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distribution for linear antenna arrays with optimal length by the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe levels according to the results are given in article. From the results we can see that for higher levels of side-lobes (more than − 30dB) for getting maximum possible value of aperture efficiency optimal length is highly dependent on side-lobe levels. This length is a few wavelengths. Optimal length of antenna array for side-lobe level less than −30dB is hundreds of wavelength. It is weakly dependent on side lobe levels.

articleTitle: Dynamic properties study of MEMS energy converter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Experimental study of an electrostatic vibration energy generator with electrode overlap changing and nonplanar electrode arrangement has been carried out. Time dependences of the generator output voltage have been taken for different load resistances and capacitance modulation frequencies. It has been revealed that the dependence of the output power versus external vibration frequency has a maximum at frequency f = 77 Hz. It has been established that the output power practically linearly increases with the load resistance increase in the range from 10 MΩ to 100 MΩ.

articleTitle: Specification of electric power systems in ISMA simulation environment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents methods for symbolic and graphic model specification of electric power systems (EPS). The methodology of hybrid systems is proposed for describing the transient electromagnetic and electromechanical processes in EPS. The behavior of hybrid models studies in the instrumental environment ISMA developed by the authors. The offered ISMA architecture includes lots of input languages and common tools for internal representation and research of program models to unify the mathematical and program software of HS with new applications. Examples of EPS specification are presented in text and graphic form.

articleTitle: Modern ways of high-precision frequency measurements
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses the basic problems of frequency measuring and methods for improving the accuracy of these measurements. It reveals shortcomings of counting method and the advantages of the method of integral periods. Also it discusses the division of frequency measurement between standard and unique devices for these purposes.

articleTitle: Fiberoptic digital-to-analog converter with Porro prizm
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes structural design of using a rectangle Porro prism at a fiber-optic digital-to-analog converter (FODAC) intended for channeling of digital fiber-optic devices' channels.

articleTitle: Research of the satellite transponder beams interference impact
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article we investigated the effect of side-lobe level directivity pattern of digital concentric circular antenna array on frequency-spatial planning mobile satellite systems using the geostationary satellite transponder. The implementation of the optimal frequency-spatial planning was carried out based on the method of coordination rings which allowed electromagnetic compatibility by taking into account the multiplicity of interference from the multipath antenna side-lobe rays.

articleTitle: The analysis of interference immunity of information transmitting systems with wavelet modulated wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the method of signals forming with usage of wavelet functions. This method is based on joint usage of pseudorandom sequence and wavelet function for widening of the spectrum of the signal. The modeling of facility which forms phase modulated wideband signal and wavelet modulated signals allows calculating an interference immunity of forming signals. The comparative analysis confirms the effectiveness of proposed signal forming method in terms of spectrum widening and increasing interference immunity of information transmitting system.

articleTitle: Laboratory work: Studying of external photo effect and measurement of a constant of planck
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This laboratory work includes two experiments, one of which is connected with studying of the law of Stoletov on directly proportional dependence of photocurrent of saturation on power illumination of the photocathode, another with definition of a fundamental quantum constant of Planck of h. Compact, completely independent portable «Photoeffect» device is developed for carrying out these experiments. The vacuum photocell of STsV-3 (CЦB-3), the block of light-emitting diodes, the measuring block and the power supply unit enter him.

Author Keywords: the Volt-ampere characteristic of a photocell

articleTitle: The new approach to developing and creation of robotic home controlling system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper deals the solution of task of management of home and agro-industrial automation system, developed on the basis of the frame logic. It touches upon the particular software and architectural features of system and the logic of intermediate nodes for communication such as intermediate nodes logic, data storage architecture, communication technique between nodes etc. Development of the proposed solution is based on open components.

articleTitle: Invariant predictor of messages
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article suggests the method of overcoming AM and FM channel distortions, multiplicative noise, additive noise.

articleTitle: The effectiveness of a-trimmed mean to suppression industrial interferences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of NI LabVIEW digital modeling of application of the α-trimmed mean to suppress industrial interferences in the process of analog-to-digital conversion are presented. The stability of the ADC bit-for-bit encoding with different weighting factors (binary, Fibonacci codes) to periodical interference, impulse interference and normal noise is estimated. It is established that the drop 5-15% of measurements above and below the normalized number of measurements allows to eliminate the most dangerous impulse noise and to ensure the suppression ratio of industrial interference in the range of 100 - 500. If the integration time is 20 ms and the number of observations is equal to 100, then the periodical interference is suppressed to the level of 100 dB, impulse noise up to 60 dB, and the normal noise up to 20 dB.

articleTitle: Approach to distributed computing system development for three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic problem solving
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work describes modern methods of parallelizing time consuming problems. Commonly used parallelization methods, such as OpenMP, MPI and GPUs, aimed to accelerate the solution of electromagnetic forward problems are revisited. Comparison of these technologies, their constraints and benefits for complex three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic field modeling are provided. An approach to configure the distributed computing system to solve most resource-intensive geoelectromagnetic problems is proposed. The problem of load balancing between computational nodes of the distributed computing system, advantages and disadvantages of different task orchestration approaches are considered. Different approaches on building fault tolerant systems to create a reliable one that will be capable of carrying out complex three-dimensional time consuming problems are discussed. The efficiency of the proposed method of distributed computing is shown on the example of solving 3D inverse problems for geoelectromagnetic survey with geoelectrical imaging of a medium with a complex structure. The structure and conductivity of the three layers located at different depths with varying lateral depth, thickness and conductivity was restored. Results of computational experiments show high computational efficiency of the proposed system and fault tolerance to both equipment failures and errors of computing software.

articleTitle: Method recognition of mathematical formulas for the arbitrarily given of the control law
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Article is devoted to the solution of a problem of recognition of mathematical formulas for randomly the set law of management. The method of recognition of mathematical formulas for two classes of mathematical formulas algebraic and hyperbolic is given.

articleTitle: Development and research of geometric inversion of induction logging data measured in vertical wells
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the software which implements the geometric-2D inversion of induction logging data in vertical wells. In solving the direct problem the electromagnetic field simulation is carried out by the finite element method in cylindrical domain. As unknown parameters which are to be recovered during the inversion, we take the values of conductivity, the horizontal boundaries of the layers as well as the vertical boundaries within these layers. The vertical boundaries may be related to the boundaries of the invasion, annulus, and others. In the inversion process adaptive choice of regularization parameters is used. This ensures a stable convergence of the inversion process. Testing and studying the workability of software developed for the data interpretation were carried out using the synthetic data with and without noise generated for a geoelectrical model, which is typical of electromagnetic logging problems in vertical wells. As the data to be measured we take phase difference and amplitude ratio for different frequencies and spans of a logging tool. Computational experiments have shown that the use of geometric 2D inversion allows us to recover quite accurately all parameters of the geoelectrical model. The increase in the noise level may slightly decrease the accuracy of recovering the vertical boundaries locations in the environment around the borehole walls, but the conductivity of the formation is recovered with good accuracy.

articleTitle: On the determination of piezoresistance coefficients of thin Si films
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper considers the procedure of derivation the main piezoresistance cooefficients of the thin monocrystalline Si film formed on the oxidized surface of monocrystalline silicon substrate. The specific features related to the different crystallographic orientations of the film and the substrate are taken into account.

articleTitle: On power of randomness and of absence of trend tests in dispersion characteristics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Distributions of various parametric and nonparametric tests are studied using methods of statistical modeling. Such tests are designed to test hypotheses for randomness or absence of a trend in dispersion characteristics. Procedure of interactive simulation of distributions of the test statistics is proposed and implemented. Such procedure allows valid usage of corresponding tests in case of violation of standard assumptions. The results of comparative analysis of the power of the tests against competing hypotheses with different models of linear, periodic, and mixed trend in the distribution characteristics are shown. Conclusions on preferences for using different criteria are made.

articleTitle: Design and study of the system of computer network traffic using the secure virtual communication channel technology
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper addresses one of the possible approaches to computer network traffic control based on encapsulated secure virtual communication channels. The design and study of the commercial VPN service with an open source code is considered in the paper. The results of the experiments aimed to identify the intercepted traffic types and to decode it are presented.

articleTitle: Increased accuracy of microwave transistor S-parameters measurements
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the method of increasing the accuracy of the measurement of S-parameters of microwave transistors by de-embedding a test fixture from the measurements.

articleTitle: Invariant overcoming method with first oder echo signals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The mechanism of echo signals and receiving signals is given. The analysis of the specifications of the elaborated method has been made as well as the comparison of the specifications with the known Widrow method. The advantages of the elaborated method are shown.

articleTitle: Investigation of gassensitive characteristics of sensors based on SiO2SnOx-CNT films
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Resistive gas sensors based on the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>-CNT nanocomposite thin film are designed. Films are prepared by sol-gel technique from Tetraethoxysilane solutions with addition of tin and CNT compounds. It is established that the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>-CNT films possess semiconductor properties.
