articleTitle: Synthesis of broadband balun on the coupled transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of synthesize broadband balun on the coupled transmission lines in a given frequency band with a given modulus of the reflection coefficient.

articleTitle: The creation of a digital element base from components of library ABM to study asynchronous circuits
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: During the schematic analysis of asynchronous circuits at the electrical level high-frequence triggers, counters and other elements with the possibility of control their characteristics (as follows, supply voltage) required. This article offers a solution for the task of synthesis of ideal digital components from the library ABM OrCAD 16.6. Due to all digital devices can be developed at a basic gate "NAND", that by developing the gate from blocks of library ABM may be implemented digital elements any complexity. The paper shows the steps in developing digital components on the example of a four-digit asynchronous counter and storage register by the "bottom-up" method. The maximum frequency of developed four-digit asynchronous counter is 10 GHz. All circuits in work, synthesized to supply voltage = 5V. The usability of digital components developed in such way, is the possibility of eligible them needed for research parameters.

articleTitle: Method of engineering-economic choosing of the conditions of development of devices and perspective measurement systems of monitoring of quality of nuclear fuel elements
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We discuss the problem of engineering-economic choosing of the best option of development hardware and software complexes of diagnostic of quality of nuclear fuel elements. A brief review of integral methods of analysis of risks and financial engineering, applied for technological and economic aspects and design and operation of perspective diagnostic measuring systems of quality of nuclear fuel elements, is presented. The method of assessment of investment practicability of serial production of new samples of measurement items is described, as well as the principles of integrity and accuracy of measurement of quality of nuclear fuel elements.

articleTitle: Layout of seismic location dots for hydraulic fracturing monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The algorithm of the closest arrangement of virtual location antenna dots for hydraulic fracturing monitoring is suggested. It excludes ambiguity of the revealed seismic impulse correspondence to the antenna dot. The comparison of several configurations of the antenna was made according to the criteria of the reasonable location antenna step which provided the greatest measurement accuracy of coordinates of the seismic impulse source.

Author Keywords: three-dimensional virtual location grid of productive layer fractured zone

articleTitle: Multidimensional analysis of high-tech companies' growth potential
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of identifying companies' growth preconditions, determinants and constraints. The study examines the enterprises that operate in the market for a long time, i.e. “the companies with a history”. The authors propose to define prospects of the companies' growth by means of algorithm of a multidimensional assessment of company growth potential that includes a formation of companies and external environment usefulness profiles. It is offered to estimate the profile of external environment usefulness on the basis of the analysis of deviations of global entrepreneurship and development index (GEDI) values from the expected level according to the GDP of the country. The dynamic aspect for a company profile is formed by means of definition of its growth trajectory and type, a value of the EI index, and also on the basis of its reference to one of two types of growth: “short-term growth” or “long-term growth”. The static aspect is provided with the calculation and the analysis of growth indicators, demographic variables and determinants.

articleTitle: Configurable educational stand for analog and digital circuitry
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of the development of configurable educational stand on analog and digital circuitry laboratory works are presented in this paper. The stand's flexibility allows changing the set of the objects under study (to change the configuration) and lets you adjust the stand and laboratory works to electrical engineering, industrial electronics and other disciplines. Students, which are working with a stand, are not dealing with a component's graphic symbols but with the real radio-electronic components. The basic stand's version covers 8 laboratory works in analog and digital circuitry. Designed-in resources allow to expand the list of studied topics up to 100.

articleTitle: Application of dynamic approach to learning process modeling
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article analyzes the approaches to the development of management systems training process. The mathematical modeling of training systems processes in the context of a dynamic approach to the “growth” of knowledge (cognitive growth) is reviewed. The complex of mathematical models is represented. Development of models is reduced to the serial disclosure of uncertainty with the phased removal of simplification and taking into account various factors.

articleTitle: Method for the process control of integrated circuits production to account the influence of uncontrolled parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a method of taking into account various uncontrolled parameters, emerging during the technological process of producing of integrated circuits chips is developed. The basis of this method is adjusting (correction) of the existing equipment settings to increase the number of yield product. The adjustment is performed by changing the influencing impacts from the control system so that to compensate the effect of non-random external influences by changing the technological parameters of in concrete manufacturing operations in the production of new batches. An example for the oxidation step is presented.

articleTitle: Forecasting algorithm of time arrival with statistical data using based on the principle of templates selection
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An approach to evaluation of en-route time from one point to another of a road graph using statistical data is described in this paper. Analysis of a vehicle dispatch monitoring system is performed. The task of forecasting of arrival time, its relevance and alternate solutions are described. The method of selection of historical data necessary for forecasting and the term “route template” are introduced. Template selection algorithm takes into account current road traffic conditions and uses the most suitable statistical data on route segment possibility for the moment of calculation. The fact that no temporary data is stored for each monitored vehicle as well as taking into account current traffic load conditions which makes it possible to minimize the loss of accuracy in case of unexpected traffic hindrance factors are specific features of the algorithm. Arrival time forecasting algorithm makes it possible to improve planning and scheduling for monitored vehicles delivering transport services inside the city. The algorithm offered was tested in the framework of the dispatch monitoring system of public municipal passenger transport of the city of Tomsk. Graphical analysis of comparison of forecast values obtained using the algorithm and actual arrival time is given in this paper, estimation error does not exceed 2 minutes.

articleTitle: Analysis of the transverse distribution of the micro-strip line capacitance
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analysis of the capacitance distribution over the cross-section of the micro-strip line is considered. The calculations were carried out using a finite element method after conformal mapping of the considered area. The results obtained allow calculating the capacitance in the cross-section of the unit length micro-strip line (discrete) on the top and bottom surfaces and edges of the micro-strip line.

articleTitle: Invariant transceiver of second order and its characteristics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The structure of the second order transceiver is synthesized The test results are given.

articleTitle: The use of robust criteria for the choice of regression model by LS-SVM method
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the researches are conducted in the variants of robust criteria for selection of the regression model with the use of Least Squares in Support Vector Machines (LS-SVM) in the conditions of foul data use. For obtaining the robust solutions is used M-estimation method of unknown parameters using the pseudo-observations. Instead of the loss function was used the Huber loss function. It was compiled the model for obtaining pseudo-observations on the basis of a simple and adapted Huber loss function. In the LS-SVM algorithm as the kernels of scalar product was used the polynomial and RBF kernels. The research conducts the possibility of using cross-validation criteria and its robust variants for tuning the internal parameters of LS-SVM algorithm. The accuracy of the solutions is controlled by using the mean squared error. A computational experiment was performed on simulated data. As a model generating the data was selected nonlinear dependence on the input factor. The solutions obtained by RBF-kernel for the symmetric and asymmetric clogging are shown in separate tables. In work concludes that to configure the internal LS-SVM algorithm's parameters are possible to use robust variants of the cross-validation criterion, which are resistant to interference with large emissions.

articleTitle: Interference of elastic oscillations of different physical nature
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The interaction of seismic and acoustic wave fields generated by a seismic vibrator in the problem of active seismic monitoring of preparation zones of natural disasters (earthquakes, volcanoes, etc.) is considered. It is shown that a consequence of this interaction are processes of interference of seismic and acoustic signals, which lead to considerable variations in the fields of amplitudes and phases of seismic oscillations in space. Such variations cause large errors in the estimated parameters used as informative ones in such problem. Recommendations on how to avoid such errors are given.

articleTitle: Use of modular training systems in secondary school students' project work
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the main approaches to the use of modular training systems intended for NSTU students laboratory works in physics. Applying these systems is assumed in educating of schoolchildren to project research activity. Examples of laboratory equipment application during physical experiments performed by students of specialized classes are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Educational and laboratory equipment in the domestic departments of building materials
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with modern electronic equipment de-signed to study construction materials (concrete example). In particular, the results of the work on the equipment in the educational and scientific institutions of Vladivostok and Belgorod. Morphological features of the microstructure of the material using electron-electron microscopy; size distribution of materials; the specific surface area of powders; radioactivity of building materials; weight change in the energy of matter using differential thermal analysis and thermal gravimetry; water and air permeability of the resulting cement stone.

articleTitle: About features of polysilicon's lock relief formation in case of its thermal oxidation in matrix FTUU
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The phenomenological model of polysilicon surface reliefs change in case of thermal oxidation of lock's end face of the transistor of source repeater accumulation and transistor of photoreceiving cell preset is processed. Recommendations about execution order of thermal oxidation process of photoreceiving cell's polysilicon lock are developed.

Author Keywords: relief of thermal oxide of silicon and polysilicon surface

articleTitle: Investigation of the influence of physical factors of multifunctional devices for reflexotherapy and intracavitary effects on in vivo biological tissue and phantom of animal origin
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Effects of the following factors were investigated: ultrasound, electrical and magnetic fields, laser and heat radiation - on the in vivo biological tissue and on the phantom of an animal origin. The mentioned physical factors are provided by the multifunctional devices for raflexotherapy and intracavitary action. It is shown that the penetration depth into biological tissue and coverage area over the biological tissue satisfy the requirements of reflexotherapy, transrectal and intracavitary treatment. The change of the biological tissue resistance under the mentioned physical factors was investigated. The obtained results can be used in development of physiotherapeutic devices. However more statistical data should be collected on this topic.

articleTitle: Methods of expanding the bandwidth of multicascade microwave attenuators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents methods of increasing the bandwidth. The attenuator is designed as a matched structures based on the planar film resistors. Achieved a significant expansion of bandwidth at a specified input microwave power due to selecting of each stage of transmission factors, providing the same amount of power dissipation.

articleTitle: Fast SEU fault injection in the SoC-memory
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the SoC-microprocessor testing problem using SEU fault injection in the SoC-memory is considered. It is substantiated the minimal time delay of fault injection is a necessity for some tests. We overview the current approach to SEU fault injection ensuring the minimal time delay. It is offered the fault injection method in the SoC-microprocessors using the on-chip fault injector. Possibilities of the proposed method are suggested. By way of illustration the injection in LEON3 SoC-microprocessor is regarded. The general injection algorithm is described. The outcome of experiment supported the injection minimal time delay are given.

articleTitle: Research of measurement error matrix analysis balun transformers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of errors matrix balun. The method of indirect measurements by used for determine the error matrix transformation and an analytical dependence of the standard deviation of the technological parameters of such a device was obtained, which can easily be used in different CAD systems.

articleTitle: Development of optical transceivers SFF standard with support for cryptographic kernel
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Information security is a top priority in any area. Hardware remedies have long been not something new and unusual. But now is not one of them combines all the most important quality. In that state discusses the option of SFF optical transceiver standard. As the main component, which is made on the basis of the transceiver - FPGA Artix7 (XC7A35T). Available FPGA in SFF module allows to realize any data encryption standard. As an example, the development of standard encryption was used GOST R 34.11-2012 “Stribog”. Description of the algorithm was implemented using a high-level hardware description language Verilog. Development of cryptographic core is made by using computer-aided design system Vivado. An optical transceiver has a small size. An optical transceiver has a large size. The device combines a high speed transmission characteristics information. Also, the device has a sufficiently large margin and power resources. Also, work is underway related to the creation of FPGA partial reconfiguration mechanism via the I2C interface.

articleTitle: Grouping of transmitter-receiver positions when using the direct solvers of finite element equation systems in induction logging problems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to investigating the possibilities to increase the computational efficiency of the finite element (FE) 3D-modeling of electromagnetic fields in solving the induction logging problems. In order to perform the FE approximation, the non-structured optimized meshes with local refinements are used. It is suggested to apply the direct solvers for FE linear algebraic equation systems (SLAE) and the same mesh for approximation for several neighboring positions of a logging tool at the trajectory, i.e. to perform the grouping of positions. This allows us to perform the most time-consuming operation - SLAE matrix decomposition - only once for a group. The paper considers the problem of optimizing the grouping of transmitter-receiver positions in computing on multi-core PCs. The mathematical model for computing the electromagnetic field induced by arbitrary oriented induction coil is presented. For the geoelectrical model, which is typical of the induction logging problems, computational costs required for different grouping variants are compared. The comparison is presented for the different number of parallel threads. The performed investigations show that the grouping of transmitter-receiver positions for the typical induction logging trajectory makes it possible to significantly (by an order or more) decrease the computational costs required to calculating the 3D electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: Comparative research of estimation accuracy of parameters of fuzzy regression models with various types of M-estimates
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Is conducted a comparative study of the accuracy of estimating the parameters of fuzzy regression models using different types of M-estimates. Are considered several types of loss known functions used in constructing robust regression, such as the Huber function loss, Andrews, Tukey and Tukey biquadratic. As a model, generating data, was used model TS (Takagi - Sugeno) type with a number of fuzzy partitions to 2. Linear models were used as the local ones. The initial parameters of local models have been set. Were considered two options for clogging the data sample: with a symmetric clogging or asymmetric clogging. Samples observations range from small 25 to 300. Calculation of all types of estimates was carried out on the same data sets, i.e. at the same levels of interference. The results were averaged over 10 experiments. Was analyzed the rate norm bias estimates decrease and the mean square error with increasing number of observations with various loss functions. Are made the conclusions, based on calculation experiments carried out, on the possibility of the use of loss functions considered, to create robust solutions as TS models with interference present.

articleTitle: Modeling of bio-inspired algorithms AntHocNet and BeeAdHoc for Flying Ad Hoc Networks (FANETs)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to versatility, flexibility and fairly small operating costs, the use of small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) groups provides new opportunities for civil application. FANET (Flying Ad Hoc Network), similar to mobile peer-to-peer networks MANET and vehicular peer-to-peer networks VANET represents a special type of peer-to-peer ad hoc network based on UAVs. FANETs are characterized by high nodes mobility, dynamically-changing topology and movement in 3D-space. To organize multi-UAV network one needs to use special routing algorithms developed due to their specific features. The article gives a short overview of the existing FANET algorithms, as well as of the algorithms based on the swarm intelligence (of the ant and bee colonies). The experimental analysis was conducted, that proved the possibility of efficient application of bio-inspired algorithms. The analysis was performed on protocols AntHocNet and BeeAdHoc, simulating the behavior of bees and ants in wildlife, to solve the routing problems in FANETs.

articleTitle: Methods of learning for spiking neural networks. A survey
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper aims to give general performance on achievements and trends in techniques for training of spiking neural networks in context of its hardware implementation, i.e. of neuromorphic technology.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligence support of knowledge transformation in knowledge management systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In present paper we propose an approach to support of knowledge spiral in the knowledge management systems in organizations facilitating transition of knowledge from implicit form to explicit one and vice versa. The approach is based on the transformation of knowledge from one knowledge representation model to another on the basis of artificial intelligence methods. Efficient methods are proposed for conversion of knowledge from the case-based model to the rule-based representation.

articleTitle: Development of technologies, methods and devices of the functional diagnostics of microelectronic sensors parts and components
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the creation of technologies, methods and devices of the functional diagnostics and control of the sensitive elements (SE) and the measurement modules (MM) of microelectronic pressure sensors (MEPS). Methods used for diagnostic and control are non-destructive and are used at all stages of the process of sensor manufacturing. The classification of diagnostic and control methods is given, the basic methods that are technologically and energetically compatible with SE and MM of MEPS are defined. For MEPS, single and integrated validity criteria given to the multiplicative or additive forms are offered. It is noted that the hidden defects are difficult to detect in the operational control of the electrical characteristics of SE and MM. This is due to the fact that their identification requires a fairly long period of time and high levels of diagnostic loads, which may adversely affect the quality of SE and MM. It is shown that the optical scanning of crystal topology in photoexcitation mode is quite informative diagnostic method for SE and MM. A device for MEPS crystals testing has been designed. It simulates SE loading by discharge feed, heating and cooling.

articleTitle: On the reduction of free photons speed in modeling of their propagation in space by the wave function in coordinate representation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main principles of photon quantum mechanics describing its single-particle states by means of the wave function (wave packet) in the coordinate representation are given. The results of modeling of the propagation in space-time of wave packet with a Gaussian distribution of the momentum of a photon corresponding to femtosecond laser radiation are discussed. On the basis of the general ideas about the evolution of this packet and within the framework of constructed photon quantum mechanics, the quantum-mechanical explanation of the experimentally registered (previously) reduction of speed of the free photons, “structured” in the same way as the light in Bessel and Gaussian beams, is proposed. It is emphasized that in fact the photon is not a some formed quantum corpuscle, but it is a quasi-particle, which is the result of propagation of spin wave in physical vacuum, the nature of which should be considered at the Planck distances simultaneously with structure of fundamental particles.

articleTitle: Trends in high-technologic industries development in Russia
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article are devoted to the aspects of high technologic industries specification in economy are studied, analyzes dynamics of main results of their activities in modern world and Russian economy. The main problems of operation and development of high technology and science-intensive industries development in Russia are defined, the recommendation on their solution are given. The conclusion is made that high technology branches in the Russian statistics are evaluated using understated parameters.

articleTitle: Characteristics of high frequency schemes with “soft” switching
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a brief review of “soft” switching power converters. It includes resonant, quasi-resonant, multi-resonant converters with different switching pattern. It also takes in scope converters with active current shape fixation. Some words are provided to disclose SiC and GaN transistors propositions in application considered.

articleTitle: Strategic models of introducing innovative technology for management of electric power consumption into world markets
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers theoretical and practical issues of introducing the innovative technology of domestic electro technical branch of industry into foreign markets. The authors discuss some elements of a strategic simulation model of the introduction. Approaches are researched to neutralize risks on the basis of the formation of project portfolio of various markets.

articleTitle: State-of-the-art in microelectronics class space
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper is devoted to analysis of the state-of-the-art in electronic component base of class Space. The review covers integrated circuits for designing digital semiconductor converter control system with a high-frequency PWM control. For this purpose modern chip digital controllers, digital signal processors, field programmable gate arrays, PWM controllers, base matrix crystals (BMC) and ASIC were considered with ability to resist to special factors in open space.

articleTitle: The logic and directions of economic entity integration during the formation of innovation clusters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The presented paper is devoted to a brief estimation of the situation with the formation of cluster structures in the Russian economy and the definition of the main directions of overcoming problems in this area. The evaluation of organizational, financial, methodological and other aspects of economic clusters creation and activities support in the current domestic conditions was conducted. On this basis the approaches to solving the problems of economic clustering have been suggested. The hierarchy of logic levels was examined, and the principles on which the implementation of such tasks should be based were presented. We describe the basic categories and generalized indicators, as well as the requirements to the process of clustering which are the basis for the formation of integral and private indicators system to evaluate the cluster's conditions and development prospects. The structure of the modules of the specialized information analysis system that is being created was presented.

articleTitle: Optimization of fuzzy controller of a wind power plant based on the swarm intelligence
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the problem of the optimal control of a wind power plant based on fuzzy control and automation of generating the fuzzy rule base. Fuzzy rules by experts do not always provide a maximum power output of the wind plant and fuzzy rule bases require an adjustment in the case of changing the parameters of the wind power plant or the environment. This research proposes the method for optimizing the fuzzy rules base compiled by various experts. The method is based on balancing weights of fuzzy rules into the base by the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm. The experiment has shown that the proposed method allows forming the fuzzy rule base as an exemplary optimal base from a non-optimized set of fuzzy rules. The optimal fuzzy rule base has been taken under consideration for the concrete control loop of wind power plant and the concrete fuzzy model of the wind.

articleTitle: The role of tax incentives in promotion of innovation activity in the Russian Federation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the taxation, as a tool for development and promotion of innovation. A coefficient characterizing the cost-effectiveness of tax incentives as the ratio of individual indicators of innovation activity of the recipients and the benefits of tax expenditures is proposed. As an innovative activity indicators are selected volume of innovative products, the cost of technological innovation, the value of fixed assets, investments in fixed assets, the number of active patents. The evaluation of the effectiveness of tax incentives on the basis of data on innovation activity and tax revenue from industries that are leaders in innovation is carried out. It is shown that the growth rate of falling budget revenues outpaced the growth rates that characterize the innovative activity of the taxpayer, indicating a lack of efficacy provided tax incentives. Obtained reasons of tax benefits inefficiency: a low level of innovative activity in the Russian Federation, the low demand for tax incentives from the taxpayers related to the problems of their application, the lack of intellectual property market development in the Russian Federation as a whole, as well as the lack of attention to the design of innovative performance in the enterprises. The following are suggested ways of stimulating effect of tax benefits: early identification and registration of results of intellectual activity in the organization, a comprehensive inclusion of all aspects of innovation in the current financial and economic activities of the organization; proper design innovation from the standpoint of accounting and taxation.

articleTitle: High tech development of Russian old industrial regions: Opportunities and instruments
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article contains the results of the theoretical study aimed at searching ways of Russian old industrial regions development on the basis of national and international trends. Possible development strategies for Russian regions are formulated in terms of international experience in regional economic transformations. Key performance indicators and analytic hierarchy technique are considered as a rationale for the strategy selection and potential assessment of high tech development.

articleTitle: The method and technical facilities for measurement of airfield friction coefficient and it's correlation with the characteristics of aircraft braking during landing
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the development of the method and means of friction coefficient measurement of runway coatings under extreme weather conditions. The correlation of measurement results with the braking characteristics of the landing aircraft is discussed. The paper also deals with the conceptual model of a towed measuring complex, implementing a new runway friction coefficient measurement technology. Automatic adaptive braking control system is offered to improve the accuracy of reproduction of electromechanical braking measuring wheel device with antilock braking mode. Computer models of friction coefficient measurement processes are built. Depending of friction coefficient measurements results with simulated anti-lock braking mode is breathy discussed. Design documentation is developed and experimental model of new towing measurement system is made. Experimental model tests on the basis of automated electromechanical test bench with the “treadmill” controlled drum simulator are carried out.

articleTitle: Program toolkit for auditory scenes' analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the architecture of program toolkit for auditory scenes' analysis and the features of spiking neural networks and neuromorphic structures using are proposed. The programming examples and the test results of main components are given.

articleTitle: Research methodology of fuzzy characteristics of real options in innovative projects
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes generalization of the fuzzy random pairs approach for research of stochastic processes. The generalization is initiated by an approach to investigation of uncertainty in research project supported with an RFBR grant no. 15-06-06914. This project deals with the stochastic processes, which are the solution of one of the Geske model's modifications.

articleTitle: New explanation of boosting efficiency in classification problem
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We study the reasons of high efficiency of methods based on classifiers compositions, such as boosting. It has been shown that one of the main grounds for such efficiency is the usage of the effect of independence of features. To investigate the performance of a method we run it directly on the distributions. We compare approximating capabilities of boosting and splines. Also we show the relation between a complexity and a margin.

articleTitle: Axiomatic theory of scalar fields dynamic systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article the collective name «theory just as the theory of scalar elds of dynamical systems or the problem of adaptive control by initial state replaced» by a more informative (in the title of the article). New concepts of dynamical systems theory (scalar field, the center offset of the scalar field) to a single unified space of dimension (3n+2), where 1) n+1 - dimensionality of the state space; 2) n is the dimensionality of the decision space (phase space); 3) (n+1)- dimension of hyperspace-state center displacement (second and third components of a single space called the space of possible States. In a hypothetical example, solved the problem of adaptive control points pulled out of hyperspace. Proved the Pythagorean theorem for everywhere undifferentiated trigonometric functions K. Weierstrass. In the language of classical proportions and sequences of the «Golden section» three new proven formula that helps to identify dynamical chaos as the automorphism (or self-similarity) analytic geometry. The automorphism demonstrated new algorithms for the synthesis of sequences of Lucas and D. Bernoulli (Binet). New mathematical formula synthesized in the language of calculus mathematical operations by means of the exponent (the formalism of tuple and mask), that allows to speak about a new scientific direction, named to the calculation of mathematical formulas. In conclusion, the article made the world's first animation of the motion of the center of displacement of the attractor of Rossler, describing chemical and physical processes of mixing in a mixture, and the specified Internet address Yandex-cloud, on which this animation is available to everyone.

articleTitle: Classification of External Factors Influencing the Parameters of the Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: From the very beginning of commissioning of fiber-optical cables of scientists in the field of optics and communication the question began to excite: “Whether this new environment of signaling is ideal? What external factors influence for this environment, by what laws they are described?” Now many factors of influence of environment on a fiber-optical cable are studied. Nevertheless, researches in this sphere proceed. We offer division of all factors into two for more evident representation: external environmental conditions and factors as a result of human activities. Then separately consider the environmental conditions with the consequences of their influence, illustrated by the schematic diagram, and also influence of the factors caused by activity of the person with their consequences.

articleTitle: Coupled vector FEM and scalar BEM formulation for eddy current problems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A problem of electromagnetic field modeling with consideration of eddy currents is addressed. A formulation for calculating eddy currents with coupled total vector magnetic potential and reduced scalar magnetic potential is presented. The finite element method (FEM) is used to approximate the total vector magnetic potential and the boundary element method (BEM) is used to approximate reduced scalar magnetic potential. The efficiency of the proposed method is investigated and compared to the pure FEM formulation. The results are obtained by solving the problem of calculating the effect of eddy currents on a magnet activation.

articleTitle: Financial analysis as a tool for company strategy developing
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper is considered on the basic approaches defined the concept of growth (or development) of the enterprises. Growth is a priority goal for every company, as there is one of the main factors of market value changes of the business, making the enterprise investment attractive. The authors give an overview of the theoretical study of the problem, a brief description of the results of published studies of scientists working on this theme in Russia and abroad. The paper also contains the analysis of the financial performance of major companies from the field of electronic engineering. Analysis of the financial activities indicators of the enterprise is a deep and comprehensive study of the economic information about functioning of the analyzed subject to make the best management decisions for planning company activity, evaluating the progress towards the company goals, identifying weaknesses and internal reserves. The authors also highlighted categories for analysis, which are necessary for the formation of growth strategies, discussed the concepts of market sustainability, the sustainability of the production, financial and economic sustainability, management and organizational sustainability, innovation sustainability. The structure of indicators for the financial activities evaluating of the company affected the determination of the enterprise growth path is proposed. As the study results in the paper there are dynamics of sustainability indicators changes, profitability changes (return on sales, return on assets , return on equity, return on invested capital ratios) and liquidity changes (coefficient of liquidity, coefficient of absolute liquidity, coefficient of current liquidity) of the largest companies of the field of electronic instrumentation, defined the nature of the sustainability indicators changes (financial stability indicator and a own fixed assets indicator). Aggregated indicators for the 2014-2015 were calculated on the basis of the proposed performance measurement system.

articleTitle: Calculation of power losses in the transformer substation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article the analysis of power losses in electric networks, which are one of the most important indicators of economic efficiency of their work is given. As the automated measurement tools allowing to supervise current loads of electricity networks elements, are installed in a limited number in power systems, then the calculation of the electricity loss for a period of time based on the calculation of losses for a limited period of time is updated. The article presents the evaluation of the practical formulas effectiveness for determining the number of the greatest losses hours in the calculation of losses on real transformer substation load graphics with a nominal capacity of 1000 KVA transformer, received in the energy audit for a day.

articleTitle: RFM-analysis as a tool for segmentation of high-tech products' consumers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method for high-tech products' consumer base analysis based on the RFM-analysis application involving classification methods is presented. Instead of the standard partition of the customer base into quintiles the analytical method of ABC-analysis is applied. It has been revealed that the distribution of customer segments is nonuniform. The approbation of the method was carried out on the example of a high-tech and office tools retail company.

articleTitle: Brief review of acoustical (sonic) artificial lenses
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The brief review of a modern state of art of acoustical artificial lens are observed. It has been shown that the subwavelength resolution in acoustical lens today may be achieved by metamaterial or artificial lens. It was mentioned that it is possible to obtain an acoustical analogue of photonic jet - acoustojet - to focus acoustical and sonic waves in subwavelength area by penetrable 3D mesoscale particle.

articleTitle: Method of synchronization in power supply
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a solution of problem is suggested that devoted to a synchronization of semiconductor converter control system as part of a power supply system based on a synchronous generator with permanent-magnet excitation operated at variable speed of shaft rotation. The proposed solution ensures the entire functionality of the standard control system algorithms in the presence of various disturbing factors. The structure of the proposed option of the synchronization system assumes a simple implementation in digital microprocessor. The paper proposes a technique to configure synchronization system parameters that referred to the certain quality criteria and the shape of amplitude and phase responses. A simulation model of the power supply system in scope of study was developed with ability to analyze the influence of disturbing factors. The results of dynamic behavior analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Experimental research of the thermal modes of the foil gas-dynamic bearings of the high-speed electrical turbo machines
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There are experimental research results of the thermal modes of the foil bearings intended for creation the high-speed electrical turbo machines 0,25 - 300 kW of power with the rotational speed of a rotor 600 - 40 000 rpm in the article. The research were made using the thrust bearing with the external diameter of carrying foils 80 mm in the range a rotor rotational speeds of 24-96 thousand rpm during different axial loading. There are some recommendations for forming high-speed turbo machine bearing cooling system.

articleTitle: Methods of providing reliability of avionics and aerospace equipment at the design stage
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes design solutions for increasing the reliability of radio equipment. The authors suggest the introduction of non-linear element into the inter-board connection of the PCB package as a damping device. In this case the forced oscillations of PCBs are absorbed by the damping device of the central connecting element due to the fact that some part of energy, emitted by a more active board oscillating with the greater amplitude, will be absorbed by a board oscillating with the smaller amplitude at the same time, which, in the final run, prevents the possibility of oscillations of any of the boards at the near-resonance frequency and increases the reliability of radio equipment in the conditions of dynamic vibration stress. The authors suggest the introduction of a non-linear element in the inter-board connection in the form of guiding rollers, making the connectors floating on the surface of electronic unit, fixing the PCB package to connectors with strips with elastic gaskets that decrease the mechanical stress of electronic components.

articleTitle: Disclosure of information on ecological activity as a factor of sustainable development of manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the results of research of the actual problem of information quality improvement in the public reporting of manufacturing enterprises are provided. Authors offer the approach to analysis of disclosure of information on ecological activity in the manufacturing enterprises reporting considering a number of factors. As a result of practical realization of author's approach the assessment of disclosure of information on corporate social responsibility is carried out, and also the key characteristics of public reporting which provide a sustainable development of manufacturing enterprises are determined.

articleTitle: Models and algorithms for the Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows and other conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article the authors examine the mathematical modeling of vehicle routing problems. The authors present the mathematical model of the classic vehicle routing problem, the vehicle routing problem with time windows, and the classification of vehicle routing problems, taking into account different aspects of the transport route. The mathematical model and method of solution for Multi Depot Heterogeneous Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows as well as safety precautions for the transportation of petrochemical products have been proposed.

Author Keywords: vehicle routing problem with time windows

articleTitle: Features of the coupling coefficients of microstrip irregular quarter-wavelength resonators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the present work on the base of modified energy approach a behavior of the frequency-dependent coupling coefficient of pair microstrip stepped-impedance quarter-wavelength resonators was investigated. It is revealed that at a certain gap between the resonators the total coefficient of coupling becomes zero due to mutual compensation of coefficients describing inductive and capacitive interactions between the resonators.

articleTitle: Dielectrophoresis applications and electric rotations in medicine: Metrology objectives
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A brief literature review of the foundations of the theory of dielectrophoresis and electrorotation of a cell in an electric field, and the extent of their practical application in the field of medicine, microbiology, virology, biophysics are provided. Primary concerns of metrological provision of traceability of measurements in the field of dielectrophoresis and rotation of the cell as per Federal Law No. 102-FZ are grounded.

articleTitle: Dynamic modes of electromechanical unbalance vibration exciter with induction motor under vector control
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of movements' separation in the unbalance vibration exciter induction motor drive is shown in the paper. The unbalance vibration exciter induction motor drive control system has been synthesized on the base of the movements' separation principle. The digital simulation of the synthesized system has been conducted and its dynamic characteristics are presented. The advantages of the movements' separation principle as applied to the system under study are shown.

articleTitle: Geometric 3D inversion application for recovering the polarizability of geoelectric-heterogeneous geological media
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the 3D-inversion computational scheme for recovering the boundaries of 3D anomalous polarizable objects and their polarizability in a 3D conductive heterogeneous medium with the use of electric field measurements on the Earth's surface. In order to solve a direct problem, we use a special computational scheme which allows presenting the induced polarization (IP) field as superposition of fields induced by each polarizable subdomain. This makes it possible to increase the computational efficiency of both forward and inverse problems. In order to solve the inverse problem, the volume being investigated is divided into subdomains so that each survey profile should cross one row of subdomains. The unknown parameters in 3D-inversion are subdomains boundaries along profiles and their polarizability, but boundaries along the axis orthogonal to profiles are fixed. The numerical results obtained with the use of synthetic IP data show that, if the conductivity of 3D medium is known, the approach developed enables us to define with high accuracy the polarizability of 3D objects and their boundaries along profile, even if the recovered polarizable subdomains boundaries along the axis orthogonal to profiles do not coincide with the boundaries of real objects.

articleTitle: Software system for different types of data classification based on the ensemble algorithms
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the structure and functional content of a developed software system of different types of data classification based on the ensemble algorithms. Also the article describes the developed heterogeneous ensemble classification algorithm implemented in the software system. A distinctive feature of the algorithm is the iterative use of single (basic) classifiers on the initial training sample and inclusion in the ensemble only those classifiers whose relative error does not exceed a predetermined threshold. The software system was tested on real medical data. The accuracy of data classification using the basic classifiers and heterogeneous ensemble algorithm was compared. Test results showed the effectiveness (increase classification accuracy) of heterogeneous ensemble algorithm compared with the single classifiers.

articleTitle: The use of hybrid angular encoder in the laser pattern generators with circular scanning
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The error of positioning in the angular direction is rather specific and typical only for laser pattern generators with a circular scanning containing a mechatronic rotation unit with a built in angle encoder. The error of this encoder is particularly important for formation of topology of angle measuring structures, such as angular rasters, limbs, scales, or multibit code disks, and for synthesis of topology of arbitrarily shaped diffractive optical elements, especially at large radii. The method of improvement the accuracy of laser pattern generator with circular scanning is proposed. The result is achieved by using hybrid angular encoder in it. Its using allows to measure the turning angle and current radial deflections of the rotor axis simultaneously. For that two measuring patterns: a radial raster for measuring the angular displacement and a ring one for measuring the linear shift in a tangential direction are formed on a single glass basis. It is shown that optoelectronic angle encoder of the hybrid type allows to reduce the error of the synthesis of the topology of microstructures up to several tenths of arc seconds, which are caused by metrological characteristics of checking machine used for certification of the measuring raster of the encoder.

Author Keywords: laser pattern generator with circular scanning mode

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of different Voice Coefficient variations for children's voice disorders detection
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to compare different variations of the Voice Harmonization Coefficient (VHC) - an acoustic parameter, which is used for voice quality evaluation and voice pathology detection. The harmonics involved in the analysis are supposed to be capable to determine the severity of different voice disorders. According to the results of this study the most sensitive variation for children's voice disturbs is selected.

articleTitle: The time-response characteristics of gastrointestinal motility
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper related to investigation of gastrointestinal (GI) motility sound's power. Developed special chest piece was used for this aim. This one can be configured to pick up and sound to electric converse of certain sounds and murmurs. The time-response findings of sounds emitted by GI operating good agree with digestion process.

articleTitle: Without Differential method for determining the points of tangency with rotation surfaces when measured on CMMs
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Progress in the advanced branches of technology has caused the need to manufacture parts of highly complex shapes that are often found through experimenting and only later is described with mathematical models. Most coordinate-measuring machines (CMM) now available have their capability based on implementation of the Cartesian coordinate system. This feature has become a bottleneck on the way to creating a new generation of CMM. A major breakthrough in this direction was the creation of a six-axis co-ordinate measuring machine. With six-axis probe control hexapods can control hard-to-reach surfaces of products and make measurements with output that is 2 to 5 times higher than the conventional CMM solutions. Absence of an integrated mathematical foundation remains the greatest problem, therefore multiple separate mathematical models are necessary for the control process. The “minimum volume of measured space” principle is going to become basis for science foundations of high-output control of complex surfaces to be created. According to the principle, top accuracy and output of control can be simultaneously achieved when the measured points cloud is located within encircling equidistant surfaces of minimum volume. Real-life realization of this approach rests on unique iterative methods of problem solving. The results of research will help industrial manufacturers adopt coordinate-measuring machines more intensively, also making it easier to adopt production technology considering information on tolerance in size, shape and surface layout. The article deals with without a differential method of finding points of contact with rotation surface when controlling on the CMM.

articleTitle: Measuring humidity of organic liquids in a wide concentration range of nondestructive testing
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The quantitative control of dissolved humidity in organic liquids is the most important task. The most common method for testing dissolved humidity is the method of K. Fischer. But, this method has a number of peculiarities that prevent its widespread use. The authors of this article propose the number of features to measure the humidity of organic liquids. They are: the sorption-frequency method of non- destructive testing of organic liquids to measure the humidity of organic liquids in a wide range concentrations, using 2 sorbents; the model of the static characteristics of a wide-range of piezo-sorption humidity sensor; Based on the criterion of maximum sensitivity of the sensors, the optimum ratios offered sorbent mass fractions applied to a quartz plate, to measure the relative humidity of the organic solvents in the range of its concentration from 0 to 1. According to the results of experimental studies the identification of static sorption characteristics of piezo-sensing elements of the proposed model for different ratios of the mass fraction of sorbents. The optimum ration of sorbents was found out to vary depending on the analyzed organic liquid.

articleTitle: Neural network application for assessment of the asynchronous motors energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the estimation of the asynchronous motors power consumption using the neural networks. As asynchronous motors with squirrel-cage rotor are the largest part of the industrial enterprises load, the change of their power consumption at the voltage deviations can affect the operating modes of the enterprise power supply system and other electrical receivers. Application of neural networks allows to determine the non-linear regularities in noisy heterogeneous data, provides valid calculations results in a large number of input parameters. At presence of input data for network training the created neural network helps simply enough to find the power consumption of an asynchronous motor at electric network voltage deviations from the nominal value in a wide range of voltages, load factor changes, and also if it is necessary of other data initial.

articleTitle: Band-stop filter based on magnetostatic surface waves, exciting by symmetric coplanar line
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An excitation of magnetostatic surface waves (MSSW) by symmetric coplanar transmission line was considered for the case, when coplanar line is placed at some distance from the ferrite film surface. The dependence of coplanar line impedance on the spacing between the line and ferrite film has been studied for design of band-stop filter. Approximate theoretical method of band-stop filter design is presented. Experimental frequency responses of band-stop filter which utilize a yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) films with different thickness are presented and compared. Frequency dependences of coplanar line radiation resistance and insertion losses of band-stop filter are discussed.

articleTitle: Textured images segmentation based on hierarchical finite-valued Gibbs model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper introduces several variants of hierarchical Gibbs model applied for solving the problem of textured images segmentation. Binary contour preparation and three-valued texture preparation are used to describe textured images. We demonstrate the performance of the developed algorithms with examples of practical processing real textured images.

Author Keywords: finite-valued Gibbs field model parameter estimation

articleTitle: Cascade design of electromechanical systems considering restrictions on the state variables
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with wheel-drive electromechanical systems operating in conditions of uncertainty. Procedures of two types for cascade synthesis of feedback are designed. These procedures provide tracking for given trajectories with a given accuracy of the generalized coordinates of Lagrange mechanical subsystem. In the first procedure, the local feedbacks and corrective actions of states observer are formed standardly as linear functions of the state variables with high gains. These algorithms are easy to implement, but they lead to peak effects in the early of transient processes, and to the excessive consumption of control resources with a significant change in external factors. In the second procedure, restrictions on the ranges of the state variables are provided in the entire process of control due to the formation of local feedbacks and corrective actions of the states observer in the form of S-shaped sigma-functions. It is shown that properties similar to the properties of systems with discontinuous controls operating in the sliding mode, are provided in the closed-loop system via smooth and bounded signals in the prelimit case. Namely, the decomposition of the total motion on multirate components and invariance with respect to disturbances with a given accuracy are provided. For the developed procedures simulation results and comparative analysis are given.

articleTitle: Software simulation of substitution ciphers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method for simulation of classic substitution ciphers for the purpose of their study in the learning process is considered. The method is based on the decomposition of the alphabets of the plain and encrypted texts. Implementation of the method has a two-level structure: the basic components are implemented using software, variation is part of the settlement. This allows user to simulate a wide range of classic substitution ciphers using a single and simple software application.

articleTitle: Apparatus for liquid acoustic signal generation using self-sustained low-voltage electric discharge generator
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describe the device for generating acoustic signals in liquid with the absence of explosive in their design. The possibility of developing a stand-alone, compact, non-disposable low-voltage electrodischarge acoustic generator without sophisticated circuit tweaks, with low material and financial costs has been shown.

articleTitle: Terajet from 3D anisotropic artificial metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A dielectric anisotropic metamaterial-based cuboid (metacuboid) for terajet formation are proposed. Artificial metamaterials based on metallic photonic crystal with high metal filling factor and perforated dielectric are discussed. The optical responses of meta-coboids are described by the effective medium approximation, in which the dielectric permittivity tensor is diagonal with different values of permittivities. The metacuboids has been designed to operate as a focusing device producing a terajet in the homogenization regime. The dispersions of effective permittivity formed by different types of structures were analytically obtained for both metamaterial and photonic crystal regimes. The terajet formation and beam focusing with birefringer effect were numerically and experimentally shown.

articleTitle: Synthesis of D-optimal continuous input signals for stochastic linear systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For stochastic linear continuous-discrete models with unknown parameters included to the equations of states and measurements, to the initial conditions and the covariance matrices of dynamics and measurement noises the problem of synthesis of D-optimal input signal in terms of linear combination of Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind is solved.

Author Keywords: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind

articleTitle: Researches of the on the Brillouin backscatter spectrum
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Researches results of fiber-optical lines with temperature changes in some sections of optical fibers are presented in this work. Results of tests confirmed advantage of the Brillouin reflectometry method for early diagnostics and detection of “problem” sections of fiber-optical communication lines.

articleTitle: Applying of Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distributions by the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The question of optimality Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distributions of linear antenna arrays by the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level is considered in this article. It is shown that the beam width is not necessarily uniquely related to the magnitude of the aperture efficiency. This fact is physically justified. It based on the ratio of the coupling aperture efficiency with amplitude directivity pattern. Research of Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distributions on expediency of its applying by the criterion of maximum value of aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level is carried out. Also, distribution data were analyzed by the specified criteria, depending on the length of the antenna array and the level of the side lobes. It is shown that the Dolph-Chebyshev amplitude distribution is optimal by the criterion of maximum aperture efficiency for given side-lobe level only in the range of the low side lobes (less than -30 dB) for almost any length of antenna array. For antenna arrays with a high level of side lobes (to -30 dB), optimal length is substantially limited, and should be considered at the stage of design in the selection of this type of distribution. Characteristics allow to determine the optimal length of antenna array are brought, for a given side lobe level and corresponding to them values of aperture efficiency.

articleTitle: Comparison of measuring time of frequency by methods counting and coincidence
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article carried out comparative analysis of three methods of measuring time frequency measurement - measurement method frequency by counting the frequency of the standard periods for integer periods of the measured frequency; measurement method frequency by counting the frequency of the measured periods for integer periods of the standard frequency; measurement frequency by method coincidence. Got an expression for calculating the optimum values of pulse duration the use of which allows to reach minimum time of measure the frequency by coincidence method; expression to evaluate time of measure the frequency by coincidence method by using the optimal values of the duty ratio; expression to determine the frequency range in which the measurement of frequency by coincidence method is faster than the measurement of frequency by count methods. It was found that the measurement of the frequency with a given level of relative maximum methodical sampling errors by coincidence method using the optimum pulse width value provides the time is less than the measurement method of counting frequency over a wide frequency range.

articleTitle: A development of algorithms for an automated blood sample image analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the thick blood sample images, problems of red blood cells counting and their analysis given by optical method were considered. Algorithms, based on Canny approach to edge detection, have been developed and realized with the following circle determination in the images by Hough transformation. The experimental test results of the algorithms are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of fluctuation of MOSFET's electrothermal parameter on thermal conditions in bridge inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the problem of the influence of techological fluctuation of power MOSFET's thermal resistance on the thermal conditions in a bridge inverter. MOSFET's electrothermal model is described. Simulation results of electrothermal processes occurring in the simultaneously working bridge inverter's switches are presented. Experimental data supporting calculations is given.

articleTitle: Variational formulation for a magnetic field on dual meshes
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The mathematical modeling of the magnetic field H as the first order differential form with external orientation was considered in the paper. The variational formulation for the second order equation for the magnetic field was formulated. The ways to the dual triangulation construction for space approximation was shown. The approach of basic functions definition on polyhedrons was proposed.

articleTitle: Approach to distributed computing system development for three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic problem solving
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work describes modern methods of parallelizing time consuming problems. Commonly used parallelization methods, such as OpenMP, MPI and GPUs, aimed to accelerate the solution of electromagnetic forward problems are revisited. Comparison of these technologies, their constraints and benefits for complex three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic field modeling are provided. An approach to configure the distributed computing system to solve most resource-intensive geoelectromagnetic problems is proposed. The problem of load balancing between computational nodes of the distributed computing system, advantages and disadvantages of different task orchestration approaches are considered. Different approaches on building fault tolerant systems to create a reliable one that will be capable of carrying out complex three-dimensional time consuming problems are discussed. The efficiency of the proposed method of distributed computing is shown on the example of solving 3D inverse problems for geoelectromagnetic survey with geoelectrical imaging of a medium with a complex structure. The structure and conductivity of the three layers located at different depths with varying lateral depth, thickness and conductivity was restored. Results of computational experiments show high computational efficiency of the proposed system and fault tolerance to both equipment failures and errors of computing software.

articleTitle: Usage of spectral models and switching functions for cascaded H-bridges VSC analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes implementation of mathematical analysis based on spectral models and switching functions to simulate operation of three-phase multilevel inverters of the cascaded topologies. Two types of cascaded inverters are considered: conventional one using series connection of the bridges and hybrid topology using both series and parallel connection. It is shown that usage of spectral models with switching functions provides one with a powerful tool for complex analysis of the voltages and currents in a multilevel converter with a complicated topology. Computer simulation is given in order to verify the results obtained via mathematical models.

articleTitle: Direct bonding copper with alumina and aluminum nitride ceramic substrates
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper will discuss the technological aspects of direct bonding copper (DBC) process conducted on a copper foil (M00б) with high thermal conductive alumina (BK-96, BK-100) and aluminum nitride ceramics (AIN) being utilized in bonding. There is a wide use of DBC structure in the construction of high power semiconductor devices. The paper will also provide the results of the research on compound interfaces that was carried out based on DBC technology.
