The bonding strenght of DBC interfaces was measured, with the results of said measurements presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Synthesis of broadband impedance transformers with predetermined phase response
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Procedures for optimal synthesis of broadband impedance transformers with predetermined phase response was proposed in this paper. The proposed method makes it possible to obtain a matrix mathematical model of the transformer in the Foster's form with lumped or distributed elements. The mathematical model describes entire set of equivalent circuits. Among them we can select a suitable in terms of technological feasibility. The efficiency of the method is demonstrated by the example of synthesis of the broadband impedance transformer with lumped elements.

articleTitle: Control system design based on sliding mode control and singular perturbation technique for a Cuk converter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Cascade control system method for power converter implemented by a Cuk scheme is discussed. Proposed control system consists of two control loops. Inner control loop allows maintaining input current of the converter by sliding mode control. In the outer control loop a continuous third-order controller is used to stabilize output voltage of the converter. The method of the outer controller parameters calculation is based on singular perturbation technique. Finally, numerical simulation results are carried out in order to prove effectiveness of the proposed design methodology.

articleTitle: Analysis of promising business models in solar energy market
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Solar power is one of the most controversial trends of future power generation. On the one hand, its cost is high, and investments pay off only in countries with high solar insolation. On the other hand, the emergence of new technological, organizational and administrative decisions on the energy market leads to a change in market structure, participants and business rules. Companies have new opportunities, which they can use, provided that they can choose a promising business model, adequate to the situation.

Author Keywords: organizational and managerial innovations in solar power generation
prospects of companies in solar energy market

articleTitle: The methodical approach to assessing the effectiveness of science/technology parks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article provides an overview of the existing methods for assessing the activity of science/technology parks, as well as the listed sources, describing the system of evaluation of a particular aspect of their activities. Based on their study and systematize the technique of calculating the efficiency of the science/technology park activity, which can be used in assessing the effectiveness of the control of science/ technology parks companies, efficiency of use of budgetary funds, the adjustment of industrial parks development strategies.

articleTitle: Detection of signals and identification of sources in the monitoring networks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Major problems of computing technologies forming a basis for modern hierarchic monitoring networks are considered. Such networks are used to trace natural processes mostly in seismic-volcano prone zones and technogenic processes associated with industrial and test site explosions, destructive processes in hydropower and nuclear power plants, etc. Algorithmic approaches for online solving of the problems and methods of their implementation, which increase the accuracy and performance of calculations at various network hierarchic levels, are proposed.

articleTitle: Multimedia support for physics laboratory works in higher education institutions
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The multimedia facilities workability in the `Physics' course engineering students' laboratory works independent preparation is considered in this piece of work. The examples of the video instructions packages provided with the laboratory tests, which are performed by the NSTU General Physics Department students, are also shown in the article.

articleTitle: Development and research of geometric inversion of induction logging data measured in vertical wells
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the software which implements the geometric-2D inversion of induction logging data in vertical wells. In solving the direct problem the electromagnetic field simulation is carried out by the finite element method in cylindrical domain. As unknown parameters which are to be recovered during the inversion, we take the values of conductivity, the horizontal boundaries of the layers as well as the vertical boundaries within these layers. The vertical boundaries may be related to the boundaries of the invasion, annulus, and others. In the inversion process adaptive choice of regularization parameters is used. This ensures a stable convergence of the inversion process. Testing and studying the workability of software developed for the data interpretation were carried out using the synthetic data with and without noise generated for a geoelectrical model, which is typical of electromagnetic logging problems in vertical wells. As the data to be measured we take phase difference and amplitude ratio for different frequencies and spans of a logging tool. Computational experiments have shown that the use of geometric 2D inversion allows us to recover quite accurately all parameters of the geoelectrical model. The increase in the noise level may slightly decrease the accuracy of recovering the vertical boundaries locations in the environment around the borehole walls, but the conductivity of the formation is recovered with good accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of the information measuring system for control of electrophysical properties of composites
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to develop the original method of research of electrophysical properties of composites the information measuring system for control of electric resistance of powders during consolidation as well as the system for thermoelectric measurement was designed in National Research Nuclear University MEPhI. The prototypes of the system allow collecting data from measuring probes on-line and recording changes of composite powder density during cold pressing at room temperature as well as obtain data of coating thickness via thermoelectric measurement. The article also highlights the items of information support for automation of electrical resistance measurement of powder materials and thermoelectric thickness measurement.

articleTitle: Some actual problems of electronic instrument in the field of reflexotherapy
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Some actual problems of electronic instrument engineering in the field of reflexotherapy were revealed following the works of researchers of Interuniversity Laboratory for Medical Electronics in NSTU. It is shown that the main problems in the considered field are: 1) realization, clinical testing and inclusion into medical practice of the multifunctional device for reflexotherapy with spatial and temporal combining of five physical influencing factors; 2) development and creation of batch production acceptable device for visualization of biologically active points (BAP) and systems of correspondence to organs with pathology by Su Jok method; 3) development and creation of the device for studying physical processes taking place during the visualization procedure for BAP and projections of organs with pathology by Su Jok method.

articleTitle: Metrological opportunities of direct three-dimensional measurement of objects by means of the Kinect controller
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The metrological possibilities of the Kinect controller for direct measurement of objects are considered in this review. The principal components of the controller, the principle of its operation and the main technologies compiling Kinect are considered.

articleTitle: Approach to the analysis and synthesis of the sign language
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses various approaches to demonstrating, training, application and study Russian sign language (RSL). The most well-known projects on development of computer translation RSL. It raised the basic problems of RSL and analyses various approaches to their solution, including the problem of linguistic text analysis. The author proposer the way of solving some of these problem. Comparing different notations of RSL the key factors and differences are found. The articles dive examples of such notations as Dimksim, SignWriter and HamNoSys, briefly considers the specificity of each of them, and shows how to work with them. It provides a way to convert sign language notation in the clip raises the problem of the inverse transform, gives examples, which show the parsing of some aspects of the RSL, as well as examples of how to transforming the notation in the clip using various libraries RSL. In the same way is an example of converting an animation clip in the notation element is given. The analysis and synthesis of the RSL in different variations is also considered.

articleTitle: The radiation-hardened BiJFet differential amplifiers with negative current feedback on the common-mode signal
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the advanced two-stage architectures of the differential op-amps and differential difference operational amplifiers, realized on the base BiJFet of array chips AGAMC1.3, AGAMC2.1 (OJSC “Integral”, Minsk). The suggested circuits provide the higher voltage gain (more than 90...100 dB), and also the low offset voltage (less than 100 μV) over the temperature range -80°C - +80°C, the neutron flux up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> n/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and the accumulated dose of radiation up to 3 Mrad. The mathematical justification of the main parameters is given. The results of their computer simulation are presented.

Author Keywords: current negative feedback on common-mode signal

articleTitle: Using thermostatically controlled loads for the secondary control provision based on the modal method
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with providing ancillary services using thermostatically controlled loads, in particular electrical space heaters. Ancillary services, such as the secondary control, are aimed to maintain balance between production and consumption of the electricity. Developing concept of smart grids provides possibility to involve classical and advanced control methods for ancillary service provision. The aggregate consumption produced by thermostatically controlled loads is significant due to relatively big number of devices of this kind. The obtained results show that a large population of electrical space heaters can meet the requirements on the secondary control. The population model is based on the first order approximation of the equivalent thermal parameter model. The matrix form of the modal method is used for control system design. Since the modal method assumes using linear model, calculations of the controller parameter are based on a 1D bin state transition model, which is used for approximation of the population behavior. The main feature of the designed control system is that the temperature control and demand tracking are provided by the central controller simultaneously, whereas the standard approaches assumes the temperature to be controlled by the local thermostats.

articleTitle: Permissible deviation ranges of a collimating lens irradiator
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Ranges of acceptable irradiator displacement from a focus coordinate through length and breadth of collimating lens principal optic axis were determined, where a phase error is less than 22.5 degrees. Lens materials that have low and high values of relative dielectric capacity have been considered. It is shown, that for the lens made of materials with low relative dielectric capacity, irradiator value of removal through breadth of the principal optic axis decreases. The value of removal through length of the principal optic axis weakly depends on the lens material.

articleTitle: Comparative research of estimation accuracy of parameters of fuzzy regression models with various types of m-estimates
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In work is conducted a comparative research of estimation accuracy of parameters of fuzzy regression models with various types of m-estimates, are considered several types of loss known functions. The purpose of this research is to obtain practical recommendations for using the considered of loss functions for constructing robust fuzzy regression. Were considered two options for clogging the data sample: with a symmetric clogging or asymmetric clogging. Samples observations range from small 25 to 300. Was analyzed the rate norm bias estimates decrease and the mean square error with increasing number of observations with various loss functions. Make are certain conclusions.

articleTitle: Comparison of computational costs of Hartley transform and Fourier transform
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the calculation of benefit in fast operation of Hartley transform relatively Fourier transform which is approximately 36%. It is due to the absence of complex numbers in the calculations thereby reducing requirements to the processor system as a whole.

articleTitle: On the reduction of free photons speed in modeling of their propagation in space by the wave function in coordinate representation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main principles of photon quantum mechanics describing its single-particle states by means of the wave function (wave packet) in the coordinate representation are given. The results of modeling of the propagation in space-time of wave packet with a Gaussian distribution of the momenta of a photon corresponding to femtosecond laser radiation are discussed. On the basis of the general ideas about the evolution of this packet and within the framework of constructed photon quantum mechanics, the quantum-mechanical explanation of the experimentally registered (previously) reduction of speed of the free photons, “structured” in the same way as the light in Bessel and Gaussian beams, is proposed. It is emphasized that in fact the photon is not a some formed quantum corpuscle, but it is a quasi-particle, which is the result of propagation of spin wave in physical vacuum, the nature of which should be considered at the Planck distances simultaneously with structure of leptons and other fundamental particles.

articleTitle: Research of Tukey's test statistic distribution under failure of the normality assumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we study the effect of disturbances of a normality assumption on the distribution of the Tukey criterion statistic multiple comparisons. The method of computer simulation of Monte Carlo is used as a research tool. The conclusions on the possibility of correctly applying of the Tukey criterion in different situations are made.

articleTitle: Key generator with adjustable contour
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of the analysis of the frequency dependence of the main energy indicators key generator forming a loop that operates without adjustment of the oscillating system.

Author Keywords: the energy indicators forming the contour

articleTitle: Remarks on the coupled tanks apparatus as a control teaching tool
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Dynamic properties of a coupled tanks apparatus are analyzed in the context of control teaching. The main issue detected is that although it is a second order system, its dynamics are very similar to that of a first order one. The paper highlights the problems which should be discussed when the coupled tanks experiment is used for control teaching.

articleTitle: Sensitized photoconductivity in silicon
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The DC photoconductivity of powdered silicon samples was studied. Effective sensitization of photoconductivity for semiconductors with organic dyes applied to the surface of microcrystalls was found. Photoconductivity in the absorption band of the dyes in the visible part of the spectrum is increasing by more than an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Automated control of fuel burning in multi-port boiler of thermal power station
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Automated burning mode control is of great practical importance for multi-port PWHOF (peak water-heating oil-fired) boilers widely used at the thermal power plants. Due to its design features, the PWHOF boiler greatly complicates implementation of the automated burning mode control system (ABMC-system). Distinctive features are possibility of burning mode control with the number and combinations of simultaneously operated burners and absence of air and gas amount control. Possibilities of automated control of the burning quality have been estimated. The ABMC-system is practically to be constructed according to the process flow diagram with correction due to the oxygen content in exhaust gases. The double-circuit, one-channel ABMC-system developed with due regard to conditions of multi-port boilers is proposed. The paper provides experimental dependencies of gas flow and performance factor of multi-port boiler at the pressure deviation. Gas savings were estimated. We recommend switching from control according to the process flow diagram to automated control with the electric drive of the forced-draught fans.

articleTitle: Experimental Research Of The Effect Of The LEDs Brightness On The Structure Of The Image Of The Dynamic Test Objest
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The present article is concerned with the experimental study of the influence of the LEDs brightness on the structure of the image of the dynamic test object. Qualitative dependences of the LEDs brightness of the dynamic test object from the flowing current were obtained. The necessity of a number of design solutions to ensure the normal operation of the dynamic test object was found out.

articleTitle: Solution of the problem of searching for an energy-efficient functioning mode of a continuous production using simulation and artificial intelligence methods
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article examines the problem of searching for an energy-efficient functioning mode for a power-consuming continuous production characterized by nonlinearity, inertness and closed-circuit operation. It suggests a method to construct a multi-criterion target function on the basis of technological production process simulation. A genetic algorithm was used to solve an optimization problem, which made it possible to receive values of controlling technological production parameters that ensured decrease in energy consumption.

articleTitle: The analysis of distribute inter-cell interference control efficiency algorithms of in LTE
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article covers some key approaches to solve the problem of reducing inter-cell interference in wireless networks, such as LTE, caused by lack of frequency reuse principle. On the basis of the author's simulation model it was done a comparative analysis of the existing solution in terms of achievable throughput and the probability of blocking the traffic channel PUSCH and PDSCH. The simulation results demonstrate the inefficient usage of time domain resources at the cell edges between subscribers served by different stations, as part of any inter-cell interference coordination procedures.

articleTitle: Specific characteristics of a PWM signal based on sawtooth voltage
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Here is given the explanation why a sine which is con-verted into a pulse-width signal (also known as “PWM signal”) due to sawtooth voltage has less first harmonic's error than a pulse-width signal being gotten via calculation depending on the signal's level at the middle of a period (on this period, there forms a signal's impulse with pulse-width modulation.), in its area or RMS value of the signal at a period.

articleTitle: Option of the bridge circuit based on the frequency-independent two-terminal network
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the option of balanced four-arm bridge circuits, built on the basis of frequency-independent two-terminal network (FITTN). The theoretical basis for the use of FITTN in balanced four-arm bridge circuits with pulse supply is the property of frequency-independent two-terminal networks. This property consists that after the end of transient the frequency-independent two-terminal network has the constant resistive resistance to electric current in case of influence of the next feeding pulse signal with tension change during its duration under the law of degrees functions of time when the fulfillment not all, and a certain part of the conditions of frequency independence. Consider balancing the bridge circuit is in turn impact on its diagonal generator of sequences of rectangular pulses and the fulfillment of the first balance condition , linearly changing shape and the fulfillment of the second balance condition when executing the first balance condition, cubic pulses and the fulfillment of the third balance condition (without disturbing execution of the first two conditions) and pulses the voltage of which varies according to the law of the fourth degree and fulfillment of all balance conditions. This bridge has the property of separate count, and allows you to identify the multi-element object of measurement that contains the primary transducers - resistive, capacitive and inductive sensors.

articleTitle: Modified multiscale discontinuous Galerkin method in the function space H(curl)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we propose the new modified multiscale discontinuous Galerkin method for solving harmonic electromagnetic problems. The computational scheme is based on the vector finite element method in function space H(curl), discontinuous Galerkin method and multiscale ideas. The numerical analysis of convergence and parallel realization scalability is performed. The proposed method is used for solving the direct electromagnetic problem in the computational domain with complex internal structure comprising randomly placed inclusions of various geometric shapes and sizes.

articleTitle: Noise models of nonrecursive digital filters with recursive lateral feedbacks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper noise models of nonrecursive digital filters (NDFs) with recursive lateral feedbacks (LFBs) have been presented. Models of four typical schemes of NDF with LFB which take into account quantization effects and rounding errors have been considered. For each scheme of NDF with LFB noise equations for noise dispersion at the output of each channel independent of analog to digital converters (ADC) and multipliers have been deduced. For each scheme of NDF with LFB implementation comparative analysis of noise models have been done.

articleTitle: Single-fiber optical transmission system with DWDM channels effect of four-wave mixing products
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Single-fiber optical transmission system (SFOTS) is offered, where the duplex is organized using dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM). The process of generating four-wave mixing products (FWM) occurring in optical fiber is modeled. The distribution of FWM products for the optical spectrum is investigated, as well as the number of products falling within the channel bandwidth.

articleTitle: The investigation of microstrip diplexer based on 2D electromagnetic crystal
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The structure of microwave diplexers based on two-dimensional (2D) electromagnetic crystals of various size has been theoretically and experimentally investigated. In the proposed devices with high-frequency selective properties two rows of microstrip quarter-wave resonators electromagnetically connected with each other and with the input of the strip conductor are used. This allows splitting the signal into two channels.

articleTitle: GPU implementation of iterative solver for linear systems obtained by FEM discretization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work describes the application of modern high-performance computing technologies such as multicore CPUs and GPUs coprocessors to the solution of three-dimensional (3D) problems of geoelectromagnetism with the use of the finite element method. The techniques for speeding up sparse linear system solving via iterative methods are discussed. Programs to solve large sparse complex-valued linear systems with the COCR method, Jacobi preconditioner and residual smoothing technique were developed and implemented for CPU and GPU devices. Jacobi preconditioner was optimized to increase performance with respect to default implementation from cuBLAS and cuSPARSE libraries on GPU. The developed programs were verified on the set of linear systems with large sparse matrices stored in CSR format that were obtained by solving the forward magnetotelluric problem with the finite element method. The comparison of parallelization has been done using both CPU and GPU devices. Our experiments with an NVIDIA Tesla C2075 and Intel i5-2500 show that, using of GPU, we can achieve an acceleration of up to 8 times compared to the single-threaded implementation on the CPU or up to 3.5 times compared to the multithreaded implementation with Intel MKL subroutines.

articleTitle: Synthesis and analysis of detection algorithm of distributed sources against background with distributed clutter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with an algorithm for detection of a broadband signal received from a multiple-unit source against the background with architecturally-like clutters that differ by location and additive space-uncorrelated noise. It is shown that the optimal detection algorithm represents the weight processing in the "ray space" of the transformed vector of observed data and does not demand access of any large matrix. A maximum likelihood ratio is chosen as the optimality criterion. After determining the inverse of the correlation function, expression for the optimal weight function is obtained. The design ratios for determination of detection characteristics under the Gaussian statistics of signals and clutters are given. The results confirm the property of the suggested algorithm: at low signal/noise ratios, efficiency of point targets detection is better, and at the large ratios the distributed targets are better detected.

articleTitle: LED lamp design optimizing on minimum non-uniformity of light intensity distribution in space
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The experiment to study the light intensity curve (LIC) of the LED lamp supporting structure with four LED emitting elements (LEEs) that are mounted in the glass bulb of a filament lamp with the E27 base is presented in the article. The LICs of the mass-produced supporting structure and the one developed in Tomsk state university of control systems and radioelectronics are compared.

articleTitle: Functional problems of audit at the present stage of his development
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Today decrease in a role of audit as factor of control of distortions of accounting reports as a result of unfair actions of the economic subject is noted. The main reasons of that are the followings: non-compliance with requirements of auditor standards; financial crisis; imperfection of methodology of audit regarding identification of distortions of financial statements as a result of unfair actions of the economic subject; objective impossibility of officially recognized audit of accounting reports to consider risks of informal shadow activity of economic subjects; inconsistency of institute of audit with the ordered activities of economic agents.

Author Keywords: laundering of the illegal income and financing of terrorism

articleTitle: Grouping of transmitter-receiver positions when using the direct solvers of finite element equation systems in induction logging problems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to investigating the possibilities to increase the computational efficiency of the finite element (FE) 3D-modeling of electromagnetic fields in solving the induction logging problems. In order to perform the FE approximation, the non-structured optimized meshes with local refinements are used. It is suggested to apply the direct solvers for FE linear algebraic equation systems (SLAE) and the same mesh for approximation for several neighboring positions of a logging tool at the trajectory, i.e. to perform the grouping of positions. This allows us to perform the most time-consuming operation - SLAE matrix decomposition - only once for a group. The paper considers the problem of optimizing the grouping of transmitter-receiver positions in computing on multi-core PCs. The mathematical model for computing the electromagnetic field induced by arbitrary oriented induction coil is presented. For the geoelectrical model, which is typical of the induction logging problems, computational costs required for different grouping variants are compared. The comparison is presented for the different number of parallel threads. The performed investigations show that the grouping of transmitter-receiver positions for the typical induction logging trajectory makes it possible to significantly (by an order or more) decrease the computational costs required to calculating the 3D electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: Russian sign language machine interpreter system based on the analyses of syntax and semantic construction
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the existing systems of translation into sign language are analyzed. There are ViSiCAST project, Zardoz system, ASL Workbench, TEAM system. Their strengths and weaknesses are identified. A new translation way based on a comparison of syntactic constructions is described. Sentences in sounding language often describe complex situations, including some simple situations (for example, a few actions). The unit, which is processed about, is a proposal for a full participle. As a result of comparison of syntactic constructions is obtained a set of simple sentences in which all participles replace verb. A corresponding library to determine the syntax construction is developed. A new method for constructing a semantic unit of the computer system of sign language is proposed. The result of semantic analysis system is a list of correspondence “word-gesture”. Among the many alternatives of words based on semantic analysis algorithm, every word is assigned a unique lexical meaning. For simple sentences algorithms of semantic analysis are designed and implemented. The most priority directions of modification module semantic analysis may include the following: broadening the base of gesture, the implementation of parsing complex sentences, taking into account specifics of the Russian-language.

articleTitle: Design of active and reactive power flows flexible regulation devices for the effective integration of wind power into the grid
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In recent years, the relevance of renewable energy has increased as never before. This fact is confirmed by the current environmental, social, political situations in the world. However, their integration into the grid creates a number of problems that require attention. This is mainly caused by a drop in voltage, frequency and power quality deterioration. But the using of flexible power transmission devices (FACTS), such as STATCOM can not only cope with this problem, but also increase the line capacity, as well as improve the performance of the power system as a whole. In this connection, we propose a model of static reactive power compensator based on the Z matrix to identify the required level of reactive power compensation depending on the load.

articleTitle: Methods of expanding the bandwidth of multicascade microwave attenuators
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents methods of increasing the bandwidth. The attenuator is designed as a matched structures based on the planar film resistors. Achieved a significant expansion of bandwidth at a specified input microwave power due to selecting of each stage of transmission factors, providing the same amount of power dissipation.

articleTitle: Laboratory course on navigation and motion control of the mobile robot with the differential drive of wheels
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes the laboratory bench, structure and the contains of the laboratory course, intended for study of principal components of the robotic platform NI Robotics Starter Kit 2.0 with the differential drive of wheels, the basic principles, and also design tools and system of navigation and motion control of the mobile robot.

articleTitle: Weak magnetic field detectors based on Hall-effect sensors
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper reports the results of experimental investigation of magnetic field detectors based on GaAs Hall-effect sensors with magnetic flux concentrators. The detection of magnetic field with flux density of tens and hundreds nT is shown to be possible. Thereafter the methods for further increase of detectors' magnetic sensitivity are discussed.

articleTitle: Matched band-pass UHF filter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The band-pass filter is considered. The filter has wide pass band and good matching not only in the pass band but also in the rejection band. The filter has steep band edges. The filtration quality of the filter corresponds to the quality of a bridge filter.

articleTitle: Study of the effectiveness of curved finite elements on the example of solving a magnetostatic problem
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work studies the effectiveness of using curved finite elements in finite element modeling. The study was made on the example of solving a magnetostatic problem by means of a finite element method stated using two scalar potentials. As a rule, in applied problems researchers have to work on a computational domain with curved boundary. If finite elements with only rectilinear boundaries are used, the order of solution approximation with increase in the order of basis functions will be limited by the approximation order of the curved boundary. The work offers a short review of the object domain: description of a mathematical model of a magnetostatic problem stated using two scalar potentials; covers a problem of calculation evaluation of a potential break; examines approaches to increasing the order of finite elements. The work solves a problem of finite element modeling using basis functions of various orders on rectilinear and curved finite elements and shows how an increase of the order of finite elements affects the accuracy of the obtained solution and the convergence order of the method.

articleTitle: Use of impedance analysis of peripheral blood composition for hemopoiesis stimulation by a magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The impedance analysis method makes it possible to operatively discover changes in the peripheral blood composition during hemopoiesis stimulation including anemia provoked by various diseases or chemotherapy in case of treating oncological diseases. The suggested method also provides a control over indirect blood composition assessment during affecting the organism hematopoietic function with a magnetic field. Invasive test results are used to provide correlation with real values of the blood components.

articleTitle: Reduced thermal injuries bio-tissue during surgery with the use of electrosurgical devices
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A system for measuring the speed of movement of the active electrode electrosurgical apparatus using three passive electrodes was developed. On its basis, a system to control the output power of the device based on the measured speed, designed to minimize thermal damage to tissues during electrosurgical exposure.

articleTitle: Automated estimation of quality indicators of passenger and cargo transportation services
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Ensuring the safety and comfort of the environment is one of the most urgent problems of modern science is the subject of this article. The solution to this problem is based on the use of modern technologies for monitoring objects that affect the properties. This approach implements the concept of integrated monitoring objects based on their information phenomenological models. It is shown that the choice as a main indicator for monitoring the so-called “information entropy” to successfully assess the current state of complex objects and systems. The specifics of the objects is taken into account by selecting the monitoring set of parameters that are correlated with the information entropy of the system as a whole and its individual components. For example, the transport system shows how to select and measure the selected parameters to determine cyclical measurements and perform the mathematical processing of the results. The proposed solution can be used for other complex systems, that include engineering, socioeconomic, biological and other components.

articleTitle: A technology of full seismic field simulation on high-performance computing systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The aim of work is developing the technology representing a complex approach for studding geophysical objects with complex subsurface geometry on the basis of numerical modeling of seismic filed from point sources. An important stage of successful solution of dynamic problem of the theory of elasticity is to develop the model representing the object under study in details and carrying out a series of calculations of elastic wave propagation in inhomogeneous media. We present a programs software for solving the forward geophysical tasks using grid methods. Particular attention is paid to the software interface that allows you to carry out the preparation of geophysical models for theoretical experiments. The developing software for simulation is designed for usage on modern high-performance computing systems. Information and analytical set of programs can be used in the interpretation of experimental data, in design and verification of 2D and 2.5D models when compare experimental and theoretical results. Studying the structure of the Baikal rift zone is one of the geophysical tasks where 2D modeling is necessary. This work was partially supported by RFBR grants No. 16-07-01052, 15-31-20150, 15-07-06821, 14-05-00867, 14-07-00312, MES RK 1760/GF4.

articleTitle: The investigation of filters with wide stop band, based on electromagnetic crystals of microstrip resonators 2D disposition
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There were introduced the brand new constructions of the bandpass filters on the basis of the electromagnetic crystal of the 2D disposition of the microstrip resonators with the rolled up strip conductors portions that have common earthing on the base. In this case, while changing the disposition of such co-directional or counter-dimensional resonators in the space the different electromagnetic coupling between them can be implemented, both primary inductive one and primary capacitive one. Thereby the circulating wave resonances can be avoided in the 2D microstrip structures, the sequential one to another resonator signal transmission is needed. This allows to construct different orders filters of high frequency-selective properties: widened high-frequency stop band 3.3ƒ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, measured by the −30 dB level, the power suppression in the low-frequency stop band more than 100 dB and bandpass steep slopes. The comparison of experimental measurements received on the fourth order filter with passband width Δƒ/ƒ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> ≈ 16% with the results modeled by the electrodynamic numerical analysis of 3D models shows the good consent.

articleTitle: Analysis of high-precision microwave used by calibration of meters parameters transfer in coaxial tract
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper seeks an analysis of high-precisions standards of the microwave used by calibration of meters parameters transfer in coaxial paths, and methods for their calibration.

articleTitle: Jig-sensitive optical detectors based on semiconductor films with anomalous photovoltage
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The photoelectrical properties of anomalous photovoltaic (APV) CdTe, CdTe:Ag films have been investigated. For the first time it was established that if the back side of the film is put on a silver-plated substrate, the APV effect in such film increases to 30%. On the basis of these films the self-contained optical radiation receivers and photoelectronic transformers for sensitive control of coordinates of moving objects have been developed. In coordinate-sensitive photogenerators on a basis cadmium telluride films it is possible to develop the coordinate-sensitive independent receiver of optical radiation. The entrance signal contains the information on a direction and size of displacement of radiating object. On the basis of such films the coordinate-sensitive independent receiver of optical radiation “КЧП-1M” was made.

Author Keywords: coordinate-sensitive independent receiver of optical radiation

articleTitle: A receive linear array beamforming using Spatially Variant Apodization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We present a novel beamformer for a receive linear array based on Spatially Variant Apodization. This technique reduces the side-lobe level compared with a uniform linear array, at the same time keeping the main lobe beam-width. For example, the side-lobe level of a 128-element linear array would be better than −30 dB in the presence of phase and amplitude errors based on the proposed technique (5.8 degrees r.m.s. and 0.5 dB r.m.s. respectively).

articleTitle: Investigation of a human organism systemic response to local heating with the use of FPA-based infrared thermography
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Focal plane array (FPA)-based infrared thermography (IRT) method was used in dynamic regime to investigate the human organism systemic reaction developed in response to a dry heat transient application to a part of body (forearm). The used infrared camera high performance (100 fps) and high temperature sensitivity (of the order of 0.01 °C) enabled high-precision measurement not only of the extremities thermal response but also the external breathing characteristics by means of the sorption-enhanced IRT original approach. In the course of the forearm heating, both an increase in breathing rate and synchronous paradoxic decrease in both arms temperature were revealed.

Author Keywords: high-resolution focal plane array (FPA)-based infrared thermography (IRT)

articleTitle: Regional problems of environmental protection activities in energy companies
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the results of environmental protection activities are presented. Estimation of data from some energy companies of Zabaykalsky Krai was made using cost based method. It has shown a significant impact of energy production on the atmosphere in this area. Estimation was made using universal cost parameters of economic damage and payments for the negative impact. The calculation of economic damage was made according to "Methodology for determining of the prevented environmental damage". The value of payment for the negative impact was calculated with usage of regulatory fees according to "Regulatory fees for emissions of air pollutants from stationary sources". Rosstat and the governmental statistics on the environmental protection were used as data sources for the information about some of energetic companies in Zabaikalsky Krai. It is revealed that payments are much lower than the economical cost of damage. And also, despite the payments have been included into cost of production, the companies have no motivation to the wide-scale conservation yet.

articleTitle: Calculation of capacitance for planar capacitors
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method for calculation of the capacitance is considered for capacitors with rectangular and circular cross-section. The method is simple and has high accuracy. The method utilizes known formulae for micro-strip line segment wave resistance, effective dielectric permittivity, effective width and length of the micro-strip line segment. Results of capacitance calculation for the plane capacitor with circular cross-section are compared with results obtained by finite element method.

articleTitle: Development of the University Platform “My NSTU”
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article, we've described the architecture of the cloud platform <;<;My NSTU>>, that provides efficient cooperation of students and teachers with information resources of the university. There is the scheme of the organization of server mirroring. We've considered the examples of the mobile application interface.

articleTitle: Mobile laboratory equipment for physics practicum
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to the reduced number of hours dedicated to General Physics within the undergraduate program, there is an evident need for new approaches to teaching the basics of physics. Authors formulated requirements for and developed a fundamentally new set of educational laboratory equipment. The emphasis is placed on analyzing the results of experiments, as opposed to the methodology and process of experimentation. Lab execution times are minimized. Equipment pieces are autonomous, mobile, do not require premises setup and are highly damage-resistant. Some equipment can be used for experiments related to different sections within the General Physics course.

articleTitle: Sensors of rotor phase currents and load determination unit of asynchronous drive of harmonic rotation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the development phase of rotary sensors and current detection unit loading of the engine system with respect to the agreed rotation of asynchronous motors. The use of current sensors and the block allows you to create multi-engined loading of asynchronous electric-phase synchronous rotation with increased synchronization capability.

Author Keywords: electric operating shaft unit determines the loading of the agreed rotation
the angles of the error position of the rotor

articleTitle: Verification of pressure sensor with optical spatial modulation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper results of pressure sensor with optical spatial modulation research are presented. The simulation of photoelectric and optomechanical parts comprising of sensor assembly was carried out. The transforming characteristics of sensor samples with membranes of 39 and 78.5 µn thick were investigated and corresponding sensitivities were received. The transforming characteristics dependence on temperature was researched. Low temperature dependence of photoelectric pressure sensor was experimentally shown.

articleTitle: The spherical and aspheric surfaces lens collimators: The aperture and aberration features
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The aperture and aberration features of the lens collimators with the spherical and aspheric-surfaces are considered.

articleTitle: Strategic development guidelines for high-technology companies
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is aimed at revealing new strategic orientations, specifics of strategic behavior and factors of successful development of high-tech companies at the modern stage of development. The analysis of the Russian and foreign sources as well as internal information of the Russian companies has allowed us to conclude that foresight, the ability to “feel” the prospects of technological trajectories, flexibility to adopt to new challenges of external environment, the will to win and efficient and skillful management of growing profitability are the key factors of business success in the sphere of high technologies. Essential guidelines of such business include the development of technological platforms, establishment of uniform consumption standards and, on this basis, creation of business ecosystems, active management of partnership, world market orientation and creation of recognized world brands.

articleTitle: Experimental holography in course of General Physics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problems in the study of holography in the course of General Physics. Here are shown the principles of the course “Holography and its applications”. Examples researches on holographic topics.

articleTitle: Transport properties of a microwave photon in a system with two artificial atoms
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we show a transport characteristic for a system, containing two distanced resonators with artificial atoms inside. The artificial atoms can be realized as superconducting quantum bits performing two level system properties. A fully quantum-mechanical approach is used. We have numerically simulated a transmission through the system with weak and strong couplings. The criteria to observe wavefunction interferences at amplitude-frequency responses was found.

articleTitle: Using the event calculus for modelling an operator of a simulator complex
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes how to create intellectual agent capable to provide training on the simulator complexes. The possibility of using the event calculus for the creation of such agents is shown. An example of constructing a model of the agent on the example of an agent of a braking position for the training simulator complex for marshalling yard is provided.

articleTitle: The effect of electrodes non-parallelism on micromechanical capacitors parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses the results of theoretical and experimental investigations of the functioning of two-electrode MEMS capacitors with changing interelectrode gap at non-parallel displacement of the electrodes. The measuring technique and experimental data on changes in the variable capacitor capacitance at non-parallel displacement of electrodes are presented. The experiments were performed both on the specially constructed capacitor model allowing to register the parameters of a mutual displacement of electrodes with changing inclination angle of the electrodes over a wide range, and on the variable micromechanical capacitors fabricated of (100) Si using IC technology.

articleTitle: Methods for digitizing weak signals much less the LSB level
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In contemporary software definer radiodevices (SDR), processing of signals is carried out in a digital kind, since entrance cascades of a high-frequency path. The contradiction between very small (by level) analog signals and large value of the least significant bit (LSB) is removed by addition of the vobulation noise. The size and a kind of distribution of this noise essentially influence quality of reception in the whole. In the article, means of the MATLAB system are used to, research of opportunities of numbering of signals, which level much is less than the minimal category of quantization. The empirical expressions for calculation of potential characteristics of transformation of weak signals in ADC are received. It is shown that at the offered numbering there are no combinational handicapes. Results of experimental confirmation of adequacy for models of digital reception of weak signals are obtained.

articleTitle: The interaction interface for the distributed computing system's nodes
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article considers up-to-date problems of parallel computing systems development in Russia. The study describes an engineering of an interface for organization of high-performance system with programmable structure and for its partition to specific subsystems focused on applied tasks. The solution is based on the concept of homogeneous computing systems (HCS) relying on the model of collective of calculators. HCS concept was formulated in the Institute of Mathematics of the USSR under the leadership of E.V. Evreinov in 1962 [1]. The approach is particularly relevant in terms of growing popularity of information networks which combining numerous personal computers (PCs). It's obviously necessary to develop software tools to integrate disparate calculators into the system and identify the required number of sub-systems for specific problem solving. An interference into the hardware and software parts of the calculators must be avoided during the software development process. Programmable structure of the computer system is provided at the stage of unification of calculators into software subsystem interface called an agent of DCS PS. The experience of the development of the Interface organization of distributed computing systems with programmable structure and allocation of subsystems for specific applications. The software described in the present document has been tested while an experimental organization of the DCS PS at the department of the computer engineering of NSTU.

articleTitle: Neural network application for assessment of the asynchronous motors energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the estimation of the asynchronous motors power consumption using the neural networks. As asynchronous motors with squirrel-cage rotor are the largest part of the industrial enterprises load, the change of their power consumption at the voltage deviations can affect the operating modes of the enterprise power supply system and other electrical receivers. Application of neural networks allows to determine the non-linear regularities in noisy heterogeneous data, provides valid calculations results in a large number of input parameters. At presence of input data for network training the created neural network helps simply enough to find the power consumption of an asynchronous motor at electric network voltage deviations from the nominal value in a wide range of voltages, load factor changes, and also if it is necessary of other data initial.

articleTitle: Abnormal blocking of the fundamental guided wave in a silicon waveguide by weak tunnel coupling with periodic polymer strips
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We examine the optical wave propagation in a single-mode silicon wire waveguide which is coupled by the evanescent field with the multiple periodic strips (segmented waveguide) separated from it by a silica buffer. The numerical modeling by the method of lines (MoL) and by finite different time domain (FDTD) method proves that the weak reflectors with period 1.6 μm may produce a strong of the transmitting optical wave suppression (blocking) by resonant interaction of a guided mode in the silicon wire with a strong decaying optical leaky mode of the artificial segmented waveguide localized in the fully etched polymer grating placed 300 nm above the silicon wire. This effect is important for studying photonic structures with multiple weak tunnel reflections and could be used for the construction of notch filters with negligible parasitic back reflection.

articleTitle: Methods for improving parameters of power consumption and received data reliability in wireless mobile ECG monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To reduce the volume of transmitted data, we propose to use the characteristics of cycle codes at the protocol of data transmission with the help of asynchronous transceiver that lets refuse the start marker and the counter giving the length of the transmitted package. We considered the peculiarities the adaptive forming of training set for the revealing distorted of areas in electrocardiogram with help of support vector machine.

Author Keywords: mobile monitoring of cardio-vascular system of man

articleTitle: Development of direct methods of calculation of energy factors of nonsinusoidal current networks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the first part of the article the procedure of geometrization of results of the differential equations algebraization is constructed, which is used in direct methods of calculation of energy factors of nonlinear consumers. It is established, that the algebraic equations for square-law norms of decisions of the differential equations of n th order are the equations ellipsoid the n+1 order. In the second part of article on the basis of direct methods the analytical method of calculation of degree of distortion of the general current of a network is developed by separate nonlinear consumers. The method can be used both for calculation and for measurement. Today no national and international standards on quality of a current of consumers of these factors are considered.

Author Keywords: Norms of decisions of the differential equations
factor of harmonics of a current

articleTitle: Simulation of phased array in THz region
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article we made analysis of programs for simulation phased array in terahertz frequency range. We presented simulation of THz two slot antenna with extended hemispherical lens for 497 GHz and 4×4 phased array which were based on this antennas by chosen packages.

articleTitle: Software for finite element analysis of stress-raisers in composite laminates
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes the method and software which allows the user to calculate quite fast and accurately the stress-strain behavior of composite materials including several stress-raisers. The computational schemes are based on the finite element method (FEM) with the use of meshes with quadrangular prism cells. The software provides the automatical meshing with an arbitrary number of stress-raisers in the form of cylindrical holes with countersinks. In order to refine stress values, the specific procedures of solution smoothing are used. The software does not use homogenization procedures. This makes it possible to perform the lamina analysis of longitudinal (along the reinforcing fibers) and transversal stresses. In order to reduce labor costs, the convenient parametrization of the investigated structures and tools for controlling the FE meshes are proposed. The paper shows the numerical results of stress-strain behavior calculations obtained for sixteen-ply composite laminate with one and three stress-raisers with countersinks. The calculation time does not exceed 15 s for one stress-raiser and 1 min for three stress-raisers. The calculation error in stresses does not exceed 4%. This allows avoiding the simplified calculation schemes that limit the variety of design solutions.

articleTitle: Elements of data mining for the development of mathematical transport models
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Issues of estimating transport origin-destination (OD) flows in terms of transport systems modelling with the utility of elements of the data mining are considered. Methods of extracting hidden patterns of origin-destination flows of the population based on the mobile operator's data are provided. The hypothesis of a model type describing a subscriber belonging to some specific population stratum is checked based on proxy factors in the form of a decision tree and subscriber's stratification is conducted. An iterative algorithm for constructing origin-destination matrices using methods of regression analysis is provided based on the knowledge obtained. The comparison of preference functions of the gravity model of the origin-destination matrix estimation is conducted. An investigation of origin-destination flows calculation method is carried out in the transport model of Novosibirsk city.

articleTitle: Experimental studies of metrological performance of SIM-6 sulphur analyzer
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the results obtained in experimental studies of metrological performance of SIM-6 sulphur analyzers.

articleTitle: Definition of MIMO technology noise immunity by correlated channels
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the method of determining receiving noise immunity for MIMO and MISO technologies. The method is based on the use of matrix eigenvalues of multiple correlation in the case of propagating a multi-path signal.

articleTitle: Connection requests service providing various availability coefficients values at different time intervals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes the analysis of methods of providing differentiated resiliency. The gain in cost due to the use of a differentiated approach is evaluated.

articleTitle: Recursive method of extracting the harmonic signal from a mixture with strong noise: Limitations and the non-uniqueness
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of harmonic signal allocation from a mixture with strong noise is considered. A recursive method for computing correlation functions is analyzed. Theoretical background the efficiency of the method is given. Assumptions about the method constraints and the uniqueness of results are expressed. They verified with the help of specially developed methods and computer simulation.

articleTitle: On fundamentals of nonlinear theory for semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Fundamentals of the nonlinear theory of Fabry-Perot semiconductor lasers have been developed, an integral part of which is the natural linewidth theory. The formula for gain depending on the energy flux specifies the basic nonlinear effect in a laser. Necessary conditions for stimulated emission of the first and second kind are presented. Maxwell's equations in the gain medium are used to obtain equations for energy flux and for non-linear phase effect description. Based on the nonlinear theory, a number of experiments have been simulated to suggest that the developed nonlinear theory is a new paradigm of the laser theory. The nonlinear theory has provided recommendations for the development of lasers with improved properties, such as lasers with increased power and lasers with reduced natural linewidth.

articleTitle: Block design of robust control via sigma-functions
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of stabilizing with a given accuracy for output variables of SISO and MIMO nonlinear systems. A mathematical model of the control plant is represented in block form “input-output” and contains unmatched external disturbances and parametric uncertainties. Within the block approach, decomposition procedures of synthesis of robust control are designed under the uncertainty of the input channels of fictitious and real controls. Using S-shaped, smooth and bounded sigma-functions in local feedbacks allowed us to consider restrictions on state variables at the synthesis stage. For block synthesis of MIMO systems with undetermined and non-singular matrices before fictitious and real control actions, the ideology of the control hierarchy method has been used for calculating lower bounds of amplitudes of sigmoidal controls, ensuring the convergence of the state variables in the defined regions. This approach extends the class of invariant systems by nonlinear systems with non-smooth disturbances, where special requirements for the composition of the state variables in each block are missing.

articleTitle: The simulation system and research of functions of random variables
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The questions of research of the distribution laws of one-dimensional functions of a set of independent random variables are considered. The subsystem that allow for implementing the imitation modeling of different functions of a set of independent random variables and investigating these distribution laws is implemented. System capabilities illustrated the efficiency of this method is demonstrated in set of examples.

articleTitle: Research of the amplitude-phase conversion impact on the 16-APSK signal noise immunity
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper represents a study of the nonlinear amplitude-phase conversion impact on the M-APSK signal distortion. M-APSK signals are widely used in the satellite communication systems, including broadcasting systems such as DVB-S2. The investigation done in this paper is aimed towards DVB-S2 standardized 16-APSK modulation scheme (4+12 constellation) and focuses on the impact of satellite high power amplifier amplitude-to-phase characteristic nonlinearity on the signal noise immunity. The Saleh model has been used as a nonlinearity model. We considered the possibility of M-APSK signals receiving under different conditions. As a result, we developed a technique of searching for an optimal operating mode of power amplifier in which a fixed error probability value is ensured by the minimum signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Substrate permittivity impact to branch-line couplers miniaturization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to fast development and complication of microwave radio technical devices, new miniaturization approaching are appearing. Compact devices should have comparable characteristics to standard constructions. In this paper the impact of substrate permittivity are observed, in the case of miniaturization problem for micro-strip branch-line coupler. Process on miniaturization initializing with fast and simple method, based on using low-pass filter with the same phase shift that appears for measurement cut of micro-strip. Numerical simulation was produced for branch-line couplers constructions with permittivity 2.48, 4.4, 6.15, 7.2 for frequency equal 2000 MHz, as the result the frequencies characteristics was obtained. Suggested way of miniaturization allow to decrease geometrical sizes of devices on 66.6, 68.5, 69.5, 66.3% respectively with comparison to standard constructions.

articleTitle: Controllable converters for high-speed railways traction transformers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes the proposed structure of the power converter for traction transformers with even phase number not multiple of three. The converter gives low current and voltage unbalance factor at the transformer primary side. The transformer plus converter control algorithm was simulated in Matlab Simulink.

articleTitle: Elements of data mining for the development of mathematical transport models
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Issues of estimating transport origin-destination (OD) flows in terms of transport systems modelling with the utility of elements of the data mining are considered. Methods of extracting hidden patterns of origin-destination flows of the population based on the mobile operator's data are provided. articleTitle: The optimization of drilling conditions by using accelerated life model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we have constructed the parametric accelerated failure time model for the reliability of a drilling tool basing on the results of drill reliability experiment. The second-order polynomial model was considered as the covariate function, and the baseline reliability function was taken from the family of Weibull distributions. The goodness-of-fit of the model was tested with the Kolmogorov, Cramer-von Mises-Smirnov and Anderson-Darling type tests by the sample of residuals. Using the constructed model, we have found the optimal cutting conditions (the feed rate and the rotational speed), which minimize the economical costs. Moreover, the failure-free operation times have been calculated for various probabilities under obtained optimal cutting conditions.

articleTitle: The theory of invariant communication systems and the prospect of its development
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the concept of invariant and invariant systems of communication, the role of the theory of transformation groups in the development of invariant systems, classification of invariant communication systems from the standpoint of transformation groups theory, problems and prospects of their development.

Author Keywords: the group of transformations of a communication channel

articleTitle: Achieving of reliable multi-gigabit data delivery in presence of multiple receivers with P2M
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper gives an overview of P2M protocol - a solution for distribution of massive data sets across multiple destinations in IP network. Paper describes main challenges in designing of high-speed data transport solutions and provides solutions for some of them. P2M was tested in a network of Future Internet Lab Anhalt in order to identify maximal practical limit of data rate per receiver. Tests results are presented in this paper. Research basis for this paper was conducted earlier in [1] and [2].

articleTitle: Planar antenna array for 3G wireless communications
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents an antenna array for the third generation (3G) mobile communication. A numerical simulation results of the proposed antenna system in frequency band 1900 - 2200 MHz are obtained together with the relevant parameters. Array consists of four radiating elements of the same type, forming by truncated ellipses.
