Created an experimental model of proving the efficiency of the device that shows a number of advantages over similar products.

articleTitle: The diode laser for Rb standard with the cavity coordinated to modulation frequency
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The spectrum of the diode laser radiation at a wavelength of 795 nm with a microwave pump modulation current have been studied. The resonance dependence of the amplitude of the side band due to the microwave frequency was registered. The half-width of observing resonance was 0.02 GHz.

articleTitle: Step-by-step method with phase shift is-use changes in the intensity of interfering beams
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We consider the theoretical background to the justification of new approaches to obtaining and analysis, interferograms. The proposed approach is based on a combination of methods for the analysis of interferograms obtained by the intensity change of the interfering beams and the phase shift.

articleTitle: An approach for estimation of integrated reliability indices and maintenance intervals of fiber-optic communication lines
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research paper is devoted to the analysis of the strain impact on the reliability of optic-fiber communication lines. The main reasons of strain appearance in optical fiber and its ranges are presented with the confirmation of a necessity to consider this factor in reliability calculations and maintenance procedures planning. Analytical and simulation models, taking into account the factor of strain, are proposed for the estimation of the integrated reliability indices of fiber-optic lines. The results of the numerical experiments, implemented using the models, showed the influence of the strain effect on the fiber-optic lines reliability. Moreover, the obtained estimations of the reliability indices allow determination of the recommended preventive maintenance intervals of fiber-optic communication lines for the purpose of the improvement of their operational efficiency.

articleTitle: An investigation of statistical properties of parameter estimates of distributions on interval data
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper discusses the issues of estimation of distribution parameters on interval data. It has to deal with interval data samples in situations when the exact value of the observation is unknown, only to the range to which the value belongs is known. In general, these intervals are different for each case and may intersect. The maximum likelihood method can be used for estimating the distribution parameters. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the statistical properties of maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) on interval data. The research was conducted in comparison with the estimates of the distribution parameters on point samples of observation interval midpoints.

articleTitle: Local extrema stream maximization by data intensity fusion
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers fusion of data streams of different nature which are describing properties of the same layered medium. It has been shown that combining these streams gives the fused stream with high intensity at the bound between layers. The simulation has shown that histogram of the fused stream have noticeable threshold between low and high intensity. The simulation has also approved that the threshold filtration allows to find bounds between layers with the error no more than 300 m.

articleTitle: Measurement and statistical analysis of indoor MIMO radio channel parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper addresses wireless MIMO channel sounding method, based on time domain cross correlation principle. Measurement were conducted in indoor laboratory environment at central frequency 2.3 GHz with measurement bandwidth 100 MHz, 4 transmit and 4 receive antennas are used. Obtained impulse responses are presented and used for channel parameters estimation. Full channel correlation matrix and its eigenvalue decomposition are calculated, showing significant spatial correlation. For statistical analysis maximum likelihood estimation of distribution of channel coefficients and goodness of fit tests are numerically computed. Correlated channel capacity compared with uncorrelated channel is presented.

articleTitle: Bridge Sircuits with Pulse Power to Determin the Sensor Parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Considered electric bridge circuits, allowing to receive separate dependent balancing by grounded adjustable components only.

articleTitle: Modeling of achievement of the reference situation in the conditions of uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is concerned the approach modeling a possibility of global purpose (a reference situation) achievement in the conditions of uncertainty for some organizational system is offered. The system is described by situational model. The problem is formulated on the basis of synthesis of concepts of the control theory and decision-making, the theory of fuzzy sets and the fuzzy logic, the theory of hierarchical multilevel systems and utility theory. The given concept expands possibilities of the account uncertainty the various nature. Two ways of the description of signs in reference situations by fuzzy numbers and fuzzy intervals are presented in the article. Application of the second way by means of which two typical tasks are solved is proved. The offered approach allows to consider interaction of subsystems at the different levels of hierarchy and considers dynamics of changes of force of influence and background of process.

articleTitle: Finite element 3D-modeling of magnetotelluric field for a set of harmonics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with three-dimensional modeling of magnetotelluric field using vector finite element method. The comparison of the computational efficiency of different preconditioners is carried out and an approach is proposed to the choice of the initial guess for solving the finite element systems of equations obtained for a set of harmonics over a broad frequency range.

articleTitle: About one structure of the autonomous research robot
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the structure and operation algorithms of research robotic complex consisting of the basic mobile platform moving along the surface and a miniature unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). With proper distribution of the base's and UAV's functions it is possible to increase the size of the area surveyed to constructing the route, and, thus, to minimize the probability of inefficient motion planning, to reduce energy consumption and to increase the time of useful functioning.

articleTitle: Metrological equipment featuring variation automatic frequency control
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method of automatic frequency control via second derivative of informative parameter. Variant of construction of metrologic equipment featuring higher precision, performance and noise stability.

articleTitle: Basic principles of development of the control panel of hump complex simulator
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses the internal and external requirements related to control panel for hump complex simulator, and methods for their implementation. The architecture of distributed microprocessor system of the panels control, the algorithms of its functioning and basic specifications are described.

articleTitle: Multithreshold robastny methods of increase of reliability of detection of sources of radio signals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In work problems of detection of sources of radio signals in rooms of room type against various hindrances as are regular also noise, and powerful pulse are considered. Robastnymulti-threshold approach for increase of detection of informative signals is offered. Problems of the choice of quantity and values of these thresholds are discussed. Specifics of application of this approach for a case of detection of broadband signals are noted.

Author Keywords: errors of the first and second sort

articleTitle: Prospects of the development of firmware complex AKTOMIKA
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The authors have developed a software component of firmware complex “AKTOMIKA” intended for processing of satellite images with meteorological other purposes. The paper discusses the achievements and prospects of development of the current system. It presents illustrations showing the results of the system working.

articleTitle: Digital displacement transducer with a three-phase interpolator in the fine reading channel
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes structural principles and generic mathematical model of the fine reading channel based on interpolation of a three-phase indication system. The device is intended for using as a part of two-speed displacement transducers. Implementation of the device can simplify the optical arrangement of the transducer with the same informative capacity.

articleTitle: Investigation of irregular microstrip resonators and wideband filters based on them
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New multimode irregular microstrip resonators and designs of wideband bandpass filters based on them are being theoretically and experimentally investigated. A central multimode resonator electromagnetically connected with single-mode or two-mode resonators at the input and output of a structure are used in the developed filters. It is the first experience giving the possibility of combining inherent frequencies up to six lowest modes of oscillations, which are involved in the formation of the bandpass of the multimode resonator. Strong interaction of oscillations modes leads to its significant extension.

articleTitle: Specification of electric power systems in ISMA simulation environment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents methods for symbolic and graphic model specification of electric power systems (EPS). The methodology of hybrid systems is proposed for describing the transient electromagnetic and electromechanical processes in EPS. The behavior of hybrid models studies in the instrumental environment ISMA developed by the authors. The offered ISMA architecture includes lots of input languages and common tools for internal representation and research of program models to unify the mathematical and program software of HS with new applications. Examples of EPS specification are presented in text and graphic form. Textual specification is fully consistent with the mathematical notation and can be used for experiments with different models of network elements. Graphical specification convenient for specialists in the field of electricity when the network configuration of the circuit is frequently changing. It should be noted that ISMA has tools for translation from graphical to textual model. Thus, it is possible to verify the program models.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of a solid deformation under the action of an external and internal pressure
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Today, the mathematical modeling of the solids deformation is of great interest due to the development of new materials. In this paper we consider the extended finite element method (XFEM) to simulate the elastic deformation of three-dimensional objects with the complex internal structure. We obtained that the XFEM solutions are in the good agreement with the results of the classical finite element method. However, the XFEM allows us to solve interface move problems without any remeshing.

articleTitle: Risk monitoring of the activity in the verification laboratory
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article reviews issues of the event probability including monitoring of the laboratory activity against accreditation criteria of national system of accreditation for resolving problem of laboratory condition including requirements for assurance of measurement' uniformity.

articleTitle: Statistical processing algorithms of signals at ultrasound distance measurement
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Statistical model of measuring signals in systems of time domain reflectometry was proposed. On the basis of this reflectometry the estimates of reflected signal parameters were obtained by means of complete sufficient statistics. Simulation modeling, which confirmed the consistency and efficiency of the estimates, was conducted. Based on the principle of unbiasedness the synthesis of uniformly most powerful unbiased detection algorithm of change in slope parameter of linearly-varying measuring signal was carried out. Simulation modeling has indicated the efficiency of the algorithm and expediency of its application to detect small changes in the measuring signal parameters of time domain reflectometry systems.

articleTitle: Comparison of approaches and the software for 3D finite element modeling of harmonic electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of the finite element 3D-modeling of the time-harmonic electromagnetic fields excited by a wire loop. We compare the computational efficiency of two approaches to the finite element (FE) approximation when solving the induction logging problems. These approaches are based on different mathematical models and mesh generation algorithms. They use different types of finite elements and different solvers of FE systems. The first approach is implemented in the Helmholtz3D software and based on the solution of the vector Helmholtz equation without extracting the 1D background medium field. The second approach is implemented in the LogEM-FD software and based on performing the FE approximation of the mathematical model with extracting the 1D background medium field. The LogEM-FD software implements special algorithms of mesh generation with local refinements and deletion of «unnecessary» nodes and the possibilities to use finite elements with terminal («handing») nodes. The research conducted shows that high accuracy of the numerical solution of the induction logging problem has been achieved when both Helmholtz3D and LogEM-FD software packages are used. However, the computational costs required for the Helmholtz3D are significantly higher than those required for the LogEM-FD to obtain equally accurate solutions.

articleTitle: The algorithm of primary responses selection for TDR analysis of multilayer liquids
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The principle of parasitic responses appearance is discussed. It is demonstrated that the ambiguousness of multiple liquids determination occurs in conjunction with the presence of parasitic responses. An algorithm of primary responses selection in the background of high-order responses is developed.

articleTitle: Features of autodynes taking into consideration the noise of a power supply
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The mathematical model of an autodyne, under the influence of its own microwave radiation reflected from the object, microwave oscillator internal noise and power supply fluctuations are given. Calculations of signal and noise characteristics as a functions of the reflected radiation time delay are executed. Results of analysis are confirmed by the experiments performed on the 8-mm band Gunn diode oscillator.

articleTitle: Identification methods of the communication channel
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Communication channel identification methods by impulse response based on voice frequency transmission circuit is analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Synthesis of invariant transceiver of first order and its results
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the structures of invariant transceivers; the test results are given.

articleTitle: Process variation estimation for passive ladder circuit by means of interval analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article a new technique of process variation estimation in electrical circuit is presented. Technique is based on interval analysis application for a ladder circuit. Using this particular class of electrical circuit high speed of calculation could be achieved which is important in optimization and automated synthesis. In the article general ability of the technique application for a resistor circuit (with real impedance) is shown. Also ways of the technique extension for general circuit (with complex impedance) is discussed. Now the technique application is limited to passive network. The numerical experiments showed an agreement obtained results with statistical modeling with Monte Carlo Method. Further development of the technique is the extension to microwave circuit.

articleTitle: Statistical algorithms for superconducting q-bits parameters measurement
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Statistical algorithms for measurement data processing were developed to perform automation of superconducting quantum bits experimental investigations. The first algorithm is aimed to detect the q-bit quantum state changes. The second one is aimed to obtain the efficient resonance frequency estimation for the resonator coupled to a q-bit. All the results were obtained using the statistical approach that employs random nature of measurement data to obtain the optimal estimation rules and statistical hypotheses testing. The numerical modeling was carried out. The results of numerical modeling confirmed the efficiency and expediency of the algorithms obtained.

articleTitle: GPU implementation of iterative solver for linear systems obtained by FEM discretization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work describes the application of modern high-performance computing technologies such as multicore CPUs and GPUs coprocessors to the solution of three-dimensional (3D) problems of geoelectromagnetism with the use of the finite element method. The techniques for speeding up sparse linear system solving via iterative methods are discussed. Programs to solve large sparse complex-valued linear systems with the COCR method, Jacobi preconditioner and residual smoothing technique were developed and implemented for CPU and GPU devices. Jacobi preconditioner was optimized to increase performance with respect to default implementation from cuBLAS and cuSPARSE libraries on GPU. The developed programs were verified on the set of linear systems with large sparse matrices stored in CSR format that were obtained by solving the forward magnetotelluric problem with the finite element method. The comparison of parallelization has been done using both CPU and GPU devices. Our experiments with an NVIDIA Tesla C2075 and Intel i5-2500 show that, using of GPU, we can achieve an acceleration of up to 8 times compared to the single-threaded implementation on the CPU or up to 3.5 times compared to the multithreaded implementation with Intel MKL subroutines.

articleTitle: Information technology for monitoring of hydraulic fracturing
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An original information technology for monitoring of hydraulic fracturing is proposed and implemented. This technology is based on detection of sources of microseismic oscillations, data processing and visualization of three-dimensional dynamic model of fractal fractured zone.

articleTitle: Laboratory work on the study of magnetoimpedance effect
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of an experimental study of the magnetoimpedance effect (MI) by students of higher school is considered. This study can be performed within the framework of laboratory works on such disciplines as "Physics of magnetic phenomena", "Electrodynamics", "Electrical engineering" and the like. The minimal equipment kit for study of the MI is described. And also the ways of enhancement for MI investigation are suggested.

articleTitle: Acceleration methods for the calculation of results in boundary element modeling
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the most widely used methods for numerical modeling of physical processes is the boundary element method (BEM). Compared to the well-known finite element method (FEM), main advantage of BEM is the reduced dimension of the problem. Discretization is only required at the boundary between the materials, therefore, mesh generation in the computational domain becomes significantly simplified. One of the problems that complicate practical application of BEM is great computational costs in calculating the characteristics of the field inside the computational domain based on the solution obtained. This is due to integrating over the entire boundary required in the conventional method in order to obtain the result. This paper addresses the study of a possibility of accelerating such calculations via parallelization and vectorization and using the fast multipole method. The efficiency of the proposed methods is investigated. The results are obtained by solving the problem of magnetic field calculation in the operating area of the C-shaped dipole magnet.

articleTitle: Installation for studying of tunnel effect by means of the tunnel diode
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The tunnel effect is the cornerstone of many phenomena of nuclear and nuclear physics, physics of a solid body and superconductors, for example, of α-disintegration, thermonuclear reactions, field emission of electrons from metal, tunnel breakdown of p - n - junction, etc. The effect of tunneling is used during creation of new element base micro and a nanoelectronics (in nanostructures like the field transistor on the basis of a quantum point), active film elements, etc. are developed.

articleTitle: Software for multidimensional inversion of magnetotelluric data with recovering conductivity in the cells
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes the method and software which allows user to carry out multidimensional inversion of magnetotelluric sounding data. The computational schemes of direct problems are based on the finite element method (FEM) with the use of meshes with rectangular regular grids using nodal and vector finite elements. Mathematical model of the inverse problem is based on the idea of the Gauss-Newton minimization. In the proposed approach, the derivatives with respect to parameters are calculated analytically. The paper shows the results of numerical experiments of 2D inversion for synthetic models.

articleTitle: An optimization of initial gap in electrostatic comb drive
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An optimization of initial gap of a movable electrode in elementary cell of planar electrostatic comb drive utilized transverse displacement is considered and analyzed. An analytical equation providing the maximal value of relation between sensitivity and area of the elementary cell is obtained in one-dimensional case.

articleTitle: The third generation of territorial passenger transport systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Perspective directions of development of passenger transport complex of Russia. It is shown that the use of modern information technologies to manage regional transportation systems makes it possible to significantly improve almost all basic indicators of passenger transportation quality, to make them more effective and less costly, increase comfort and accuracy, reduce investment and operating costs. The methodology of the gradual transition to the third generation of the first and second generations, which are currently used in the territorial system of Russia passenger traffic.

Author Keywords: mobile technology in social processes and business

articleTitle: Accuracy evaluation of functional characteristics in devices
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper invariant method of evaluation of the functional (output) characteristics when designing devices is discussed and recommended to use. The method is particularly useful in the development of electronic devices for various purposes.

articleTitle: Verilog-model ALU microprocessor 6502 at the base MPGA 5503HM5 (CAD VLSI Kovcheg 3.02)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For the first time created a Verilog-model ALU microprocessor 6502 company MOS Technology (USA) based MPGA 5503HM5 using CAD VLSI Kovcheg 3.02. It carried out a complete ALU design cycle, including the simulation of the formation of a truth table and topology. It is shown that the library 5503 is functionally complete and supports the effective development of all the constituent elements of the ALU microprocessor 6502 based Verilog Netlist.

articleTitle: Determining the number of classes on an image as a distribution space dimension
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work considers the task to determine the number of classes for a rank-based image thresholding algorithm. A new approach is proposed, which is based on a rank histogram ensemble forming. Rank histograms are considered as linear space vectors, for which the orthonormal basis dimension is determined using the modified Gram-Schmidt process. The histogram bar height distribution is considered for determining the projection error maximum. During the Gramm-Schmidt process, vectors with projection error less than the specified threshold are discarded. The obtained basis dimension is used as an estimation of the number of classes. The method is controlled by three parameters: the threshold for discarding vectors, the sample structure and the histogram bin. The influence of these parameters on the estimation is considered. The proposed method is computationally simple and allows accelerating of the image segmentation algorithm. The segmentation results of thermal images are provided with the automatic estimation of the number of classes.

articleTitle: The investigation of filters with wide stop band, based on electromagnetic crystals of microstrip resonators 2D disposition
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Microstrip bandpass filters to the 6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order, based on 2D electromagnetic crystals were studied. Their appliance in structures of irregular resonators with originally convolved and earthed on its base with strip conductors enables the implementation of filters building multiple versions, including of high frequency-selective properties. The good conformance of the calculated characteristics in comparison with the received characteristics on experimentally made model of microwave device is shown.

articleTitle: Multiobjective problem of product line engineering for a small IT company
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper discusses the multi-objective problem of software product (SP) portfolio engineering in the context of limited resources of a small IT company. The authors introduce the following optimality criteria: minimized costs, maximized total profit and market segment attractiveness. The rule for selection of the compromise solution is presented as additive convolution of ratios of target and calculated indicators (costs, profit, attractiveness and number of target segments). The paper presents an example of product portfolio engineering for distribution of the Electronic Timetable software in the market of institutions of secondary specialized and higher education of the Siberian Federal District.

articleTitle: Development of laboratory facilities for analogue electronics as part of CDIO standards implementation in the research university
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Development of engineering education in a contemporary research university is relied on the international CDIO (Conceive - Design - Implement - Operate) standards. An important part of the process is development of technologies of methods for development of practical skills of engineering skills of students in electronics. In this paper we discuss the problems of development of laboratory facilities for analogue electronics as part of this process in National Research Nuclear University MEPhI.

articleTitle: UV radiation of radio frequency electronegative discharge in the inert gas - C12 mixture in association with the discharge shape
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The capacitive RF discharge in cylindrical geometry with the end-face outer flat electrodes (the RF field is directed along the cylinder axis) has been analyzed by a 2D modeling. It is shown that the reduction of cylinder length leads to a significant growth of both specific power and efficacy of excimer UV radiation, whereas the radius variations influence the said parameters only weakly.

articleTitle: Algorithm of processing of signals relative phase modulation in the presence at them the initial angle of shift of phases and correlation between two next instant values
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The algorithm of processing of signals of relative phase modulation based on summation of absolute values of the sums of instant values of the low-frequency modulating fluctuation with correlation between the next instant values is offered. The analysis of qualitative parameters of the radio engineering system realizing the offered algorithm is made.

articleTitle: Features visualization acoustic images obtained by the method shady stereo projection
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The constructive features of ultrasonic fault detection apparatus of the stereo type are examined. Determined depth resolution ability of ultrasonic stereoapparatus.

Author Keywords: non-destructive testing of the internal structure of physical objects

articleTitle: An acoustooptic information system of infralow frequencies
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, an original approach to studying acoustooptic interactions at infralow frequencies using seismic vibrators is proposed. It has been proved by the authors in numerous natural experiments that such sources can radiate low-frequency acoustic oscillations propagating in the atmosphere up to hundreds of kilometers from the source. High-precision metrological properties of vibrators for force and frequency-time characteristics - open up new for investigating acoustooptic interactions at infralow frequencies. An acoustooptic system developed by the authors is described. The system consists of the CV-40 vibrator, an optical bench with a laser emitter with a radiation power of up to 6 W at a wavelength of 850-930 nm and a pulse repetition rate of 1 kHz, a set of acoustic measurement stations, and a meteorological station. The results of natural and test experiments on acoustooptic interactions are presented.

articleTitle: Ways to ensure quality of work radio transmitters to base stations
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the issue of ensuring the electromagnetic compatibility of base stations, the main types of spurious emissions of transmitters of base stations and the ways of their elimination. Base stations with simultaneous operation generate unintentional electromagnetic interference each other, which ultimately reduces the quality indicators of communication and leads to the necessity of solving problems of electromagnetic compatibility, which is understood as the ability of base stations to function with a given quality in a given electromagnetic environment and not to cause harmful electromagnetic on-fur other electromagnetic means. Issues about the side radiation arising in the process of formation of oscillation of the carrier frequency. Consider the origin, spectral composition and measures of suppression of spurious emissions at frequencies associated fractional multiples of the ratios from the carrier frequency of the Radiation due to spurious modulation and noise radiation.

articleTitle: A 1–4.5 GHz MMIC mixer based on SiGe BiCMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A MMIC double-balanced passive mixer with on-chip integrated baluns based on 0.25 μm SiGe BiCMOS technology is presented. The mixer core configuration uses ring-connected CMOS transistors. The main MMIC mixer design steps are considered. The construction of integrated on-chip broadside balun is investigated. The MMIC mixer in the test bench with wire bonding has the following characteristics: conversion gain G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> is -9...-12.5 dB over the frequency band of 1-4.5 GHz; input power P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1dB</sub> for 1 dB compression is 12 dBm; size is 1.74×0.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Processing of biological objects of various sizes using the electrode with two point contacts by coblation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of various sizes biological objects processing by using the electrode with two point contacts of 0.5 mm in diameter by cold plasma (CP) is considered. It is shown, that by using such a thin electrode, it's possible to implement a thin and volume insision of a biological tissue and treat the surface of biological objects of various sizes.

articleTitle: Application of neuromuscular electric stimulation for elimination of the obstructive sleep apnea syndrome
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper establishes grounds for the necessity to search alternative active methods of affection aimed at elimination of obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (OSA) episodes. For that, the method of electric neurostimulation based on interferential currents was chosen. The authors performed theoretical development of the method, determined principle characteristics of actuating signals, and also found points of electrodes application in accordance with the human's anatomy. In addition, on the base of established parameters, the authors designed and manufactured a device, which can provide such affection. As it is supposed, the developed technology will make it possible to effectively eliminate the apnoeic episodes of a human during sleeping without a necessity of wakening.

articleTitle: Access technology to high performance resources by means of information systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes the developed information system (IS), aimed at the realization of the possibility of remote work with the program permutation test on supercomputers. As part of the article provides a detailed description of the software components included in the information system and a brief description of the operating principle of the permutation test (PT). This work was supported by RFBR grant No16-37-00240.

articleTitle: Decision support system to determine the effective values the parameters of the production process on the Pareto set
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discussed the definition of the Pareto-optimal set of average products production time, taking into account several criteria of optimality. Developed and an algorithm of vector control parameters of production processes. Changes in the course of implementation of the control algorithm based on the behavior of the objective function.

articleTitle: Evaluation of results of activity of educational institutions of professional education
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of processing of results of activity of educational institutions in relation to FSAI FPE “Academy of standardization, metrology and certification (educational)” the Novosibirsk branch.

articleTitle: Malicious software detection in operating system (OS) for mobile devices (the case of Android OS)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analysis of the OS security for mobile devices (thec ase of Android OS) and formalizing the samples of malicious software were carried out in the paper. Based on received data an experimental sample describing behavior of malicious software was suggested and the choice of the best method of classification of the present [experimental] sample though experiments employing classical, neural network classification method, and also support vector machines was made. Desired goalin improving the effectiveness of malicious software detection was achieved through development of a method based on support vector machines and fuzzy logic. The present method was accomplished by means of research prototype of malicious software detection system.

articleTitle: The planar dipole antenna excited by modified microstrip via-hole balance unit
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel variation of the conventional printed dipole antenna in combination with the modified microstrip via-hole balance unit (balun) is proposed. By properly choosing their parameters, it is possible to create the version of the antenna that has suitable range of input voltage standing-wave ratio (VSWR) performance and radiation patterns. Prototype of this antenna has been successfully implemented on a FAF-4 Russian printed-circuit-board substrate. The proposed antenna with the modified via-hole balun, relatively low profile, and high polarization purity is suitable candidate for mobile communication systems with single linear, dual linear or circular polarization.

articleTitle: Geometric 3D inversion application for recovering the polarizability of geoelectric-heterogeneous geological media
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the 3D-inversion computational scheme for recovering the boundaries of 3D anomalous polarizable objects and their polarizability in a 3D conductive heterogeneous medium with the use of electric field measurements on the Earth's surface. In order to solve a direct problem, we use a special computational scheme which allows presenting the induced polarization (IP) field as superposition of fields induced by each polarizable subdomain. This makes it possible to increase the computational efficiency of both forward and inverse problems. In order to solve the inverse problem, the volume being investigated is divided into subdomains so that each survey profile should cross one row of subdomains. The unknown parameters in 3D-inversion are subdomains boundaries along profiles and their polarizability, but boundaries along the axis orthogonal to profiles are fixed. The numerical results obtained with the use of synthetic IP data show that, if the conductivity of 3D medium is known, the approach developed enables us to define with high accuracy the polarizability of 3D objects and their boundaries along profile, even if the recovered polarizable subdomains boundaries along the axis orthogonal to profiles do not coincide with the boundaries of real objects.

articleTitle: Development of high tech companies in Russia: Empirical study
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper deals with interfirm cooperation of high tech and innovative companies. This cooperation is rather flexible and could take various forms. Empirical data are obtained through survey of Siberian small and medium size companies. Special part of the inquiry is devoted to partnership cooperation analysis. It was found that innovative companies consider partnership cooperation to be an important component of firms' activities. However in most cases these relations are developed spontaneously without regular management. Several key actors got high scores as main partners; managers plan to improve cooperation with them. Our calculations revealed that large domestic and foreign corporations turned to be reliable partners.

articleTitle: On one problem of financial management optimization of enterprise when performing state defense order
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The original formal problem definition of financial management optimization of an enterprise at this conjuncture of financing the state defense order is suggested. The problem is shown to belong to the class of NP-hard problems of the mixed programming. The existing methods for solving this problem are considered and the properties of the program tools developed by the authors for searching for the best solutions are discussed.

articleTitle: Installation for potential-raising current measurement in grounding arrangement
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A voltage on grounding equipment of high-voltage substation measurement algorithm has been proposed. The algorithm involves calculation of potential-raising current taking into account transformers' grounded neutrals and earthwires of overhead power transmission lines. A installation for modelling processes that cause occurrence a voltage on the grounding arrangement has been developed.

articleTitle: The use of robust criteria for the choice of regression model by LS-SVM method
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article researches are conducted in the variants of robust criteria for selection the regression model with the use of LS-SVM method in the conditions of foul data use. For estimation of model parameters uses M-estimation method with the Huber loss function. For the settings of LS-SVM algorithm parameters is used the cross-validation criterion and its robust variants.

articleTitle: Training simulators for support of inductive method in teaching
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article is devoted to training simulators aimed to support inductive methods in teaching applied mathematical disciplines in the higher education system. Such training simulators not only implement traditional functions by presenting ready knowledge and ensuring opportunities for obtaining skills in problems solving, but they also enable students to organize their own experimental research, to process and analyze the obtained results in order to generate a new generalized knowledge. The article summarizes some requirements to simulators, and describes one of the variants of the basic structure of the simulator and its functions. The article also gives examples of simulators applicable to the following disciplines: Optimization Methods, and Simulation Modeling, elaborated in the framework of the concept of inductive teaching.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of the scanning laser stimulation of biologically active points
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The mathematical description of the method of changes the wavelength of the laser radiation 670 nm and 850 nm is formed. Mathematical calculations prove the new method of laser stimulation of biologically active points of a living organism. Effect on biological point happens from is moving the laser source by the variable speed. The study allows to calculate the dependence of the wavelength on the speed of the radiation source relative to the biological active point.

articleTitle: The magneto-electric system for the brain and hippocampus activation with magnetic field under various diseases
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is concerned with a magneto-electric system and the mechanisms of different brain cortex regions activation by low-intensity magnetic flux in order to apply the obtained results for curing various diseases.

articleTitle: The research of the sorption-capacitance method to measure the humidity of the benzene
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is offers to use the sorption-capacitance method to measure the humidity of benzene. It also gives the description of the most widespread method of measurement of humidity of organic liquids by K. Fisher, and points out its peculiarities of use that re-strict its universal application. The research was carried out by sorption-capacitive sensors of Honeywell. These sensors nowadays are used to measure only gas humidity. To carry out this research it was offered to make organic liquid samples of known humidity by the method of using saturated salt solutions. The dependences of capacity of sensitive elements on changes of the humidity of benzene are received as the result of carrying out experiments. The check of reproducibility of experiment at confidential probability of 0.9 was carried out. The approximation of experimental data was made by the method of smallest squares. The identification of parameters of the mathematical model approximating these dependences was carried out. The result of the research is the possibility of measurement of the humidity of benzene by the sorption-capacitance method.

articleTitle: Laboratory bench for research of air gaps' dielectric strength
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article, air gaps' dielectric strength has been explored. Furthermore, the measurement procedure of discharge voltage has been incarnated for impulse and power-frequency voltages, uniform and nonuniform electrical fields.

articleTitle: A method of increasing the resolution of the analog-to-digital Converter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is shown that when using modulate-present additional signal at the input of the analog-to-digital Converter subsequent filtration, it is possible to improve the accuracy of the ADC. Given the theoretically cal justification of the method and carried out the computer modeling.

articleTitle: Software for finite element analysis of stress-raisers in composite laminates
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes the method and software which allows the user to calculate quite fast and accurately the stress-strain behavior of composite materials including several stress-raisers. The computational schemes are based on the finite element method (FEM) with the use of meshes with quadrangular prism cells. The software provides the automatical meshing with an arbitrary number of stress-raisers in the form of cylindrical holes with countersinks. In order to refine stress values, the specific procedures of solution smoothing are used. The software does not use homogenization procedures. This makes it possible to perform the lamina analysis of longitudinal (along the reinforcing fibers) and transversal stresses. In order to reduce labor costs, the convenient parametrization of the investigated structures and tools for controlling the FE meshes are proposed. The paper shows the numerical results of stress-strain behavior calculations obtained for sixteen-ply composite laminate with one and three stress-raisers with countersinks. The calculation time does not exceed 15 s for one stress-raiser and 1 min for three stress-raisers. The calculation error in stresses does not exceed 4%. This allows avoiding the simplified calculation schemes that limit the variety of design solutions.

articleTitle: Investigation of influence of some factors on accuracy of determining the flashpoint of oil products
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the results obtained in experimental studies of express method of determining the flashpoint of oil products.

articleTitle: The impact of memory effect on computing time
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article presents results of experiments, which were carried out to discover the impact of memory effect on computing time. A series of runs were conducted to execute sequential and parallel algorithm of solving system of linear equations (SLE) with the steepest-descent method. The quantitative evaluation of parallel algorithm realization exponents in different ranks SLE solving is given. Dependences and factors, which have impact on computing time, are detected. Parallel computing was implemented in the Distributed computing system with programmable structure of Novosibirsk State Technical University at Computer Engineering Department.

articleTitle: About one impact-electric effect and possibilities of creation of impact acceleration sensor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The theoretical explanation of experimentally found phenomenon of emergence of macroscopic area of local violation of electro neutrality is given. The area arises at blow to a metal core and extends with an impact impulse. We will explain observed macroscopic effect from a position of physics of a solid body.

articleTitle: Using thermostatically controlled loads for the secondary control provision based on the modal method
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with providing ancillary services using thermostatically controlled loads, in particular electrical space heaters. Ancillary services, such as the secondary control, are aimed to maintain balance between production and consumption of the electricity. Developing concept of smart grids provides possibility to involve classical and advanced control methods for ancillary service provision. The aggregate consumption produced by thermostatically controlled loads is significant due to relatively big number of devices of this kind. The obtained results show that a large population of electrical space heaters can meet the requirements on the secondary control. The population model is based on the first order approximation of the equivalent thermal parameter model. The matrix form of the modal method is used for control system design. Since the modal method assumes using linear model, calculations of the controller parameter are based on a 1D bin state transition model, which is used for approximation of the population behavior. The main feature of the designed control system is that the temperature control and demand tracking are provided by the central controller simultaneously, whereas the standard approaches assumes the temperature to be controlled by the local thermostats.

articleTitle: Demonstration experiment for course of general physics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Effective and efficient understanding of general physics course needs good presentation of education material. In this article authors offer an example of physical experiment presentation based on construction of ion engine. Understanding of physical, chemical, and mathematical principles of ion engine gives an opportunity for students to perceive basics in context of scientific understanding of world.

articleTitle: Patent activity of developed countries in the terahertz range — Comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The terahertz radar - prospects of development based on the patent activity of developed countries into area radars of terahertz range is analyzed. It is shown that since 2000, there is a linear increase in the number of patents in this area. The largest number of patents is issued in the NATO countries.

articleTitle: Control and adaptive feedback operation of game models in psychophysiological virtual reality simulator by means of biofeedback system BOSLAB
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article gives a theoretical basis and an example of the practical implementation of methods for monitoring and control of human psychophysiological state using the methods of adaptive biocontrol, technology-loads the virtual reality software and hardware complex “BOSLAB-Labirint”.

articleTitle: Prospects for use and design of oil product inspection and quality monitoring tools
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of design of instruments for monitoring physical and chemical parameters of oil products and their use for monitoring of quality of oil products.

articleTitle: The method for calculating magnetic field induced by current coils
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the simulation of electromagnetic fields in particle accelerators, it is often required to calculate the field from the coils with the current. For this one can use the Biot-Savart law. The paper presents a method for calculating the field from coils with the current, in the case where the coils can be represented in the form of a body formed by extrusion of a constant section along a smooth curve. The formulas that allow transforming the integral over the body of the current coil to the integral along the extrusion curve are presented. The analysis of the effectiveness of the proposed approach is given.

articleTitle: The choice of the coefficient of criterion of a minimum of the resulting root-mean-square error
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The various approaches to a choice of weight coefficient of criterion of a minimum of the resulting root-mean-square error of linear automatic control systems are considered. This criterion allows defining compromise meanings of small parameters of system, minimizing an resulting error of the system, which is summed dispersion of measurement noise and error of reproduction of determined or casual reference input. Changing weight coefficient of criterion, we give greater “weight” to that error, which is necessary for suppressing more strongly.

Author Keywords: the criterion of minimum mean square error

articleTitle: The tasks development and implementation of digital orthogonal meters of harmonic signals parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Orthogonal meters with digital signal processing provide optimal estimates of the amplitude and phase of harmonic signals for measurements in noise. They are used as separate measurement tools and as a component of measurement systems. Well-developed methods of spectral measurement based on the discrete Fourier transform of signals may be applied to determine parameters of orthogonal meters upon their metrological characteristics. Required characteristics of orthogonal gauges shall be obtained upon implementable parameters of the device. The paper presents solutions that provide requirements in accuracy, dynamic and frequency range due to the prior analog and digital signal filtering. The filter parameters selection conditions and implementation characteristics optimization goals are shown. The results are tested through computer modeling and implementation.

articleTitle: The development of the phantom for testing physiotherapy equipment for intracavitary effects
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the development process Fantin-ma for physiotherapy unit tests for intracavitary action. For the searcheth-tion of new medical devices, there is a need in the modeling of biological tissues on a physical level. During the development of this model was done 3D model Vor we prostate gland, which is then filled zhelat-new solution has properties similar to those of a-stvami tissues of the prostate.

articleTitle: The simulation of evolution of crystal particle in vortex chamber
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The vortex chamber is proposed to produce silicon and other crystal particles, as well as to intensify heat and mass transfer processes and chemical reactions. Results of the numerical computations of the evolution of ice crystal moving in vortex reactor are presented.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling exposure of shock on the electronic equipment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of mathematical modeling of exposure of shock research and development of optimized numerical models of spacecraft electronics, which reduce the dimension of the finite element model, while maintaining the reliability of the simulation results. Mathematical modeling of stress-strain state of the construction of autonomous navigation system due to shock impacts, taking into account the actual operating conditions using developed optimized models.

articleTitle: The parameters determination of the inverted pendulum model in the automatic control system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The inverted pendulum is considered as an object. The object parameters different variations from the basic values are set (regulator parameters don't change at the same time). The test signal is given on the system, the several characteristic points get out of the transition process. According to these data the special charts are under construction. After that the object parameters identification problem is reduced to measurement of the chosen process indicators at the system exit and to drawing them on the constructed chart. The sinusoidal signal is chosen as a test signal.

articleTitle: Block design of robust control via sigma-functions
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of stabilizing with a given accuracy for output variables of SISO and MIMO nonlinear systems. A mathematical model of the control plant is represented in block form “input-output” and contains unmatched external disturbances and functional uncertainties. Within the block approach, decomposition procedures of synthesis of robust control are designed under the uncertainty of the input channels of fictitious and real controls. Using S-shaped, smooth and bounded sigma-functions in local feedbacks allowed us to consider restrictions on state variables at the synthesis stage. For block synthesis of MIMO systems with undetermined and non-singular matrices before fictitious and real control actions, we are used the ideology of the control hierarchy method for finding lower bounds of amplitudes of sigmoidal controls, ensuring the convergence of the state variables in the defined regions. This approach extends the class of invariant systems by nonlinear systems with non-smooth disturbances, where special requirements for the composition of the state variables in each block are missing.

articleTitle: Research of Tukey's test statistic distribution under failure of the normality assumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we study the effect of disturbances of a normality assumption on the distribution of the Tukey criterion statistic multiple comparisons. The method of computer simulation of Monte Carlo is used as a research tool. The conclusions on the possibility of correctly applying of the Tukey criterion in different situations are made.

articleTitle: Synthesis and analysis of detection algorithm of distributed sources against background with distributed lutter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with an algorithm for detection of a broadband signal received from a multiple-unit source against the background with architecturally-like clutters that differ by location and additive space-uncorrelated noise. It is shown that the optimal detection algorithm represents the weight processing in the «ray space» of the transformed vector of observed data and does not demand access of any large matrix. A maximum likelihood ratio is chosen as the optimality criterion. After determining the inverse of the correlation function, expression for the optimal weight function is obtained. The design ratios for determination of detection characteristics under the Gaussian statistics of signals and clutters are given. The results confirm the property of the suggested algorithm: at low signal/noise ratios, efficiency of point targets detection is better, and at the large ratios the distributed targets are better detected.

articleTitle: Algorithm of processing of signals relative phase modulation in the presence at them the initial angle of shift of phases and correlation between two next instant values
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The algorithm of processing of signals of relative phase modulation based on summation of absolute values of the sums of instant values of the low-frequency modulating fluctuation with correlation between the next instant values is offered. The analysis of qualitative parameters of the radio engineering system realizing the offered algorithm is made.

articleTitle: Using the event calculus for modelling an operator of a simulator complex
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes how to create intellectual agent capable to provide training on the simulator complexes. The possibility of using the event calculus for the creation of such agents is shown. An example of constructing a model of the agent on the example of an agent of a braking position for the training simulator complex for marshalling yard is provided.

articleTitle: Development of an universal firmware for control of testbed in strength laboratory
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to development of an universal firmware in order to carry out of strength and fatigue tests for aeronautical equipments. The framework of the developed firmware is described. The firmware is operated as the part of testbed and allows providing computer-aided strength and fatiguing tests. Hardware components of the firmware are based on industrial equipment which is used in stands for strength tests. The upper level of software is implemented by means of Visual Studio 2012 with C#, WPF, C++. The lower level of software is implemented by means of ANSI-C and PLC code. The created firmware allows to increase of implementation accuracy of power loading cyclograms during of strength and fatigue tests for aeronautical equipments.

articleTitle: Speedup of three-dimensional finite element geoelectromagnetic fields modelling in time domain
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the finite element modeling of an electromagnetic field induced by an ungrounded circular loop in three-dimensional medium is conducted using the vector basis functions and an implicit scheme in time. An approach to the choice of initial guess in the solver of finite element system of linear algebraic equations is proposed. The computational efficiency of different preconditioners is compared.

articleTitle: The electromagnetic model of a printed dipole with generalization of arbitrary orientation and phasing of unconventionally excited arms
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with a method of setting the current distribution on single dipole arms in such a way as to enable its radiating characteristics to be generalized. Therewith, the capability of arms to have an arbitrary orientation and non-traditional excitation with a phase shift introduced into the arms currents together with a number of features allowing consideration of dipole printed-circuit implementation, is taken into account. The option was examined for proposed method to be extended to the analysis of multiple-dipole antenna systems with arbitrary parameters of individual dipoles.

articleTitle: Investigation of printed dipole match realized on a zinc tungstate
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of a dielectric constant of the zinc tungstate on the return loss of printed dipole is presented. The return loss indicates how the printed dipole is matched with the energized coaxial cable having the characteristic impedance 50 Ohms. The dielectric constant of zinc tungstate is the random quantity with the Gaussian distribution having the nominal value equal to 18. Plots of the return loss distribution functions for several dielectric variances are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of fault tolerance of wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Sensor networks are used to collect information from a monitored area and to transfer it to the coordinator node. To ensure the trouble-free operation, network elements require high fault tolerance to intentional and unintentional destructive influences. The article discusses the problem of simulation of changes of performance network under the influence of attacks and the problem of estimation of network stability.

articleTitle: Solution of the problem of searching for an energy-efficient functioning mode of a continuous production using simulation and artificial intelligence methods
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article examines the problem of searching for an energy-efficient functioning mode for a power-consuming continuous production characterized by nonlinearity, inertness and closed-circuit operation. It suggests a method to construct a multi-criterion target function on the basis of technological production process simulation. A genetic algorithm was used to solve an optimization problem, which made it possible to receive values of controlling technological production parameters that ensured decrease in energy consumption.

articleTitle: Distortion effect analysis of N-OFDM signal with frequency drifts of carrier wave
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper, research results of the distortion effect of an N-OFDM signal are presented. The consequence emerges due to a frequency drift of the carrier wave because of the Doppler effect during user's movement and instability of oscillator frequency, when a transfer of the spectrum is implemented in transmitting and reception path of the communication system. The N-OFDM signal based on the Hartley transform with the QAM modulation of subcarrier was analyzed. The interference immunity of the N-OFDM signal was defined for different frequency spacing between subcarriers and various frequency drifts of the subcarriers for an equivalent low-frequency channel with AWGN. Demodulation was implemented by the modified Cauchy method. The highest possible shift of the frequency subcarriers of the N-OFDM signal was determined by means of simulation experiments in Matlab 7 for the situation, when it is still possible to keep a communication session.

articleTitle: Synthesis of D-optimal continuous input signals for stochastic linear systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For stochastic linear continuous-discrete models with unknown parameters included to the equations of states and measurements, to the initial conditions and the covariance matrices of dynamics and measurement noises the problem of synthesis of D-optimal input signal in terms of linear combination of Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind is solved.

Author Keywords: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind

articleTitle: Modified multiscale discontinuous Galerkin method in the function space H(curl)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we propose the new modified multiscale discontinuous Galerkin method for solving harmonic electromagnetic problems. The computational scheme is based on the vector finite element method in function space H(curl), discontinuous Galerkin method and multiscale ideas. The numerical analysis of convergence and parallel realization scalability is performed. The proposed method is used for solving the direct electromagnetic problem in the computational domain with complex internal structure comprising randomly placed inclusions of various geometric shapes and sizes.

articleTitle: Pyrometric probes with limited conductive binder based on silicon carbide
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Using monocrystalline silicon carbide polytype 6H developed and tested design pyrometric probe, which increases the degree considered horizontally isothermal surface emitting area, through the creation of static heterogeneity. In the temperature range 800…1300°C experimental methods television pyrometry, including both full and partial immersion of the probe in the gas flame, the peculiarities of morphology formed in the structure of the temperature field.

articleTitle: Transmission protocol research according to IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We created a hardware and software facility of modeling power-system protection, which is consisted physical models of basic measuring, control and protection system nodes. The hardware and software facility ensures data transfer according to the requirements of the IEC 61850 standard. The obtained results are applied at creation of education and research equipment “Model of digital substation” and “Microprocessors of power-system protection communication protocol”. The education and research equipment allows complete studying of structure and particular engineering qualities of power-system protection digital substation, allows MMS, GOOSE & SV communication protocol implementation and practical application.

articleTitle: Fault tolerance methods for distributed computing systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers actual questions of organization of computing in distributed computing systems (DCS) which components are exposed to breakdowns. The consideration to terminology in the sphere of computing in DCS is given. The existing and expanding methods of computing process recovery after one of several nodes breakdown are discussing. The special attention is payed to the local checkpoints method and its realization in module of fault tolerance providing of NSTU Computing Science department distributed computing system.

articleTitle: Adaptive controller design based on time-scale-separation method for testbed of strength tests of aircraft structures
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to development of an universal firmware in order to carry out of strength and fatigue tests for aeronautical equipments.
