The framework of the developed firmware is described. The firmware is operated as the part of testbed and allows providing computer-aided strength and fatiguing tests. Hardware components of the firmware are based on industrial equipment which is used in stands for strength tests. The upper level of software is implemented by means of Visual Studio 2012 with C#, WPF, C++. The lower level of software is implemented by means of ANSI-C and PLC code. The created firmware allows increasing of implementation accuracy of power loading cyclograms during of strength and fatigue tests for aeronautical equipments.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of frequency selective structures of millimeterwave range
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electrodynamic characteristics of single-layered and cascaded metasurfaces for filtering and absorption of millimeter wave range electromagnetic waves are investigated. 3D numerical model of local site of metasurface, which takes into account it sizes in three coordinate directions is developed for analysis of such frequency-selective structures. Novel design of double-sided frequency-selective surface with cross shaped conducting elements is proposed.

articleTitle: Acceleration methods for the calculation of results in boundary element modeling
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the most widely used methods for numerical modeling of physical processes is the boundary element method (BEM). Compared to the well-known finite element method (FEM), main advantage of BEM is the reduced dimension of the problem. Discretization is only required at the boundary between the materials, therefore, mesh generation in the computational domain becomes significantly simplified. One of the problems that complicate practical application of BEM is great computational costs in calculating the characteristics of the field inside the computational domain based on the solution obtained. This is due to integrating over the entire boundary required in the conventional method in order to obtain the result. This paper addresses the study of a possibility of accelerating such calculations via parallelization and vectorization and using the fast multipole method. The efficiency of the proposed methods is investigated. The results are obtained by solving the problem of magnetic field calculation in the operating area of the C-shaped dipole magnet.

articleTitle: Measurement and statistical analysis of indoor MIMO radio channel parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper addresses wireless MIMO channel sounding method, based on time domain cross correlation principle. Measurement were conducted in indoor laboratory environment at central frequency 2.3 GHz with measurement bandwidth 100 MHz, 4 transmit and 4 receive antennas are used. Obtained impulse responses are presented and used for channel parameters estimation. Full channel correlation matrix and its eigenvalue decomposition are calculated, showing significant spatial correlation is. For statistical analysis maximum likelihood estimation of distribution of channel coefficients and goodness of fit tests are numerically computed. Correlated channel capacity compared with uncorrelated channel is presented.

articleTitle: Variational formulation for a magnetic field on dual meshes
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The mathematical modeling problem for the magnetic field H as the first order differential form with external orientation was considered in the paper. The variational formulation for the second order equation for the magnetic field was formulated. The ways to the dual triangulation construction for space approximation was shown. The approach to definition of basic functions on polyhedrons was proposed.

articleTitle: Information technology of system assessing of educational competences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper focuses on the system approach to assessing the development of educational competences based on the order testing technique of the competence structure following the dichotomous assessment of knowledge, skills, experience and students' personal qualities. Information technology of assessing competences has been developed.

articleTitle: The new three-phase AC voltage regulators with a small number of switches
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new family of AC voltage regulators with commutated capacitors is proposed at the paper. Reduction of number of semiconductor switches and reactive elements was the main point in the development of new converters. Discussed converters could increase or decrease of voltage keeping sinusoidal input and output currents. Lower values of the given capacitors reactive power and a large control range are characterized of these regulators. Paper presents an analytical calculation of the basic energy characteristics with using of the author direct method of calculation. We analyzed the imitating modeling results in the PSIM software.

Author Keywords: low switches regulators of AC voltage

articleTitle: The influence of digital averaging on the thyristor rectifier transfer function
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Digital control has several advantages such as good noise immunity, the ability to adjust the control system more flexibly and the ability to implement algorithms that are impossible or extremely difficult to be implemented in analog form. It is not surprising that today digital control is used in the vast majority of power converters. When implementing a digital control of power converter, it is necessary to consider the effect of the transition from the continuous representation of the whole system to a discrete one. Compensator parameters obtained for a continuous system may not be suitable for a digital control system. The quality of transients may not correspond to the requirements to the converter. Moreover, due to adding a compensator with such parameters the system may become unstable. This paper considers the influence of the digital averaging and sampling of control system on the thyristor rectifier operation. Transfer functions allowing to take into account this effect are presented. The change in the quality of transients due to the refinement of transfer functions is shown in the PSIM model.

articleTitle: Features applications modular training complex MTC-SS1 “Solid State Physics“
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper describes a modular training package MTC-SS1 “Solid State Physics” by the company “experienced equipment.” Identified the pros and cons of equipment and prespek-tives use in the educational process.

articleTitle: Development of service integration between the health information system NSO with the information system of the Bureau of medico-social examination
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the structure of the regional segment of the unified state information system NSO, basic information about medical information systems (MIS) and information systems (IS) medico-social examination Bureau (MSE), discussed the form and manner of filing directions to ITU. The article describes the review and analysis of existing solutions for the integration of MIS and IS MSE in other constituent entities of the Russian Federation. In addition, the article formed the basic requirements for the design of integration of service and determine the format for reporting direction to the MSE. The practical part of the article contains the description develop a standardized electronic medical document, the SOAP applied in the development of service, and a description of relevant information on the languages and programs used to design the prototype web service. The diagram information impact between the information systems and the this web service are there.

articleTitle: On power of randomness and absence of trend tests in dispersion characteristics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Distributions of various parametric and nonparametric tests are studied using methods of statistical modeling. Such tests are designed to test hypotheses for randomness or absence of a trend in dispersion characteristics. Procedure of interactive simulation of distributions of the test statistics is proposed and implemented. Such procedure allows valid usage of corresponding tests in case of violation of standard assumptions. The results of comparative analysis of the power of the tests against competing hypotheses with different models of linear, periodic, and mixed trend in the distribution characteristics are shown. Conclusions on preferences for using different criteria are made.

articleTitle: The valve motor when powered from a transistor voltage inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Reviewed results of the development and testing of the valve motor with the rotor position sensor when powered from a transistor voltage inverter. Speed control is provided by DC voltage level control at the entrance of the inverter. The tests were conducted using a synchronous motor with Magnetoelectric excitation. Motor power 60 kW at 6000 RPM.

articleTitle: Engineering education in Russia today: Problems and prospects
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the nature and reasons for the crisis phenomena in modern Russian higher technical education. The study was performed through analyzing statistical data and statements of the first government persons that containing strategic decisions in the area of reform directed to the domestic engineering education. Possible ways to overcome the problems described in paper are formulated.

articleTitle: Modular training complex MUK-MFT1 “Molecular physics and thermodynamics”
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Presented a modular training package MUK-MFT1 “Molecular physics and thermodynamics“. The application of the complex to carry out work to determine the thermodynamic characteristics of the air and studying the gas laws.

articleTitle: Synthesis of broadband impedance transformers with predetermined phase response
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Procedures for optimal synthesis of broadband impedance transformers with predetermined phase response was proposed in this paper. The proposed method makes it possible to obtain a matrix mathematical model of the transformer in the Foster's form with lumped or distributed elements. The mathematical model describes entire set of equivalent circuits. Among them we can select a suitable in terms of technological feasibility. The efficiency of the method is demonstrated by the example of synthesis of the broadband impedance transformer with lumped elements.

articleTitle: Scientific gear DCh-01
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Structural description, purpose and operation principal of multi-functional scientific gear Dch-01, installed on the small space vehicle AIST-2D, are present. Effects of space hazards on spacecraft elements are viewed.

articleTitle: Optimization of fuzzy controller of a wind power plant based on the swarms intelligence
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the problem of the optimal control of a wind power plant based on fuzzy control and automation of generating the fuzzy rule base. Fuzzy rules by experts do not always provide a maximum power output of the wind plant and fuzzy rule bases require an adjustment in the case of changing the parameters of the wind power plant or the environment. This research proposes the method for optimizing the fuzzy rules base compiled by various experts. The method is based on balancing weights of fuzzy rules into the base by the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm. The experiment has shown that the proposed method allows forming the fuzzy rule base as an exemplary optimal base from a non-optimized set of fuzzy rules. The optimal fuzzy rule base has been taken under consideration for the concrete control loop of wind power plant and the concrete fuzzy model of the wind.

articleTitle: On finding zero dynamics for descriptor systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A brief overview of the latest results for the problems of quality control theory for the ordinary linear systems as well as the new problems for the above. A link has been noted between the problems in modal control by output feedback and the zero dynamics problem. Descriptor systems reduced to the canonical form and the related problems of zero dynamics were considered.

articleTitle: Algorithms for statistical signal processing in ultrasonic distanse measurement
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: the Proposed statistical model of the measuring signals in the system temporary reflectometry on the basis of which with the help of complete sufficient statistics the estimates of the parameters of the reflected signal. The imitating modeling which has confirmed a solvency and effectiveness ratings. On the basis of the principle of unbiased the synthesis of the unbiased uniformly most powerful detection algorithm parameter change of the slope of the linearly varying signal. Simulation has shown the efficiency of the algorithm and the feasibility of its application for the detection of small changes in the parameters of the measuring signals and systems temporal reflectometry.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the effectiveness of a-trimmed mean to suppress industrial noise
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Institute of nanotechnology, electronics and instrumentation, Taganrog, Russia The results of digital modeling in the environment of NI LabVIEW applications α-trimmed mean to suppress industrial noise in the process of analog-to-digital conversion. Estimates of the stability of the ADC bit-for-bit encoding with different weighting factors (binary, Fibonacci codes) to periodical and impulse noise, normal noise. It is established that the drop 5–15% of measurements above and below the normalized number of measurements allows to eliminate the most dangerous impulse noise and to ensure that the coefficient of suppression of industrial noise in the 100 – 500 times. If the integration time is 20 MS and the number of observations equal 100, then the sinusoidal interference is suppressed to the level of 100 dB, impulse noise up to 60 dB, and the normal noise up to 20 dB.

articleTitle: Fiber-optical pyrometer
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Information on the outline sketch of a high-temperature fiber-optical pyrometer is provided in work. The main characteristics of pyrometers of the leading domestic producer of JSC NPP Etalon are provided. Results of power calculation of radiation of surfaces for a problem of measurement of high temperatures are presented, the choice of spectral range for such pyrometer is reasonable. On the basis of the carried-out calculations optical fiber and a lens are chosen. The block diagram of a fiber-optical pyrometer is provided.

articleTitle: FPA-based infrared thermography as a principal division of photonics
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the review lecture devoted to focal plane array (FPA)-based infrared thermography (IRT), one of the photonics rapidly advancing branches, novel research results are presented, which were predominantly obtained using modern high-performance FPA-based infrared cameras and IRT-based investigative methods. It is shown that the new-generation IRT technique makes it possible to carry out both fundamental and application-oriented works of wide-ranging thematic areas with obtaining precise quantitative data. It is possible to increase substantially the experimental results information value by addition of the adequate mathematical treatments to conventional analysis of thermogram dynamic packs.

articleTitle: Capacity of p-cascade tuned filter with an impact PSK-n-signal
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, qualification of the p-cascade tuned filter capacity estimation is presented for radio communication systems using multiposition phase-shift keyed signals with n-discrete states. It is shown that the capacity will be limited to the resolution time of linear systems that are present in the RCS linear radio-frequency section and that are an integral part of channel. The method of estimating the capacity is presented for p-cascade tuned resonant filter when the phase-shift keyed signal with n-discrete states is used for data transmission. Analytical estimate expressions of capacity for the one- and two-cascade tuned resonant filter were obtained with PSK-n-signal impact. It was found that the capacity is a limited quantity, which is characterized by essential growth with the change of n in the range of 2...32.

articleTitle: Mathematical models of the system of measurement and analysis of temperature parameters of radio electronic modules
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Increasing density of arrangement of radio-electronic equipment of different purpose, especially on-board equipment, limits significantly the possibility of heat removal by means of ventilation and convection in multi-level radio-electronic modules. At the same time, conductive method of heat removal, that suggests the use of heat mode support systems, special heat-exchange materials for sealing elements of radio-electronic devices. The aim of the research is to analysis possible mathematical models of heat exchange processes in radio-electronic modules in the form of analytical solutions. The article suggests the mathematical model of the analysis and heat mode support in radio-electronic devices and complexes in the form of quasihomogeneous non-isotropic parallelepiped with stationary three-dimensional or flat heat sources, placed in the surrounding conventions environment with stable temperature. This approach gives the opportunity to implement the following procedures: complex spatial arrangement of heat sources exchanged for simpler ones; multi-component subsystems with nonhomogeneous structures exchanged for quasi-homogeneous areas with effective values of heat-transfer properties; spatial arrangement of values describing heat exchange processes at the edges of the areas substituted by their mean values. The suggested approach allows simplifying substantially the expected value of temperature fields and these models can be widely applied for calculation, measurement, and analysis of heat modes in radio-electronic modules with high density of arrangement of radioelectronic equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis of stationary means of measurement filters with optimum sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When transmitting information and control signals to electrical, electromechanical and mechatronic systems are require reduction to the lowest possible levels of noise interference. For this is substantiated in the general formulation of the one-dimensional problem of determining the sensitivity of a linear stationary optimal Wiener filtration. It is proposed to use the method of local approximation of the spectral densities for the quantitative determination of indicators of sensitivity converting electrical signals from the means of measurement. In relation to the different models produced recommendations on the advisability of accounting the characteristics of the signal deviations from nominal, deviations from the optimal structures and parameters for their implementation and configuration of the filters themselves.

articleTitle: Parameter control of radio-electronic systems based of analysis of information conflict
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article examines the processes in radio systems consisting of multiple various radio devices that experience intentional and unintentional intentional interference. The research is aimed at finding the optimal plan for the operation of multiple radio devices so as to increase the efficiency of joint performance by means of readjusting the emittance parameters. The probability approach is offered to be used for the analysis of state dynamics of the model of radio devices, built on the basis of the theory of semi-Markov processes. As a result the models were obtained allowing to calculate and analyze the system performance efficiency. These models consider the complex of factors influencing the joint operation and are characterized by reliable formalized process description. The resultant mathematical basis allows to calculate the efficiency of radio-electronic devices functioning in interference conditions and to evaluate the probability of achieving the set tasks in the given amount of time. The suggested mathematical solutions allow to conduct complex study of the efficiency index as far as the dependence from parameters is concerned. The suggested models may help to perform optimal planning of frequency resource so as to reduce the interference level for radioelectronic devices, and in this way to build an efficient radio system equipped with various types of radio devices. The suggested models do not only allow to analyze the efficiency of system operation but to solve inverse problems aimed at improving their protection until it reaches the desired level.

articleTitle: Design and measurement of 0.1 – 4.5 GHz SiGe BiCMOS MMIC digital step attenuator
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The design and measurement of 0.1 – 4.5 GHz 5-bit MMIC digital step attenuator (DSA) are presented. The MMIC DSA is fabricated with 0.25 um SiGe BiCMOS process and includes integrated driver providing serial/parallel control. The main features of MMIC DSA are as follows: wideband performances (it covers L-, S- and partially C-band); a good input and output return losses (less than 12 dB and 14 dB, respectively); small phase variation (RMS phase error less than 5.3°); integrated driver; small size (1.4×0.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>); low power consumption Performances of MMIC DSA designed are compared with its commercial counterparts.

articleTitle: Dynamic mapping of all-to-all collective operations into hierarchical computer clusters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Interconnection networks of modern distributed computer systems are now hierarchical. In such systems communication time between processors depends on their placement in a computer system. In large-scale NUMA/SMP computer clusters first two levels are formed by network switches of two-stage fat tree/dragonfly topology and a third level is presented by a shared memory of computer nodes. In this paper, we describe a dynamic optimization method for collective all-to-all communication operations on hierarchical computer clusters. Our approach exploits knowledge of the L-level hierarchy of a computer system and is based on a mapping of intensively communicating processes into the same computer nodes. Optimized versions of the Bruck and recursive doubling algorithms for MPI_Allgather operation are proposed. Algorithms are implemented in our experimental library TopoMPI. Performance results on multicore SMP computer clusters with InfiniBand and Gigabit Ethernet networks indicate that the Allgather algorithms based on our approach outperform the original Allgather algorithms (Bruck and recursive doubling).

articleTitle: Information systems for popularization of scientific and knowledge-based software
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses problems of public awareness about scientific and knowledge-based software, the absence of a public repository of software and databases developed by research institutes and universities. The article presents the information system that provides support for scientific software developers - the Foundation of Algorithms and Programs.

articleTitle: The design of the circuits of radiation-hardened charge-sensitive amplifiers based on the structured array (MH2XA010) and the array chip (AC-2.1)
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article gives the circuit design results of the of radia-tion-hardened charge-sensitive amplifier (CSA) MH2XA010-04, intended for the capacitance sensor signal processing. The main equations for optimal design of CSA are given, taking into account a new circuit (2016) of structured array MH2XA010. The variants of construction of multichannel CSAs for the tasks of tool engineering based on the elements of the radiation-hardened array chip AC-2/1, produced since 2016, are considered.

articleTitle: Investigation of effects of longitudinal stretching of optical fibers on Brillouin backscattering spectrum
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of the strain characteristics (longitudinal stretching mechanical strains) of optical fibers based on Brillouin backscattering spectrum analysis are presented in this work. The reflectogrames of Brillouin backscattering spectrum and strain dependences along optical fibers are shown. “Problem” sections with the increased strain have been detected. The Brillouin reflectometry method allows to carry out early diagnostics of fiber-optical communication lines and to eliminate problems in the optical fiber in the early stage before changes in fibers become irreversible and damage optical fiber.

articleTitle: Voltage harmonics integral factors estimation of multilevel inverter with space vector modulation of two delta voltages
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes some details of the voltage source multilevel inverter space vector PWM algorithm developed on the base of one of the more general algorithms for oblique-angled coordinates of two delta voltages. The instantaneous output voltage waveform simulation has been carried out, and voltage THD and harmonics integral factors dependences on the amplitude modulation index are presented.

Author Keywords: integer and fractional parts of delta voltages relative values

articleTitle: Selection of factor for root mean square minimum error criterion
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with various approaches to the selection of weighting factor for of a cumulative weighted root-mean-square minimum error criterion of linear ACSs. Such criterion allows to determine optimal values of small parameters of the system, thus minimizing the system error caused by input replication error of a determined (or random) signal, as well as by variance caused by disturbance of the measurement.

articleTitle: Joint testing of optical pulse reflectometers of various types for early diagnostics and detection of “problem” sections in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental testing of optical fibers sections which were exposed to longitudinal stretching stresses or temperature changes, by means of usual (OTDR - optical time-domain reflectometer) and Brillouin optical pulse reflectometers (BOTDR - Brillouin optical time-domain reflectometer) are presented in this work. OTDR-graphs of “problem” sections of optical fibers and BOTDR-graphs (3D-reflectogrammas and optical fiber strain dependence) for heated and for cooled sections of optical fibers are shown. Results of tests confirmed advantage of the Brillouin reflectometry method for early diagnostics and detection of “problem” sections in fiber-optical communication lines.

articleTitle: The parameters determination of the inverted pendulum model in the automatic control system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The inverted pendulum is considered as an object. The object parameters different variations from the basic values are set (regulator parameters don't change at the same time). The test signal is given on the system, the several characteristic points get out of the transition process. According to these data the special charts are under construction. After that the object parameters identification problem is reduced to measurement of the chosen process indicators at the system exit and to drawing them on the constructed chart. The sinusoidal signal is chosen as a test signal.

articleTitle: Virtual students' laboratories in the physics practicum of the Technical University
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The author has organized the project activities of computer modeling in teaching physics for IT students at the Novosibirsk State Technical University. The students' teams develop soft-ware products that are virtual counterparts of experimental setups. The developed programs can be used as interactive virtual labs that enhance the physics laboratory practicum. Participation in the project activities of computer modeling contributes to formation of the students' professional competencies in the early stages of education.

articleTitle: The virtual laboratory “Microwave instruments and devices”
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New design approach and software package for computer modeling of virtual education laboratory works is proposed. Measurement equipment in virtual laboratory has interface and behaviors which are identical to real devices and allow studying characteristics of UHF devices and elements.

articleTitle: The ontology-based approach to support the requirements engineering process
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents a knowledge-based approach to requirements engineering process. The approach can be used when creating a system of requirements, satisfying the whole set of properties: correctness, completeness, consistency, unambiguity, traceability. We propose a hybrid model based on the frame ontology and production rules. Requirements types are the classes of the ontology. Hierarchical relations between the classes allow implementing the inheritance property from parent requirement class to the descendant one, and can be used for testing traceability, completeness and consistency properties of the requirements specification. Associative relations implemented through a set of slots permit to approach the problem of matching the requirements engineering theoretical framework through the establishment of correspondence between requirements types belonging to different classifications.

articleTitle: Development of rotating pendulum stabilization algorithm and research of system properties with the controller
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of stabilization problem decision of Rotating Pendulum electromechanical system is discussed. The schematic representation of observable system is pictured and the nonlinear differential equations which describe this system behavior are presented. The transition to reductive model is realized and the research of its main qualitative properties is executed. Modeling the closed-loop system by a controller in Matlab Simulink program environment is spent.

articleTitle: An approach for estimation of integrated reliability indices and maintenance intervals of fiber-optic communication lines
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the analysis of the strain impact on the reliability of optic-fiber communication lines. The reasons of strain appearance in optical fiber are discovered and two models, analytical and simulation, are proposed for the estimation of the integrated reliability indices of fiber-optic lines. The results, obtained by means of the models, can be used for the estimation of recommended maintenance intervals of the considered telecommunication lines.

articleTitle: Towards development of self-learning and self-modification spiking neural network as model of brain
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper novel architecture of artificial intelligence based on spike neural networks is proposed. This architecture includes some perception, some action modules and control module supervising learning of others. Control module is based on generation and learning to generate basic emotions: positive and negative. These emotions are supervising learning and behavior of whole system.

articleTitle: Research of statistical properties of stochastic calculations using the improved test of distribution on the plane
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This offers an approach to improvement of the graphic test “Distribution on the Plane” allowing finding of weaknesses unidentifiable by the conventional tests. This contains testing findings of various pseudorandom number generators using the improved test.

articleTitle: Training hidden Markov models on incomplete sequences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with the algorithms of training hidden Markov models on sequences with missing observations. The method of imputation using Viterbi algorithm and the method of marginalization of missing observations are studied. These two methods are compared to the standard methods of dealing with missing data: imputation of gaps using the mode (the most frequent value) of nearest observations and gluing of observable parts of the sequence. The studied methods appeared to be more effective than the standard ones. Although the marginalization method proved to be a bit more effective than the method of imputation using Viterbi algorithm.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient wireless sensor with data transmission via RFID interface
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Compact and mobile device able to log environmental temperature and humidity has been developed. This device is powered from embedded battery. Collected data is transferred to external terminal by means of RFID link that does not require power to be supplied from battery that allows extended battery lifetime above 5 years depending on data acquisition rate. Possible ways to further extend battery lifetime has been evaluated. System that harvests energy from mains wires has been evaluated and tested. This system is based on collapsible current transformers made of standard power inductors and additional magnetic circuit part.

articleTitle: Application method of barrier functions in the problem of estimating the probability density of the parameterized approximations
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The methods of obtaining a parameterized density function with a limited number of data. The solution of this problem by minimizing the functional. In the method of the barrier function minimization problem with inequality constraints reduced to solving a sequence of unconstrained minimization problems. The advantage of this approach lies in the number of restrictions is independent of the order of the polynomial. Practical implementation of the minimization of the above causes functional choice of basis functions and the required order of polynomials approximating the probability density function.

articleTitle: Comparison of approaches and the software for 3D finite element modeling of harmonic electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of the finite element 3D-modeling of the time-harmonic electromagnetic fields excited by a wire loop. We compare the computational efficiency of two approaches to the finite element (FE) approximation when solving the induction logging problems. These approaches are based on different mathematical models and mesh generation algorithms. They use different types of finite elements and different solvers of FE systems. The first approach is implemented in the Helmholtz3D software and based on the solution of the vector Helmholtz equation without extracting the 1D background medium field. The second approach is implemented in the LogEM-FD software and based on performing the FE approximation of the mathematical model with extracting the 1D background medium field. The LogEM-FD software implements special algorithms of mesh generation with local refinements and deletion of «unnecessary» nodes and the possibilities to use finite elements with terminal («handing») nodes. The research conducted shows that high accuracy of the numerical solution of the induction logging problem has been achieved when both Helmholtz3D and LogEM-FD software packages are used. However, the computational costs required for the Helmholtz3D are significantly higher than those required for the LogEM-FD to obtain equally accurate solutions.

articleTitle: Modern problems of high-precision measurements of the phase differences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Precision phase measurements are necessary in many sectors of the measuring equipment. The most important parameters of these devices: 1) carrier frequency range; 2) changing range of the measured phase difference; 3) the phase measurement error; 4) frequency range for phase increments. The paper discusses the opportunities and challenges for precise measurement of phase differences for these purposes.

articleTitle: Application of photovoltaic cells with an intelligent control system for railway transport
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Application area of solar panels is expanding every year. Modern solar panels are widely used in various industries, such as aerospace, aviation, electricity supply buildings, outdoor lighting, etc. This article focuses on the use of solar energy in various railway fields. The results of the study to achieve maximum efficiency of the photovoltaic module using the algorithm of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) are shown. Many maximum power point tracking techniques for photovoltaic systems have been developed to maximize the produced energy and a lot of these are well established in the literature. However, when irradiance and temperature are changing rapidly, not all methods can track MPP rapidly enough. This paper presents a MPPT method, based on artificial neural network (ANN). A fast and accurate system realizing that method is offered. Efficiency of an ANN with different input parameters is estimated. Modeling is carried out with the software package Matlab, considering different solar irradiance variations and temperature.

articleTitle: The novel reentrant power splitters and band-stop elliptic filters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel variation of the conventional reentrant structure in combination with the modified bar transmission lines is proposed. By properly choosing their parameters, it is possible to create the version of the device that has suitable range of input voltage standing-wave ratio (VSWR) performance and power division. Prototype of this device has been successfully realized on a coaxial implementation. The proposed device with the modified reentrant structure is suitable candidate for mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Verification “in silicon” active output rectifier controller IC in 250 nm BCD technology for high-efficiency power converters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work is devoted to the experimental verification “in silicon” of an active output rectifier (AOR) integrated circuit (IC) for high-efficiency power supply units. IC is realized with the use of 250 nm BCD (Bipolar, CMOS, DMOS) mixed technology. As a part of this work, high-voltage low drop output (LDO) voltage regulator integrated circuit (IC) for power supply units has been characterized. This IC is realized also in 250 nm BCD technology.

articleTitle: Methods of calculation of load modes of roughing stand electric drives of wide-strip hot rolling mill
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper provides analysis of load modes for electric drives of horizontal rolls installed at the continuous train of the wide-strip hot rolling mill. It adduces results of experimental investigations of load distributions across the stands at rolling thick strips at the 2,000 mm rolling mill of OJSC Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works (OAO MMK). When rolling hollow billet, loads are distributed non-uniformly; at this, motor currents exceed nominal values. The paper substantiates development of the refined methods for calculation of the roll pressure and mill torque. articleTitle: System of monitoring and remote control of temperature conditions, climate and heat consumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the idea on developing of automated system for monitoring and management of climate and space heating. The developed system is implemented on the most modern components used to create devices with Ethernet- interface; it is versatile, easy to rebuild for specific applications and optimal in terms of its implementation costs.

articleTitle: Researches of strain characteristics of dispersion-shifted optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental examination of strain characteristics and their temperature dependences of dispersion-shifted optical fibers on the basis of the Brillouin reflectometry method are presented in this work.

articleTitle: “In silicon” verification of Multi-Functional Control Integrated Circuits in 250 nm BCD technology for high-efficiency power converters
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work represents results of verification of experimental samples of Multi-Functional Control Integrated Circuits (MFC IC) developed for modern low power, high-efficiency power supply units. articleTitle: The research of influence Normalizer voltage on characteristics and processes in electric networks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of research of influence of a Normalizer voltage on characteristics and the modes of a distributive electric network are presented: on static characteristics of active and inductive, resistive-capacitive and motor loading, on limit of the transferred power on a power line under the terms of stability at longitudinal and cross inclusion of a Normalizer voltage. Pilot studies are executed on Electrodynamic model of power supply systems of Novosibirsk State Technical University.

articleTitle: The effective use of STATCOM in the electrical system of the Republic of Tajikistan to reduce the losses of active power in the electric network
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is reviewing the possibility and efficacy of high-power static VAR compensator (STATCOM) to reduce active power losses in the electrical system of the Republic of Tajikistan, taking into account the use of renewable energy sources (RES).

articleTitle: Functional-structural theory based techniques for human-machine systems optimal design
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers an automated procedure for designing a human-machine systems functioning processes (HMS FP), models, methods and techniques discussed are based on functional-structural theory (FST) and generalized structural method suggested by prof. A.I. Gubinsky. Each of alternative human-machine system functioning processes is defined as a functional net (FN). It consists of a number of formalized units: basic functional units and their combinations - basic functional structures. A set of alternative HMS processes is described by an alternative graph. A HMS FP notation based on binary relations between elements included in FN is presented. Resolving the optimization problem takes into account several parameters, including efficiency index, reliability and quality. Hybrid expert system developed with extended functionality allows building all isomorphic representations of the alternative graph, generating the specific directed sorting algorithm automatically and manually. The suggested algorithm defines FN boundaries alternative HMS FP segments can be preset within. The technique to identify a binary relation FN as belonging to a set of nets described under the functional-structural theory is presented. Software implementing all the methods discussed is considered.

articleTitle: An information technology of verification of earth's crust velocity models
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the basic statements of an information technology for investigation and verification of Earth's crust velocity models using mathematical simulation and active seismology methods are presented. Implementation of the technology for two velocity models of Earth's crust for the south of the Baikal rift zone and adjacent Mongolian areas in experiments called BEST (Baikal Explosion Seismic Transect) and PASSCAL (Program for the Array Seismic Study of Continental Lithosphere) is considered. The Internet resource of the information technology is implemented as part of the scientific information system “Active Seismology”.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of forming of optimal combination of machineries and tractors park subject to social factor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A number of essential for economical activity factors are changed in process of planning or already after planning, and it is necessary to correct operatively them to take account of new conditions, and therefore the task of making management decision at the earliest possible date is appeared. The mathematical model, developed for task solution of forming of optimal combination of machineries and tractors park (MTP) in enterprise subject to limitations of machineries amount and social factor, is presented in this article. On the basis of described model the web-application for decision support and operatively management of agricultural enterprise were developed with application of technologies of remote access at Siberian Physical and Technical Research Institute of agrarian problems of the Federal State Budgetary Establishment of the Siberian Region of the Academy of Sciences. It is allowed to move from strategical tasks to decision the tasks of current situation. The experimental researches were carried out, the variants of optimal combination of MTP for concrete enterprise were calculated. According to the obtained results it is concluded, that developed web-application allows to carry out necessary calculation with different basic data, to compare received variants of decision, to operatively react to change of conditions of activity of an enterprise in process of crop production, to make a decision of plant management.

articleTitle: Statistical modeling the probability of some types of automobile-pedestrian accidents
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper simulation models of some common types of traffic accidents are proposed: automobile-pedestrian accident on unregulated crosswalks with one or two lanes. articleTitle: Energy-efficient control options of electric drive based on asynchronous converter-fed motor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the options of energy-efficient control and static characteristics of the adjustable speed electric drive based on asynchronous converter-fed motor. Electric drive analytical models and vector diagram are presented.

articleTitle: Distortion effect analysis of N-OFDM signal with frequency drifts of carrier wave
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper, research results of the distortion effect of an N-OFDM signal are presented. The consequence emerges due to a frequency drift of the carrier wave because of the Doppler effect during user's movement and instability of oscillator frequency, when a transfer of the spectrum is implemented in transmitting and reception path of the communication system. The N-OFDM signal based on the Hartley transform with the QAM modulation of subcarrier was analyzed. The interference immunity of the N-OFDM signal was defined for different frequency spacing between subcarriers and various frequency drifts of the subcarriers for an equivalent low-frequency channel with AWGN. Demodulation was implemented by the modified Cauchy method. The highest possible shift of the frequency subcarriers of the N-OFDM signal was determined by means of simulation experiments in Matlab 7 for the situation, when it is still possible to keep a communication session.

articleTitle: Analysis and modeling of latent defects in the printed conductors
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper substantiates the necessity of taking into account of hidden (latent) defects printed conductors. Defines the conditions of transition latent defect of the printed conductor in obvious defect, leading to inoperability of the printed circuit board. Allocated technological defect of the printed conductor in the form of cracks and is made analysis of stress-strain state. Specified conditions of overgrowth defect depending on external factors (mechanical stresses). This model allows to perform numerical simulations of the printed circuit board and to determine the conditions for the transition of latent defects (cracks) in obvious defect, depending on the external impact (acceleration). The results of computational experiments have allowed to reveal mechanical stress in the defect zone depending on the size of the printed conductor and external acceleration.

articleTitle: Development of low-cost electronic training boards based on universal microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)

articleTitle: The investigation of the mechanism of hardening and softening of aluminum single crystals with ultrasound loading
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Amorphous metal alloys are a unique structurally disordered system with metallic properties. These alloys have received to date a significant practical use. The most valuable information about the structure of these materials can be obtained by X-ray analysis. Method research system of amorphous metal alloys Zr-Cu-Ni-Al by X-ray scattering is presented in the article. Microstructure and x-ray curves of patterns depending on the heat treatment are studied. It established, the introduction of carbon, silicon and boron with one hand had impaired zirconium-based alloys for amorphization, but at the same time it had made it possible to obtain partially amorphous materials, reinforced with dispersed particles of carbides, nitrides, borides. The proposed method is used to clarify the phase composition and determine the characteristics of the local structure of nanomaterials, including amorphous metal alloys, is extended the notion of communication structure with the physical and chemical properties.

articleTitle: Methods of calculation of load modes of roughing stand electric drives of wide-strip hot rolling mill
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper provides analysis of load modes for electric drives of horizontal rolls installed at the continuous train of the wide-strip hot rolling mill. publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)

publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)

articleTitle: Combined control of an asynchronous machine with squirrel - cage rotor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An asynchronous machine with squirrel cage rotor operation under combine control is investigated. articleTitle: Distributed storage approach in content delivery networks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes an approach that improves the functionality of LH*RS - high-availability scalable distributed data structure. The core concept behind this approach is the particular implementation of LH* schema that allows efficient imagery data storage for content delivery networks (CDN) to be created. We propose the novel wavelet-based method of buckets composition and distribution among storage nodes to improve the basic characteristics of schema. This method is less redundant than image pyramid structure (MIP maps). Also we propose some ideas for multilevel encoding algorithms and multilevel privacy protection in this storage schema.

articleTitle: Methods of providing reliability of avionics and aerospace equipment at the design stage
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The design solutions to improve the reliability of onboard radio-electronic systems, consisting of several printed circuit units, are proposed. It is suggested to use several circuit boards, connected by nonlinear damping devices. A model of the three node system, each of which focuses a mass portion of the PCB and mounted components, and is connected by elastic links, is given. The analysis model is designed. It is shown, that the forced oscillations of the boards are extinguished with the damping device of the central node of the mounting. It is due to the fact, that some of the energy radiated by a more active oscillating board with a greater amplitude, will be repaid by the board vibrating at the same time with a lower amplitude. It will ultimately prevent the possibility of oscillations of any board at a frequency close to the resonant one. The proposed approach provides the increased reliability of onboard radio-electronic systems under the conditions of vibrational dynamic loading. A modification of the damping systems in the form of guide rollers, as well as the execution of the floating connectors on the housing of the radio-electronic unit, and the preload of the board package with elastic pad straps to the connectors, are proposed. It will ultimately reduce the mechanical impact on the radio-electronic components of the boards. Mathematical modeling of onboard radio-electronic systems structures, which confirm the validity of the theoretical calculations and design solutions, is carried out.
